b50ab001.title: Pre-Sales Solution Architect
b50ab001.description:
**Function**
Presales
  
  
**Our Company**
We’re Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world’s innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers – from banks to theme parks ­– can focus on achieving the incredible with data.
  
  
If you’ve seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you’ve seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate – and wow their customers. Right now, we’re laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We’re looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team – and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.
  
  
**Job Description**
The primary role of a TechSales Solutions Consultant is to work collaboratively with the direct sales team as well as partners to provide support for all presales solution aspects of the sales cycle. Job requirements include but are not limited to the following activities; RFI/RFP preparation, opportunity & account planning, technical liaison (representing Sales) to Professional Services / Partners and APAC TEs / Product Management teams, demonstrations, joint partner solutions etc. Solution Consultant plays a vital role in establishing and supporting the technical sales relationship with prospects & clients. In concert with the sales representative, the Solution Consultant maps product capabilities to client needs and sets mutually understood and accepted expectations related to our solutions to ensure the success of post-sale implementations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide technical sales support to the sales team and partners leading the engagements
* Strong Focus on Customer engagements in ongoing opportunities
* Leverage technical relationship and trusted advisor role to create new opportunities with consultative selling
* RFI/RFP support (both proactive and reactive)
* Solution proposal support to highlight differentiators and quantified benefits with CXO level summary
* Technical engagements with key partners (SI, ISV etc.) for joint Solution development and / or joint bidding
* Lead initial solution demonstrations to customers/partners
* Assist in pre-sales to post-sale transition to ensure smooth implementation and maximum customer satisfaction

**Required Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify, document and articulate the business and technical requirements of a prospective customer during the full sales cycle – qualification, proposal, post-sale transition
* Strong ability to communicate our software ability to address prospect’s requirements through compelling presentation (written, oral and product demonstrations) of the applications
* Excellent customer facing and presentation skills
* Excellent collaboration and Team work not only with in HV teams but also partner teams
* Proactive in approach to lead customer/partner/consultant engagements and strengthen HV’s presence in accounts
* Excellent writing and quantitative skills, specifically related to proposals, RFI/RFP response and MS PowerPoint presentations
* High level of energy, enthusiasm, persistence, discipline, and a strong desire to succeed
* Willingness to do whatever is necessary to win (Team work, ability to resolve issues etc.)
* Ability to travel

**Technical Skills**

* Good technical experience in Data Center level infrastructure with strong focus on Storage
* Good understanding of Object Storage technologies
* Minimum 10 years of experience with 8 years being in presales role
* Experience with Database, Application integration etc. desirable
* Experience in conducting demos
* Experience to lead consultative workshops to demonstrate business value

**About Us**
We’re a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
  
  
**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
  
  
We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
  
  
**How We Look After You**
We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We’re also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We’re always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. So here, you’ll experience a sense of belonging, and discover autonomy, freedom, and ownership as you work alongside talented people you enjoy sharing knowledge with.
  
  
We’re proud to say we’re an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, age, disability status or any other protected characteristic. Should you need reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know so that we can do our best to set you up for success.

9ca46456.title: Cloud Engineer, Data and AI
9ca46456.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience architecting and deploying enterprise-grade cloud data platforms, incorporating both streaming and batch processing workflows.
* Experience writing software in Python, Scala, R, or similar.
* Experience with Gemini models, ADK, Gemini Enterprise, and other google AI products.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning.
* Experience with data analytics, data visualization techniques and software, and deep learning frameworks.
* Experience with core data science techniques.
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts, including data warehouse technical architectures, infrastructure components, ETL/ELT and reporting/analytic tools and environments.
* Knowledge of cloud computing, including virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems, and content delivery networks.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

  

As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will design and implement machine learning solutions for customer use cases, leveraging core Google products including TensorFlow, DataFlow, and Vertex AI. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to apply machine learning in their business, and travel to customer sites to deploy solutions and deliver workshops to educate and empower customers. Additionally, you will work closely with Product Management and Product Engineering to build and constantly drive excellence in our products.  
  
In this role, you are the Google Engineer working with Google's largest and most ambitious Cloud customers. Together with the team you will support customer implementation of Google Cloud products through: architecture guidance, best practices, data migration, capacity planning, implementation, troubleshooting, monitoring, and much more.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide expert advisory on architectural frameworks and operational best practices for comprehensive Agentic platforms, encompassing deployment, monitoring, evaluation, governance, and security protocols.
* Lead comprehensive artificial intelligence initiatives through strategic thought leadership, while identifying agentic workflows and designing robust architectural solutions for advanced agentic implementations.
* Deliver effective big data and machine learning solutions and solve complex technical customer challenges.
* Identify new product features and feature gaps, provide guidance on existing product challenges, and collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers to influence the roadmap of Google Cloud Platform.
* Provide expert guidance on architectural data strategies to ensure optimized utilization across different AI models. Deliver best practices recommendations, tutorials, blog articles, and technical presentations adapting to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

7c632d47.title: Program Manager – Identity & Access Management (IAM)
7c632d47.description:
Seeking a results-driven **Program Manager – Identity & Access Management (IAM)** to lead and coordinate enterprise IAM programs for clients in India and global markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong program and project management capabilities with a solid understanding of enterprise identity security solutions, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM).

This role requires ownership of program planning, governance, delivery execution, risk management, financial tracking, vendor coordination, stakeholder engagement, and client reporting. The successful candidate will work closely with IAM architects, engineering teams, business analysts, security leaders, and external partners to ensure programs are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives and security requirements.

Candidates should demonstrate the ability to manage multiple workstreams, maintain executive-level visibility, resolve delivery challenges, and translate complex IAM initiatives into measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

1. IAM Program and Project Delivery

* Lead end-to-end delivery of enterprise IAM programs across multiple clients, business units, and geographic regions.
* Define program scope, objectives, delivery roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, and success metrics.
* Manage multiple IAM workstreams and ensure alignment between technical implementation, business requirements, and security objectives.
* Monitor delivery progress, identify bottlenecks, manage dependencies, and implement corrective actions to maintain timelines.
* Drive program execution using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies, depending on project requirements.

2. IAM Technical and Functional Oversight

* Provide program-level oversight across core IAM, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM) initiatives.
* Coordinate implementation and integration activities involving SSO, MFA, identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, access certification, and privileged access controls.
* Work with technical teams implementing platforms such as Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and BeyondTrust.
* Ensure technical deliverables, integration dependencies, and implementation milestones align with the approved solution architecture.
* Facilitate communication between business stakeholders, security teams, architects, engineers, and platform vendors.
* Identify technical delivery risks and coordinate resolution with the relevant subject-matter experts.

3. Program Governance and Performance Management

* Establish and maintain program governance frameworks, reporting structures, delivery reviews, and escalation mechanisms.
* Track KPIs, milestones, deliverables, resource utilization, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, steering committee updates, and status presentations.
* Maintain RAID logs and ensure risks and issues have clear owners, mitigation plans, and resolution timelines.
* Drive accountability across workstream leads and ensure adherence to governance standards and delivery commitments.

4. Financial Management and Commercial Oversight

* Monitor program budgets, resource costs, financial forecasts, and delivery performance against approved plans.
* Track financial performance, commercial commitments, and project profitability in coordination with relevant teams.
* Support client invoicing milestones, billing coordination, and timely validation of completed deliverables.
* Identify potential budget overruns, scope changes, and resource constraints, recommending appropriate corrective actions.
* Ensure financial reporting and commercial documentation remain accurate and up to date.

5. Client and Stakeholder Management

* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, including senior management, security leaders, business owners, and operational teams.
* Lead program review meetings, stakeholder workshops, steering committee discussions, and executive updates.
* Communicate progress, delivery risks, dependencies, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage expectations, resolve escalations, and ensure alignment on scope, timelines, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and strengthen client confidence through transparent delivery management.

6. Resource, Vendor and Team Coordination

* Coordinate cross-functional teams comprising IAM engineers, solution architects, business analysts, project managers, and vendor partners.
* Support resource planning, allocation, capacity management, and delivery prioritization across multiple workstreams.
* Monitor vendor performance, delivery commitments, dependencies, and contractual obligations.
* Facilitate collaboration between internal teams, client organizations, and third-party service providers.
* Promote accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across delivery teams.

7. Risk, Compliance and Delivery Assurance

* Identify and manage program risks relating to delivery timelines, integrations, dependencies, resources, costs, and stakeholder expectations.
* Ensure IAM initiatives align with organizational security policies, access governance requirements, and applicable compliance obligations.
* Coordinate audit readiness, evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking where required.
* Ensure appropriate change management, issue escalation, and quality assurance processes are followed.
* Drive lessons learned and improvement initiatives to enhance future program delivery.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience:-**

Candidates should possess the following skills and capabilities:

**Program and Project Management**

* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in project or program delivery.
* Experience managing complex technology initiatives, multiple workstreams, project plans, milestones, and dependencies.
* Strong program governance, risk management, financial tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
* Proven stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and escalation management skills.
* Practical experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

**Identity & Access Management**

* Strong understanding of enterprise IAM concepts, architectures, and implementation lifecycles.
* Knowledge of SSO, MFA, identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, and access governance.
* Understanding of IGA platforms such as SailPoint and Saviynt.
* Understanding of PAM solutions such as CyberArk and BeyondTrust.
* Familiarity with SSO and MFA platforms such as Okta and Ping Identity.
* Ability to coordinate technical teams and track IAM implementation deliverables, risks, integrations, and dependencies.

**Communication and Leadership**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to engage with senior client stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain delivery focus in a dynamic environment.

**Preferred Certifications:-**

Candidates with one or more of the following certifications will be preferred:

* Project Management Professional (PMP)
* PRINCE2 or Program Management Professional (PgMP)
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or SAFe certification
* ITIL certification

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you hold PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, CSM/SAFe, or ITIL certifications?
* What hands-on or program-level experience do you have with IAM, IGA, and PAM solutions? Please specify your exposure to Okta, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and/or BeyondTrust, including SSO and MFA implementations.
* How many years of experience do you have in program or project management, particularly in enterprise IAM initiatives?
* What are your current and expected annual CTC (in LPA)?
* What is your current notice period, and what is your earliest possible joining date? Are you available to join within 15–30 days?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* in managing and delivering large-scale (IAM) programs. : 6 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a
**Senior Solution Architect**
to join our Databricks Practice and play a pivotal role in shaping data modernization journeys for enterprise customers. This is a customer-facing, consulting-oriented role where you will engage with CDOs, Data Architects, and Engineering leaders to design and deliver scalable, future-ready Lakehouse solutions on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

You will be the trusted technical advisor — translating business problems into architectural blueprints, guiding customers through EDW modernization programs, and championing the adoption of Databricks' most advanced capabilities including Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP), Lakeflow Connect, Serverless Compute, Unity Catalog, and AI/BI workloads.

**Responsibilities:**

1. Lead pre-sales and delivery architecture conversations with enterprise customers, owning the technical narrative from discovery through solution design and through implementation oversight.

2. Design end-to-end Databricks Lakehouse architectures spanning ingestion, transformation, governance, ML, and consumption layers — aligned to Medallion Architecture principles.

3. Drive EDW modernization engagements, including migration strategies from legacy platforms (Teradata, Netezza, Oracle, SAS, Greenplum, Synapse, Snowflake,

on-prem Hadoop) to Databricks, with clear wave planning, risk mitigation, and TCO/ROI articulation.

4. Advise customers on the adoption of advanced Databricks features.

5. Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (LDP / formerly DLT) for production-grade ETL with

built-in data quality and lineage.

6. Lakeflow Connect for managed ingestion from SaaS, databases, and file sources.

8. Unity Catalog for unified governance, lineage, and fine-grained access control.

9. Databricks Asset Bundles (DAB) for CI/CD and environment promotion

10. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

11. Expertise in Data Bulid Tool (DBT) and Databricks Autoloader

12. Databricks SQL, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie for self-service analytics

13. MLflow, Model Serving, and Mosaic AI for ML and GenAI workloads

14. Conduct architecture deep-dives, PoCs, and workshops — including cost modelling roadmaps, runbooks and executive presentations.

15. Produce Client ready deliverables. HLD / LLD documents, reference architecture, migration road maps, runbook and execution presentations

16. Partner with sales, delivery, and Databricks field teams to shape proposals, SoWs, and bid responses.

17. Stay ahead of the Databricks product roadmap and evangelize new capabilities internally and with customers.

18. Mentor data engineers, platform engineers, and junior architects on Databricks best practices.

**Qualifications**

• 8+ years in data engineering / data platform architecture, with 3+ years hands-on on Databricks in a customer-facing or consulting capacity.

• Demonstrated experience leading at least 2–3 large- scale EDW modernization or Lakehouse migration programs end to end.

• Strong, fundamentals-level understanding of the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform.

• Delta Lake internals (transaction log, OPTIMIZE, Z- order, Liquid Clustering, Deletion Vector, Predictive Optimization)

• Spark execution model, Photon, cluster sizing, and performance tuning.

• Unity Catalog object model (metastore, catalogs, schemas, volumes, external locations, stor age credentials).

• Workspace, account, and identity architecture across AWS / Azure / GCP.

• Handson experience designing and deploying Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Conn ect, and Serverless workloads in production.

• Solid grounding in Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, and data governance fra meworks.

• Cloud fluency on at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP

including networking, IAM, and storage layers (ADLS Gen2 / S3 / GCS).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills able to engage equally with engineers and C- suite.

• Willing to travel and stay overseas for Solutioning and Delivering projects.

**Required Skills**

* AWS Platform Knowledge: Deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Knowledge of Azure: Experience with Azure platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into Azure-specific services and configurations.
* Familiarity with ICP: Exposure to ICP platform and service catalog, with understanding of how to integrate ICP with other cloud platforms.
* Containerization Expertise: Experience with containerization methods and tools, including selecting the right approach for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.

Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

8e1202d3.title: Tech S and T-Cloud AI Platform Architect-ISR-Manager-GDSF02
8e1202d3.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Architect)**
**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform architect expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering and Architecture Leadership

+ Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
+ Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
+ Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
+ Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
+ Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
+ Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
+ Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

* Client & Stakeholder Management

+ Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
+ Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
+ Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption

* Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
+ Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
+ Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
+ Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
+ Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
+ Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
+ Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

* MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
+ Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
+ Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
+ Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
+ Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
+ Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
+ Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
+ Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

* Business Development & GTM Initiatives

+ Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
+ Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
+ Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

* Program Governance & Delivery Excellence

+ Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
+ Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
+ Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

* Practice Development & Team Leadership


+ Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
+ Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
+ Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Education:**

* B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).

**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

**Consulting & Leadership Experience:**

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.

**Portfolio Requirements:**
Hands-on experience in building production-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

a0e5953c.title: Application Architect - Java
a0e5953c.description:
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. Youll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Associate Architect**

As an Associate Architect at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

As a Cloud Strategy practitioner, you will be responsible for working collaboratively within integrated cross functional teams to deliver comprehensive strategies that enable Cloud and Infrastructure Transformations.

**Work youll do:**

Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.

* Expertise in J2EE and Spring Boot:
* Strong proficiency in Java/J2EE frameworks, with a focus on Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Cloud.
* Extensive experience in developing scalable, high-performance enterprise applications using J2EE.
* Cloud Computing (AWS/Azure):
* Deep understanding and hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFormation) or Azure (App Services, Kubernetes Service, Event Hubs, Cosmos DB, Azure Functions).
* Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms.
* Microservices Architecture:
* Strong expertise in building and managing microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud Netflix (Eureka, Hystrix, Zuul, Ribbon), and REST/GraphQL APIs.
* Experience with inter-service communication using gRPC or Kafka.
* Performance Optimization:
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, and optimizing applications for performance using tools like JMeter, Java Flight Recorder..
* Expertise in JVM tuning, memory management, and SQL query optimization.
* DevOps Practices and CI/CD:
* Hands-on experience with DevOps tools and methodologies, including:
* CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline.
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible.
* Monitoring tools: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
* Database and Data Storage:
* Expertise in relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, DynamoDB, or Cosmos DB.
* Code Reviews and Best Practices:
* Expertise in conducting thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to SOLID principles, design patterns, and industry-standard best practices.
* Proficiency in writing clean, modular, and maintainable code using tools like SonarQube or PMD for static code analysis.
* API Management and Security:
* Experience in designing and managing APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, or API Gateway.
* Knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols like OAuth2, JWT, and SAML.
* System Architecture and Design:
* Strong experience in architecting scalable, distributed systems using microservices, event-driven architectures, and domain-driven design (DDD).
* Proficiency in creating technical design documents and architectural diagrams using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Archimate.
* Continuous Learning and Collaboration:
* Commitment to staying updated with the latest advancements in Java, J2EE, and cloud-native technologies.
* Excellent collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Product, QA, DevOps) to ensure alignment and deliver high-quality solutions.

**The team:**

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models—traditional teams, pools, or pods—are tailored to each client’s needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Qualifications

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* 10 - 17 years of industry experience, with at least 6+ years in a technical architect role designing applications and hosting solutions as public/private cloud SaaS PaaS platforms.
* At least 5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud native architecture design, implementation of distributed, fault-tolerant enterprise applications for cloud.
* Should have knowledge to understand and create the Target State Solutions.
* Should be able to create Low level designs for Engineering teams For Ex: Flow charts, Sequence diagrams, class diagrams.
* Should have knowledge of reusable components- Filters, JPA, Logging and Monitoring.
* Should have Hands-On experience on
* Spring web-Java API development along with certification process
* Maven build Tools
* Spring JPA, connection pool configuration
* Event Driven Implementation: Kafka connector library Integration with Java.
* Should have good knowledge of SOLID principles and Java Design Pattern
* Should define Interfaces and re-usable components to avoid duplicate effort - For Ex: Circuit breaker, Retry, Error Handling.
* Experience in application migration and modernization of legacy applications to AWS cloud platforms.
* Familiarity of principles summarized in the AWS Cloud Adoption and Well-Architected Frameworks
* Deep expertise of architecting and designing end-to-end AWS solutions architecture, recommending best cloud architecture patterns suiting the business problems, (Integrating services like: AWS API Gateway, SQS, SNS, Step Function, Amazon MQ, Lambda, AWS S3 and storage classes, etc.)
* Working experience of designing approach and migrating solution from on-prem using AWS Database Migration, Migration Hub, Application Migration Service, etc.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, EKS or OpenShift container platforms
* Working knowledge of AWS CodePipeline, CodeCommit, CodeBuild, CodeArtifact, AWS X-Ray, IAM Policies, KMS, GuardDuty, etc.
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, design and implementation creating cloud architecture leveraging PaaS and IaaS.
* Strong understanding of the cloud native development practices and architectural patterns
* Experience in leading and managing teams within specialist areas from project planning to execution

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Awareness of industry trends, challenges, technology adoption levels and solution landscape
* Understanding of backup, replication, disaster recovery and high availability technologies
* Understanding on network architectures including integration of software components such as web / application servers, middleware, RDBMS, development environments, operational components and data center operations
* Understanding of cloud security and regulatory policies and governance mechanisms
* Experience in marketplace tools for cloud discovery, migration and modernization or Cloud FinOps
* Experience in cloud infrastructure design of data, storage and networking infrastructure, addressing disaster recovery and business continuity planning requirements
* Certification from any cloud service provider (AWS, Azure, GCP)

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

* Finance AI Strategy & Innovation | Brief Job Description

**Role Intent**

* A hands-on delivery leader who can shape a new squad, turn an undefined AI opportunity into an executable plan, and own delivery outcomes while continuing to lead core Scrum activities.

**Role purpose**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of a Finance AI Strategy squad operating in a complex and evolving environment.
* The role will establish the squad, delivery approach, governance and working rhythm, translating business problems into prioritised, measurable outcomes from discovery and experimentation through implementation and adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own delivery from problem definition and discovery through planning, build, testing, release, adoption and outcome tracking.
* Shape the squad from the ground up, clarifying purpose, roles, accountabilities, decision rights and ways of working.
* Translate ambiguous business and AI opportunities into a clear roadmap, prioritised backlog, milestones and achievable delivery plans.
* Manage scope, capacity, risks, assumptions, dependencies, blockers and trade-offs, escalating early with clear options and recommendations.
* Lead stakeholder alignment across Finance, Product, Data, Architecture, Engineering, Risk and third-party suppliers.
* Facilitate Scrum activities including refinement, sprint planning, daily coordination, reviews and retrospectives, applying Agile practices pragmatically rather than mechanically.
* Maintain delivery transparency through Jira, dashboards, milestone reporting, decisions, delivery confidence and measurable outcomes.
* Create a culture of ownership, experimentation, learning and continuous improvement in a setting where no established playbook may exist.

**Essential Experience And Capabilities**

* Proven ownership of complex technology, transformation, data or AI-enabled delivery, with clear evidence of personal contribution and business impact.
* Experience establishing a new squad, delivery model, product initiative or programme from an early or undefined starting point.
* Ability to operate confidently in ambiguity, structure complex problems and progress decisions with incomplete information.
* Strong delivery management across planning, governance, risk, dependencies, stakeholder communication and execution.
* Practical Scrum and Agile expertise, supported by delivery judgement rather than ceremony-only facilitation.
* Credibility with senior business and technology stakeholders, including the ability to challenge constructively and influence without formal authority.
* Working knowledge of AI, data, automation or emerging-technology delivery is strongly desirable; deep technical development expertise is not mandatory.
* Basic delivery-level understanding of the SAP Finance landscape is advantageous, including exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW and Finance processes such as Record to Report (R2R), together with awareness of other relevant SAP modules. This is desirable rather than mandatory; deep SAP functional or technical expertise is not required.

**Senior HR Business Partner – Provation & Fluke Health Solutions**  
**Location:** Bangalore, India (hybrid)

**Role Summary**  
We are looking for a strategic, hands-on Senior HR Business Partner to support Provation and Fluke Health Solutions (FHS) in Bangalore. You’ll be a trusted advisor to site and business leaders. The role shapes talent, organization, and culture strategies that support business growth, while making sure HR runs well and stays compliant across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of India labor law and strong business acumen. You should be able to influence senior leaders in a matrixed, multi-entity global organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Business Partnership**

* Partner with site and business leaders to understand their priorities and turn them into people strategies and action plans.
* Act as a thought partner on organization design, workforce planning, and change management.
* Use people data and insights to spot trends, risks, and opportunities, and bring clear recommendations to leaders.
* Represent the Bangalore site in global HR forums so local needs shape broader programs.

**Talent Strategy & Development**

* Lead talent reviews, succession planning, and calibration, building strong pipelines for critical roles.
* Find and develop high-potential talent, and partner with leaders on development plans, career paths, and retention.
* Drive annual performance and rewards processes, including goal setting, reviews, and merit planning, and coach managers through each cycle.

* Partner with Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, hiring strategy, and building a strong employer brand in the Bangalore market.

**Employee Relations & Compliance**

* Manage employee relations matters fairly and consistently, from investigation through resolution.
* Keep HR policies and practices compliant with India labor laws and aligned with Fortive and OpCo standards.
* Support policy changes and their rollout, keeping the employee impact in mind.

**Engagement, Culture & Onboarding**

* Pick up on colleague sentiment and team dynamics early, and partner with leaders on engagement and retention.
* Build a culture of belonging and connection to Provation, FHS, and Fortive values.
* Shape an onsite onboarding experience that complements global and OpCo programs and helps new hires get productive quickly.

* Make sure core HR processes run smoothly at the site level, in partnership with the HR COEs and shared services.
* Use Fortive Business System (FBS) tools to improve HR processes, the colleague experience, and outcomes.

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3 years in an HR business partner role, ideally in a multinational, matrixed environment.

2c46492a.title: Service Delivery Manager - Metso IT Ops Network Services
2c46492a.description:
Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life.
  
  
Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources.
  
  
Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration.
  
  
This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible.
  
  
**Job posting end date:**  
Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC
  
  
Introduction
  
  
We are looking for a Network Service Delivery Manager – APAC to join our Network Service Delivery team in Information Technology. In this role, you will ensure reliable, secure, cost-effective and business-aligned network services across the Asia-Pacific region. You will be the regional link between business stakeholders, Country IT teams, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, project teams and external service providers, and you will make sure regional needs – including offices, manufacturing plants and service locations – are well represented in our global network operating model.
  
  
This role is based in Gurugram, India, and includes regional travel as required.
  
  
Team you will belong to
  
  
You will join our Network Service Delivery community, working closely with the Network Service Delivery Team Lead and regional service delivery managers to keep ways of working and service delivery practices consistent across regions. We collaborate with Country IT teams, global network service owners, Information Security, Procurement, Finance and external service providers. Our work spans APAC time zones and includes participation in agreed major-incident escalation and planned maintenance arrangements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Oversee the delivery and performance of network services across APAC sites, including local and wireless networks, software-defined WAN (SD-WAN), internet connectivity and secure remote access, aligning resilience with global site criticality standards.
  
Manage service performance against agreed service-level and operational-level agreements, working with internal teams and service providers to maintain availability, capacity and readiness.
  
Act as the regional escalation point for critical network incidents, coordinating restoration, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and govern network changes and resilience testing.
  
Serve as the regional focal point for network demand, ensuring business and site requirements are documented, prioritized and progressed with Country IT, Global Network, Architecture, Information Security, Operational Technology (OT) and project teams, in line with global standards and approved designs, including IT/OT network segmentation where applicable.
  
Represent APAC priorities in global network service, governance and roadmap discussions, and drive regional improvement opportunities.
  
Coordinate service provider relationships, monitor supplier performance and escalations, and partner with Procurement, Global Service Owners and Country IT Managers on service requirements, renewals, budgets, costs and cost optimization.
  
Coordinate network needs for new site setups, expansions, relocations, closures and integrations of acquired businesses, and communicate service performance, risks, outages and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  
Ensure new or changed network services move into operations with accurate service records, monitoring and documentation, and drive improvements in monitoring, reporting, automation and operational analytics.
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Network Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
Typically 8–10 years of experience in enterprise network services, infrastructure operations or IT service management, including service delivery, vendor management or regional coordination across multiple countries.
  
Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including local and wireless networks, SD-WAN, internet connectivity, routing, VPNs, IT/OT network segmentation, high-availability architectures and network security fundamentals.
  
Demonstrated experience managing service-level agreements, major incidents, problem resolution, service transitions and supplier performance.
  
Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication and commercial skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.
  
ITIL Foundation certification or higher, or other relevant networking, infrastructure or IT service management certifications (nice to have).
  
Experience managing network services in a global, multi-vendor environment, ideally in manufacturing, industrial, mining or other operationally critical multi-site settings, and experience within APAC (nice to have).
  
Familiarity with enterprise SD-WAN, switching, wireless and network monitoring platforms such as Palo Alto Prisma SD-WAN, HPE Aruba or SolarWinds, or equivalent (nice to have).
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Metso, you will combine meaningful work with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact in a supportive and inclusive environment. You’ll be part of a global team where collaboration, wellbeing, and continuous learning are part of everyday work.
  
  
**We support your growth and wellbeing by offering:**  
**Purpose-led work:** Contribute to enabling sustainable modern life and transforming the industry.
  
**Wellbeing:** Access to wellbeing programs, occupational healthcare, and supportive services.
  
**Rewards:** Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  
**Growth:** Learning pathways, mentoring, internal mobility, and global collaboration opportunities.
  
**Culture:** A caring, collaborative, and inclusive workplace committed to helping you thrive.
  
  
Get in touch
  
  
Want to rise above the possible with us? Click “Apply now” to submit your application.
  
  
We recognize that highly capable candidates may hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification. You may be exactly the right candidate for the role.
  
  
**Hiring Manager:** Shiji Nambiar
  
  
Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. Compensation information is shared in line with local legislation and applicable recruitment practices.
  
  
How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people
  
  
Metso is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, nationality, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran or status as a qualified individual with a disability.
  
  
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers’ energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.
  
  
Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

5a204c22.description:
**Description**
Amazon Health Services (AHS) is on a mission to make it dramatically easier for customers to find, choose, afford and engage with the services, products, and professionals they need to get and stay healthy. We use design, service and technology to provide the best possible customer experience and change the way people think about healthcare. Our team owns some of the Science charter of AHS and specifically the Evaluations of Health AI and Integrations team (integration of Health AI and Pharmacy) along with all of the data that powers our optimization and valuation services.
  
  
We are seeking a lead Technical Program Manager to partner with our Engineering, Product, Science and Marketing teams to deliver world class experiences for our customers. This position will require a broad set of skills that will range from deep-dive analytical problem solving, working with engineering, understanding science to executive reporting. You will be working directly with engineering and science tech teams, Product and business teams, and all of our partner teams, which include teams within and outside of AHS.
  
  
The right person will demonstrate proven track of software delivery and good management experience to manage numerous stakeholders and ambiguous processes; understand how to evaluate control effectiveness; understand potential risks and how to address them; provide in-depth consultation; be able to deliver high priority projects; and have the ability to prioritize mitigation efforts using risk management concepts. We are looking for a leader who excels at building and managing mechanisms, continuously evaluating how to improve these mechanisms, and then revising on an ongoing basis. AHS is in start-up mode, and we are seeking a leader that is flexible, dynamic, and can proactively make recommendations on how to improve our approach.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architecting, building, and owning mechanisms between technical teams and our partners. Surfacing status and key issues with partner development and ensuring projects stay on task,
  
  
Identifying and problem-solving risks across the software development lifecycle and developing escalation paths where appropriate,
  
  
Owning key business processes and leadership mechanisms for flagship projects and coordinating task development and completion,
  
  
Supporting career development and growth within the team by sharing mechanism best practices and participating in the team’s recruiting efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon’s mission is to make it dramatically easier for customers to access the healthcare products and services they need to get and stay healthy. Towards this mission, we (Health Store and Tech) are building the technology, products and services, that help customers find, buy, and engage with the healthcare solutions they need.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

41a6acc5.title: Senior Program Manager, Data Insights
41a6acc5.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a high-visibility Data Insights Program for a large payments client. The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of program management experience, a strong background in data products, analytics platforms, data architecture, and data engineering, and the ability to establish program roadmaps and governance structures in a fast-moving environment.

  

This is a data-focused program leadership role requiring strong stakeholder management, enterprise delivery, regulatory compliance, and financial management capabilities.

  

**Experience:** 10+ years  
**Work Mode:** Remote  
**Working Hours:** Must overlap with US Eastern Time  
**Certification:** Active PMP certification is mandatory

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Data Program Leadership

* Lead complex, cross-functional data programs from initial scoping through implementation and go-live.
* Define program roadmaps, governance structures, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Coordinate data product, analytics and insights platform, data architecture, and engineering teams.
* Translate business requirements into actionable data and insights deliverables.
* Align business and technology stakeholders on program objectives and expected outcomes.

2. Program Management and Delivery

* Manage large-scale enterprise portfolios worth $10M+ across scope, schedule, budget, forecasting, risks, and change management.
* Own program vision, strategy, and roadmaps.
* Translate business, regulatory, and compliance requirements into API-first, cloud-native, and data-driven solutions.
* Drive delivery using Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe methodologies.
* Coordinate engineering, data, AI/ML, UX, and DevOps teams.
* Define and monitor OKRs and KPIs and validate business value after go-live.
* Manage vendors, contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), and onshore/offshore delivery teams.

3. Program Governance and PMO

* Maintain project plans, RAID logs, action trackers, and dependency trackers across multiple workstreams.
* Conduct governance meetings, steering committee reviews, and leadership discussions.
* Establish program reporting standards and governance best practices.
* Manage change-control processes, Change Advisory Board activities, and intake workflows.
* Monitor risks and issues, conduct risk-register reviews, and escalate critical concerns with mitigation options.

4. Executive Reporting and Stakeholder Management

* Prepare weekly, monthly, and senior-management status reports, executive presentations, and program dashboards.
* Use Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and performance tracking.
* Work closely with senior business leaders, technology leadership, C-suite stakeholders, risk, legal, and compliance teams.
* Maintain accountability for program delivery and business outcomes.

5. Risk, Compliance, and Data Governance

* Deliver audit-ready solutions in regulated environments.
* Support compliance with applicable regulatory and control frameworks, including OCC, Federal Reserve supervisory expectations, SOX, SOC 1/SOC 2, and PCI-DSS.
* Lead data governance initiatives, including data-domain identification, lineage tracking, data-quality controls, and data-gap remediation.
* Monitor controls, conduct risk reviews and quarterly attestations, and manage remediation of control deficiencies.
* Apply knowledge of relevant financial regulations, including Dodd-Frank, ECOA, BSA/AML, KYC, GDPR, and CCPA.

6. Resource and Financial Management

* Manage resource planning, capacity, budget tracking, and program financials.
* Monitor expenditure and program health against agreed targets and milestones.
* Maintain portfolio data and program information using PPM tools such as Clarity PPM.

  

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 10+ years of program management experience leading complex, cross-functional programs from initiation through delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience in data products, analytics and insights platforms, data architecture, and data engineering.
* Proven ability to establish roadmaps, governance, and structure when program scope is still evolving.
* Experience managing large enterprise portfolios, budgets, risks, schedules, and multiple vendors.
* Hands-on knowledge of Waterfall, Agile, and SAFe delivery methodologies, including PI planning and release planning.
* Strong PMO discipline, including project plans, RAID logs, dependency tracking, governance forums, and executive reporting.
* Active PMP certification.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of financial regulations, data privacy, and compliance controls.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work hours that overlap with US Eastern Time.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in payments, merchant services, banking, or financial services.
* Direct experience leading data governance or data-controls programs under regulatory oversight.
* Experience with cloud migrations involving Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS.
* Exposure to Identity and Access Management (IAM) programs.
* Experience with AI/ML, analytics, and generative AI use cases in financial services.
* Experience managing merger or integration programs, hyper-care, and major-incident frameworks.
* Additional certifications such as PSM I, CSM, PSPO I, SAFe PO/PM, SAFe Scrum Master, ITIL Foundation, Azure AZ-900/DP-900, or Google Cloud Foundations.

  

**Tools and Technologies**

JIRA, Confluence, Clarity PPM, Microsoft Project, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall, data governance, analytics platforms, cloud technologies, and data engineering.

240af652.title: PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer
240af652.description:
**Purpose And Scope**
The PDM Digital Supply Chain Solution Engineer is responsible for shaping and assuring digital solutions across three core areas: SAP S/4HANA and ECC supply chain implementations, supply chain network design, and control tower and end-to-end supply chain visibility.
  
  
The role translates business, operational, data and regulatory requirements into scalable, secure and compliant solution designs for manufacturing-focused supply chain management. It works across demand and supply planning, procurement, production planning, manufacturing execution integration, materials management, inventory and quality-related processes, ensuring that SAP and connected platforms support an integrated global manufacturing supply chain operating model.
  
  
Working with Business Process Owners, System Owners, DigitalX, Enterprise Architecture, Quality, Validation, Data and Analytics teams, and delivery partners, the role leads solution design, technical assurance, integration, testing and implementation activities through stabilisation and transition to operations in a GxP-regulated environment.
  
  

* SAP S/4HANA and ECC Supply Chain Implementations
* Support solution design for SAP S/4HANA and ECC implementations, upgrades, rollouts and process harmonisation across supply chain capabilities.
* Translate business requirements into fit-to-standard process designs and functional requirements.
* Define solutions spanning relevant SAP manufacturing supply chain capabilities, including demand and supply planning, procurement, materials management, inventory management, production planning, manufacturing execution integration and quality-related processes.
* Ensure designs support global templates while addressing justified site, market, regulatory and operational requirements.
* Supply Chain Network Design
* Shape digital capabilities that support supply chain network design, including manufacturing footprint, plant, contract-manufacturing, sourcing and supply-network scenarios.
* Define data, modelling and integration requirements for scenario analysis covering capacity, demand, inventory, lead times, service levels, cost, risk and resilience.
* Partner with supply chain stakeholders to translate network strategy questions into repeatable analytical models, decision criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure network-design solutions use governed master data, transparent assumptions and traceable scenario outputs that can be connected to planning and execution processes.
* Control Tower and Supply Chain Visibility
* Design control tower and visibility capabilities that provide timely, role-based insight across the end-to-end supply chain.
* Define event, milestone, alert, exception and workflow requirements across suppliers, contract manufacturers, production sites, inventory locations, markets, customers and enterprise systems.
* Establish requirements for dashboards, operational KPIs, drill-down analysis, predictive insights, exception prioritisation and coordinated response management.
* Define integration across SAP ECC or S/4HANA, planning and manufacturing platforms, external supply partners, data platforms and analytics tools using APIs, middleware, EDI and event-based patterns.
* Ensure visibility solutions have clear data ownership, business rules, thresholds, escalation paths and measurable decision-making value.
* Delivery, Testing and Validation
* Support assigned solution workstreams from discovery and design through build, integration, deployment, stabilisation and transition to support.
* Define the technical test strategy and support system integration testing and UAT support, including end-to-end processes, interfaces, data, roles, controls, regression and applicable non-functional testing.
* Ensure test scripts, test data, evidence, defects, retesting and approvals comply with applicable GxP validation and change-control requirements.
* Stakeholder and Partner Leadership
* Act as a principal digital interface for global supply chain stakeholders, business process owners, technology teams, quality functions and external partners.
* Facilitate requirements, design, testing and decision workshops, clearly communicating solution options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs.
* Challenge vendors and delivery partners on solution quality, fit-to-standard, estimates, delivery risks and long-term supportability.
* Maintain transparent design decisions, assumptions, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria.

**Essential Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain or a related discipline.
* Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA and/or ECC supply chain implementations, upgrades or global rollouts in a complex organisation.
* Strong end-to-end knowledge of manufacturing supply chain processes and their integration across demand and supply planning, procurement, materials management, production planning, manufacturing, quality and inventory.
* Experience translating business requirements into SAP solution designs
* Practical experience with supply chain network design concepts, scenario modelling and the data needed to assess cost, capacity, inventory, service and resilience trade-offs.
* Experience designing or implementing supply chain control tower, visibility, event management, alerting, exception management, workflow or operational analytics capabilities.
* Experience integrating SAP with planning, manufacturing, partner, data and analytics platforms using APIs, middleware, EDI or event-based integration.
* Hands-on experience leading or coordinating system integration testing and UAT support, including planning, test data, defect management, retesting and evidence.
* Experience delivering systems in a GxP or similarly regulated environment, with working knowledge of validation and change control.
* Strong communication, facilitation, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.

**Desirable Qualifications And Experience**

* Pharmaceutical or life-sciences experience, including GxP validation and audit readiness.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and ECC Supply Chain Functionalities .
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI or comparable supply chain planning, network-design, visibility or analytics platforms.
* Experience defining operational KPIs, event models, alert thresholds, exception workflows and response governance for supply chain control towers.
* Experience with data products, master-data governance, cloud data platforms, advanced analytics, optimisation or AI-enabled supply chain use cases.
* Relevant SAP, supply chain, architecture, data, testing, validation, Agile or cloud certification.

**Working Environment**
Astellas recognises the importance of work-life balance and offers a hybrid working approach that combines time connecting with colleagues in the office with flexibility to work from home, in accordance with the Astellas Responsible Flexibility Guidelines.
  
  
Category
  
  
Astellas is committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.
  
  
EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans
