6701ad1e.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
6701ad1e.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* 4+ years of project management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management
* Experience in construction of data center delivery (design, commissioning and construction), mission critical facilities, or equivalent industrial/manufacturing facility builds
* Knowledge of mission critical systems (data centers, hospitals, power plants, military facilities, etc.)

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

**Job Category**

**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/
  
  
Johnson & Johnson is recruiting for a
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
, based in India. We are searching for top talent to join the Global Simplification and Innovation in Contracting program, GSINC.
  
  
Do you seek big, complex, and ambiguous challenges? Are you passionate about transforming enterprise contracting through simplified processes, modern technology, intelligent data, and responsible AI? Do you want to help build a capability that improves how Johnson & Johnson works with its employees, suppliers, customers, healthcare professionals, and research partners?
  
  
GSINC is building an integrated, AI-enabled contracting capability designed to make contracting faster, simpler, more consistent, and more valuable to the enterprise! The program brings together process, policy, templates, technology, data, and intelligence to establish a scalable, modern contracting foundation across Johnson & Johnson.
  
  
The
**Technical Product Owner, GSINC Contracting Solution**
will be responsible for translating the product strategy into an executable technology roadmap and scalable delivery model. This role will be responsible for the product backlog, shape priorities, coordinate dependencies, and establish the Agile and release practices required to support
**multiple concurrent deployments and continuous product evolution across the enterprise**
.
  
  
This is not simply a backlog-management role. The Technical Product Owner will help define
**how GSINC technology is built, released, scaled, and continuously improved**
, working across business, product, engineering, architecture, implementation partners, and platform teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Ownership and Roadmap
  
  

* Own and continuously refine the product roadmap and backlog for the GSINC Contracting Solution, aligned to business priorities and enterprise strategy.
* Translate business capabilities, process requirements, and user needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical priorities.
* Drive prioritization based on value, user impact, technical dependencies, risk, scalability, and delivery capacity.
* Maintain a clear view of product health, technical debt, platform enhancements, integrations, defects, and innovation opportunities.

Agile Delivery and Product Management
  
  

* Lead Agile product practices across backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, release planning, demos, retrospectives, and improvement.
* Balance near-term deployment requirements with the long-term integrity and scalability of the enterprise product.
* Use product metrics, user feedback, adoption data, and operational performance to continually refine priorities.

Concurrent Release and Deployment Model
  
  

* Design and operationalize an innovative delivery model that enables multiple GSINC deployments, enhancements, and product releases to progress concurrently.
* Establish release trains, development pathways, environment strategies, dependency management, testing approaches, and governance needed to move from sequential implementation toward continuous, parallel delivery.
* Define how enterprise product capabilities and business-specific deployments can advance simultaneously without creating unnecessary customization, fragmentation, or release conflicts.
* Create repeatable delivery patterns that allow GSINC to increase deployment velocity as adoption expands across business units, functions, and geographies.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and continually improve the operating model to increase throughput, predictability, quality, and speed.
* Lead solution architects and engineering teams to ensure product decisions align with enterprise architecture, security, data, and technology standards.
* Champion reusable enterprise capabilities and configuration over unnecessary customization.

Performance and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and monitor product and delivery measures including adoption, release velocity, cycle time, quality, defects, stability, user experience, and business value.
* Use data to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and increase delivery throughput.
* Provide concise leadership updates on roadmap progress, releases, risks, dependencies, product health, and outcomes.
* Continuously evolve the GSINC product and delivery model as the program scales globally.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience in technical product ownership, product management, Agile delivery, enterprise technology, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Product Owner or Technical Product Owner for a complex enterprise platform or product.
* Strong experience with Agile product development, backlog management, release planning, dependency management, and cross-functional delivery.
* Experience designing or operating delivery models that support multiple parallel workstreams, release trains, or concurrent deployments.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical capabilities, epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience working across engineering, architecture, business, testing, integration, data, and implementation teams.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms, workflow technology, integrations, APIs, data, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Contract Lifecycle Management or enterprise contracting experience preferred.
* Experience with platforms such as Azure DevOps or Jira and modern Agile/product management practices preferred.
* Agile, Product Owner, Scrum, SAFe, or product management certification preferred.

Leadership Capabilities
  
  

* Product mindset: Owns outcomes and product health, not simply requirements, ceremonies, or delivery activity.
* Technical fluency: Connects business needs with architecture, engineering, data, integration, and platform capabilities.
* Enterprise thinking: Builds reusable capabilities that scale across businesses and geographies while managing legitimate local requirements.
* Delivery orchestration: Creates the structure, cadence, and discipline required for multiple teams and releases to move concurrently.
* Bias for action: Works through ambiguity, removes obstacles, and moves teams toward decisions and outcomes.
* Strong judgment: Understands when to standardize, when to sequence, when to escalate, and where technical debt or complexity could constrain scale.
* Influence: Builds alignment across business, technology, vendors, and leadership without relying on direct authority.
* Data-driven communication: Uses evidence to prioritize decisions and provides leadership with clear, decision-ready recommendations.

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**Preferred Skills:**

c4075368.title: Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)
c4075368.description:
**Bid & Pre-Sales Executive (IT Tenders & RFPs)**

Sajal Tech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. | Bhopal (On-site) | Full-time | 1 to 4 years experience

**About Us**

Sajal Tech Solutions is an AI-first software development company based in Bhopal. We build SaaS products, AI/ML solutions, mobile apps and automation for clients in India, the US, the UK and the UAE. We hold ISO 9001:2015, ISO 27001 and CMMI Level 3 certifications, and we are a DPIIT-recognised startup and MSME.

**Role Summary**

You will run our government and enterprise IT bidding from start to finish. That means finding opportunities, understanding the technical scope, writing the proposal and submitting a compliant bid on time. You will work closely with our Head of Business Development and the technical team, and you need to know software well enough to write about it convincingly.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Tenders & Bids*

* Track and shortlist IT and software tenders and RFPs every day on GeM, CPPP (eprocure.gov.in), MP e-Tender, other state and PSU portals, and private or international RFP platforms
* Analyse each RFP and prepare a bid/no-bid summary covering scope, eligibility, PQ/TQ criteria, EMD, evaluation method and key dates
* Prepare complete bid packs, including technical and commercial proposals, compliance matrices, forms, annexures, affidavits and undertakings
* Submit bids online using a DSC and handle EMD/bid security, tender fees, BOQs and PBGs
* Attend pre-bid meetings, raise pre-bid queries, and track corrigenda, clarifications, technical evaluation and results
* Manage our GeM seller account, including catalogue, bids, reverse auctions and order acceptance
* Maintain a current bid library: registrations, certificates, financials, work orders, completion certificates, CVs and case studies
* Keep a tender tracker/MIS covering pipeline, submissions, win/loss and the reasons behind each result

*Technical Proposals & Pre-Sales*

* Write the technical sections of proposals: understanding of requirements, solution approach, architecture overview, technology stack, implementation plan, timelines, team deployment, SLA and support model
* Map RFP functional and technical requirements (FRS/SRS) into point-by-point compliance sheets
* Work with developers and architects on solution design, effort estimates, manpower plans and cost components (resources, cloud, licences, AMC)
* Prepare technical presentations and coordinate demos for evaluation committees and enterprise clients
* Create capability statements and case studies from our project portfolio

*Business Development Support*

* Help the Head of BD with proposals, decks and pricing inputs
* Handle vendor registrations and empanelments with government departments, PSUs and enterprises
* Find new opportunities, including upcoming tenders, consortium or partner bids, startup-friendly procurement and relevant schemes
* Manage follow-ups, CRM updates and documentation for active opportunities

**Requirements**

* B.Tech, BCA, MCA or B.Sc (IT/CS) strongly preferred
* 1 to 4 years in bid management or pre-sales for IT or software services
* Has submitted bids on GeM and CPPP or a state e-procurement portal, and can use a DSC independently
* Working knowledge of MSE and Startup relaxations (EMD exemption, prior turnover and experience waivers), Make in India (Class I/II supplier) and GFR basics
* Strong written English, with the ability to write clear, structured technical content

**Technical Knowledge (Must Have)**

* Understands the SDLC and Agile, and how web, mobile, ERP and SaaS projects are scoped, built and maintained
* Can read and break down technical scope covering portals, ERP, mobile apps, APIs and integrations, cloud hosting, AI/ML and AMC/O&M
* Familiar with cloud basics (AWS, Azure, GCP), MeitY-empanelled cloud, hosting, backup and DR
* Knows common government IT requirements: GIGW and accessibility, CERT-In security audits, STQC, data localisation, SLA/uptime and penalty clauses, ISO 27001
* Can prepare effort and manpower estimates with the tech team and sanity-check a BOQ

**Good to Have**

* Background as a developer, business analyst or pre-sales engineer
* Experience with international RFPs (Middle East, UK, US)
* Can create basic architecture diagrams (draw.io, Lucidchart or similar)
* Uses AI tools to draft and review documents faster

**What We Offer**

* Salary:
  **₹2.5 to ₹6**
  **LPA**
  , plus an incentive on won bids
* Work directly with the founders, the BD head and the engineering team
* Clear path to a Bid Manager / Pre-Sales Lead role
* A fast-growing AI-first company with international clients

**Build the Future with Us.**

Join NTT DATA Business Solutions, a global leader in SAP consulting and digital transformation. As part of the NTT DATA Group, we collaborate with over 16,700 professionals in 30+ countries to deliver innovative SAP solutions that help businesses thrive.

Take the next step in your career and become a trusted partner to our global customers. In this role, you'll support and optimize complex SAP landscapes, drive operational excellence, and contribute to impactful digital transformation projects, all while growing your expertise within a world-class team.

**Job Title: Presales Solution Architect-GTM**

**Experience: 15 to 20 Years**

**Job Location: Mumbai**

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Notice Period:**
Immediate to 30 days (or currently serving notice period)

**Travel:**
As needed

Job Description:

Role Overview

The Pre Sales Engineer – SAP S/4HANA is responsible for driving customer engagements, shaping solution positioning, and supporting the sales cycle with deep product expertise. The role requires hands-on SAP S/4HANA knowledge, strong customer-facing communication skills, and the ability to translate product capabilities into compelling business value for prospects.

This role partners closely with the Sales, Delivery and SAP Teams to accelerate cloud adoption and improve win rates.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Pre Sales Solutioning & Customer Engagement

• Lead the region, own - discovery sessions, requirement analysis, and solution mapping for SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

• Deliver high-impact demos in one or more areas namely Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, and Project Services.• Prepare solution presentations, value propositions, and customer-specific walkthroughs.

• Support RFIs/RFPs, proposals, and technical clarifications throughout the deal cycle.

• Lead conversations around S/4HANA Conversions and business value.

2. GTM Activities (Aligned with Global Practice)

• Create and refine pre-sales assets, pitch decks, value stories, and industry use cases.

• Localize global GTM assets for NDBS India context (industry, customer maturity, regional references).• Conduct internal enablement sessions for sales, consulting, and delivery teams.

• Ensure alignment with SAP roadmap, product changes, and release updates.

3. Hands-On SAP S/4HANA Cloud

• Perform configuration walkthroughs and demonstrate fit-to-standard processes.

• Showcase capabilities using Fiori apps, SAP Best Practices, SAP BTC and released scope items.• Explain Clean core concepts and extensibility, integrations (BTP, Integration Suite), and analytics options.

• Articulate cloud implementation approaches, project phases, and CALM/ALM usage.

4. Innovation, AI & Cloud Readiness

• Present emerging Public Cloud capabilities including automation, embedded ML/AI, and agentic AI (Joule).

• Evangelize SAP’s cloud operating model, upgrades, data migration methods, and extensibility guardrails.• Work with CoE teams to position AI-enabled use cases relevant to customer sector challenges.

1. Required Skills & Qualifications

• 8–12 years of SAP experience, including 3+ years in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

• Strong functional expertise in at least one core module (Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing).• Hands-on experience with fit-to-standard workshops, data migration, and release management.

• Prior experience in Pre Sales, Solutioning, or GTM roles would be an added advantage.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and demonstration skills.

• Ability to simplify complex SAP concepts for business and technical stakeholders.

2. Preferred Qualifications

• SAP S/4HANA certification.

• Familiarity with SAP BTP, SAC, integrations, workflow, and extensibility.• Exposure to industry-specific S/4HANA Cloud scope items and scenarios.

• Experience running PoVs, PoCs, or demo environments.

3. Why This Role Matters in NDBS India

This GTM role shapes customer perception, influences deal outcomes, and showcases NDBS India’s SAP Cloud leadership. You play a central role in customer-facing conversations, differentiating our offering, and accelerating SAP Cloud adoption for strategic accounts.

e014abd8.title: Solutions specialist - Pre sales and implementation
e014abd8.description:
**About the role**

You’ll be the technical voice behind our sales engagements and see each solution through to go-live: discovery, PoC/PoV, implementation and handover. You’ll configure the product, work with customer IT teams, troubleshoot what breaks and work directly with Sales, Product and Customer Success.

**What you’ll do**

·      
**Lead technical pre-sales and solutioning.**
Understand customer requirements and IT environments, conduct tailored discovery sessions and demos, explain Nanoheal’s capabilities and architecture, support proposals/RFPs/RFIs, and identify technical risks, dependencies and differentiators.

·      
**Plan and execute PoCs/PoVs.**
Define use cases, scope, timelines and success criteria; configure the product and integrations; coordinate customer testing, troubleshoot issues, document outcomes and limitations, and support the transition to production.

·      
**Design and document solutions.**
Develop solution architecture, integration designs, deployment prerequisites, implementation plans and SOWs; define milestones, responsibilities and acceptance criteria, and flag gaps against standard product capabilities.

·      
**Lead implementation and go-live.**
Conduct kickoff and readiness assessments, validate infrastructure and security prerequisites, configure the platform, onboard endpoints, integrate enterprise systems, coordinate technical dependencies, validate functionality against acceptance criteria, and drive implementation sign-off.

·      
**Troubleshoot and enable partners.**
Diagnose and resolve deployment, integration, automation and performance issues; analyze logs, coordinate and validate fixes with Product, and guide SIs and MSPs on implementation, configuration and troubleshooting to enable independent delivery.

·      
**Document, report and hand over.**
Maintain solution designs, configurations, test results, implementation records and known limitations; communicate project progress, risks and dependencies to internal stakeholders; hand over technical details and outstanding actions to Customer Success and contribute to reusable delivery best practices and product feedback.

**Who we’re looking for**

•    Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related discipline.

•    3–6 years in technical pre-sales, solution consulting or enterprise software implementation.

•    You’ve run demos, discovery sessions and PoCs, and hands-on configured, deployed and troubleshot a product.

•    You know Windows endpoints, endpoint management and enterprise IT environments well.

•    You can explain technical concepts to IT leads and business stakeholders in their own language, and juggle several engagements at once.

**Bonus points**

•    ITSM, UEM, identity management and security tools

•    DEX, DXA, endpoint management or self-healing IT experience

•    SQL, APIs and enterprise system integrations

c80d35e2.title: RFP & Solutions Manager
c80d35e2.description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a strategic thinker to own Payoneer's RFP and solutions delivery capability. You will build a modern, knowledge-driven RFP function that leverages AI and automation to scale response quality. You will also serve as a Solution & Implementation Manager on enterprise deals, building deep product and customer knowledge that directly informs RFP accuracy and responsiveness.
  
  
**This Role Balances Two Complementary Responsibilities**

* Designing and evolving a scalable RFP capability through knowledge management and automation
* Acting as a hands-on SIM when RFP volume is lower. The SIM expertise is what enables RFP excellence—knowing our solutions intimately allows you to ensure responses accurately reflect product capabilities and implementation realities

Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (to be coordinated to overlap with EMEA/Global teams)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Knowledge Management & RFP Strategy (Primary)
  
  

* Design and maintain a centralized knowledge management system that serves as the foundation for RFP responses
* Build automation and AI-assisted workflows to cover automated intake parsing, response drafting, versioning, knowledge management and quality gating
* Define RFP policies; ensure organization-wide understanding and adoption
* Lead continuous improvement: analyze win/loss themes, refresh content quarterly, incorporate feedback from Sales and delivery teams
* Own the accuracy of RFP responses by leveraging hands-on SIM knowledge to ensure solution descriptions and commitments reflect delivery reality
* Partner with Sales, Product, Ops, and Compliance to maintain content quality and relevance as our solutions evolve

Solution & Implementation Management (Primary when RFP volume is lower)
  
  

* Act as Solution & Implementation Manager on assigned enterprise deals, owning scoping, design, delivery and client success
* Build and maintain deep product and customer knowledge through hands-on implementation work
* Apply standard PS methodologies and client experience standards
* Bring implementation insights back into RFP process and knowledge base, ensuring responses reflect what we can actually deliver

Who You Are
  
  

* 5-7 years in enterprise presales, solution architecture, or technical account management
* 3-4 years leading RFP/RFI strategy and operations; passionate about knowledge management and process automation
* Demonstrated experience redesigning significant operational processes and driving organization-wide adoption
* Track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations
* Ability to think systemically about workflows, automation, and tradeoffs (where automation adds value vs. where human judgment is required)
* Strong cross-functional influence skills to drive alignment with Sales, Product, Ops, Compliance
* High fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.); demonstrated experience using or building AI agents for workflow automation
* High standards for quality and accuracy; ownership mindset; bias toward action
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to learn new technical domains quickly
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

What We Value
  
  
A builder's mindset. You see a broken system and ask: 'How would I redesign this from scratch?'
  
  
Ownership and accountability. You own outcomes: when things go wrong, you diagnose and improve
  
  
Learning agility. You're comfortable with new domains and approaches; you adapt and grow
  
  
Customer empathy. You care about impact—for internal stakeholders and external clients
  
  
Humble collaboration. You elevate others, build trust, and lead through influence
  
  
Bias toward action. You move forward with incomplete information and iterate based on feedback
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Job Title:** Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - Web Technology (React, Angular)

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:** Full Time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**

Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

**India Benefits include:**

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

**Hybrid working**

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Hiring process**

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

***Technical Presales | Discovery | Solution Architecture | Deployment | Managed Services***

**Experience-**
5–10 years of relevant experience

**Function-**
AI & Data Practice

**Role type**

Customer-facing, hands-on individual contributor

**Location- Noida**

**Reporting to-**
VP-AI & Data Practice

**Role overview**

AppSquadz is looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Architect who can own the technical customer journey—from first discovery and solution shaping through architecture, proof of concept, production deployment and managed-services recommendations. The role combines consultative technical presales with practical engineering judgment and accountability for secure, scalable, commercially viable AI solutions. The architect will collaborate with sales, alliances, delivery and customer stakeholders while remaining actively involved in implementation and handover.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Technical presales and solution shaping:**
  Partner with AI Services Business Development Manager in customer meetings; qualify AI opportunities, explain solution options, run technical demonstrations and contribute to proposals, effort estimates, bills of materials, statements of work and technical responses to RFPs.
* **Discovery workshops and use-case assessment:**
  Plan and facilitate business/IT workshops; map workflows, data sources, stakeholders, pain points, security constraints and success metrics. Assess AI readiness, prioritize use cases by value, feasibility and risk, and document requirements, assumptions and dependencies.
* **Architecture and solution design:**
  Design end-to-end generative AI, agentic AI, ML and data-enabled architectures covering models, prompts, RAG, vector search, orchestration, APIs, integrations, identity, guardrails, observability and cloud infrastructure. Produce diagrams, design decisions, cost estimates and deployment patterns.
* **PoCs, deployment and productionization:**
  Build or guide working PoCs and pilots; establish acceptance criteria; support integration, CI/CD, evaluation, performance testing, security reviews and production rollout. Troubleshoot issues and support operational readiness, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* **Managed-services advisory:**
  Assess post-go-live support needs and recommend appropriate managed-services packages: monitoring, incident response, model/prompt evaluation, cost optimization, data and knowledge-base refresh, security controls, SLA/SLO reporting and continuous improvement. Define scope, responsibilities, service levels and handover needs with delivery teams.
* **Collaboration and governance:**
  Work across OEM partners, engineering and customer teams; apply responsible-AI, privacy, data residency, governance and compliance considerations. Communicate trade-offs clearly to both business executives and technical teams.

**Required experience and skills**

* **Experience:**
  5–10 years in solution architecture, cloud/data engineering, AI/ML engineering or technical consulting, including meaningful customer-facing presales and hands-on implementation experience.
* **AI engineering:**
  Practical experience delivering at least one production AI/GenAI solution; knowledge of LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG, agent workflows, evaluation, hallucination mitigation and prompt engineering.
* **Cloud and platforms:**
  Working experience with AWS and its AI/data services; familiarity with Amazon Bedrock and at least one major model ecosystem such as Anthropic Claude or OpenAI. Equivalent Azure/GCP experience is useful.
* **Engineering and integration:**
  Strong understanding of Python, REST APIs, application integration, databases, vector stores, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and production monitoring.
* **Security and economics:**
  Ability to design IAM, encryption, secrets management, network controls, data protection and human oversight; estimate infrastructure/model usage costs and explain architectural trade-offs.
* **Communication:**
  Confidence facilitating workshops, whiteboarding solutions, writing technical proposals and presenting recommendations to CIO/CTO stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications**

* **Additional experience:**
  AWS Solutions Architect or relevant cloud/AI certification; experience with agent orchestration frameworks, MLOps/LLMOps, regulated-industry architectures, enterprise knowledge assistants, coding assistants or intelligent process automation.
* **Commercial acumen:**
  Experience translating technical solutions into delivery plans, effort estimates, recurring support offerings and measurable customer outcomes.

**Expected deliverables**

* **Discovery:**
  Workshop agenda, current-state assessment, prioritized use-case backlog and measurable success criteria.
* **Solution design:**
  Reference/target architecture, integration and security design, sizing, cost estimate, risks and implementation roadmap.
* **Execution:**
  PoC/demo, deployment plan, test and evaluation results, production handover documents.
* **Operations:**
  Managed-services recommendation, operating model, monitoring plan, SLA/SLO inputs and improvement backlog.

**How success will be measured**

* Quality and conversion of technically qualified opportunities and discovery workshops.
* Clarity, feasibility and accuracy of proposed architectures, effort estimates and solution costs.
* PoC-to-production progression, deployment quality and customer acceptance.
* Security, reliability, operational readiness and customer satisfaction after go-live.
* Practical managed-services attach opportunities and smooth transition to support teams.

**Candidate profile**

We value an architect who can engage a business leader in the morning, whiteboard an enterprise AI design with the technology team, and work with engineers to make the solution run reliably in production. This is not a presentation-only presales role or a purely back-end development role.

Please share your CV at puja.bisht@appsquadz.com

We are looking for an experienced **ServiceNow SOMT Solution Architect** with 8+ years of IT experience and strong expertise in Telecom Service Management. The ideal candidate should have experience designing telecom/fiber Quote-to-Order, Order-to-Fulfillment, Provisioning, Billing, and MACD processes, along with practical knowledge of ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM).

The candidate should be capable of designing scalable solution architectures, managing enterprise integrations, engaging with stakeholders, and providing solutioning and presales support.

* Define New Order and MACD (Move, Add, Change, Disconnect) lifecycle processes.

* Design reusable and scalable telecom fulfillment patterns.

**2. ServiceNow SPM Experience**

* Strong understanding of ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and its alignment with SOMT.

* Work with Project Charters, Projects, Tasks, Dependencies, Milestones, Planned vs. Actual Dates, and Project Status Tracking.

9495d403.description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models:
  
  

* a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
* a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design**

* Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
* Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
* Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
* Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
* Design the Security & Observability Framework

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
* Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
* Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
* Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

**Stakeholder & Delivery**

* Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
* Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
* Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
* Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong solution architecture experience on AWS: API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, IAM and KMS
* Configuration management using AppConfig or DynamoDB; observability with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry/ADOT or X-Ray; CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code design.
* Proven design of API gateways or enterprise integration layers for high-volume transactional systems
* Hands-on with Node.js/TypeScript or Java/Spring Boot microservices
* Strong grasp of resilience patterns, idempotency and event-driven design
* OpenAPI-first design and contract testing practices
* Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership

**Good-to-Have**

* Exposure to email service provider platforms; retail transactional email, ESB/middleware platforms
* Fastify; Akamai WAF; Terraform or AWS CDK; OpenSearch/ELK-based operational search.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience with solution architecture and hands-on technical leadership.
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent
* AWS architecture certification is desirable.

**About Us**
At Zensar, we’re
*“experience-led everything”*
. We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
*Together, we shape experiences for better futures*
. Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is
*ONE with Client*
- a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work:
*One Zensar, Nurturing, Empowering, and Client Focus*
.
  
  
Part of the $4.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000+ innovators across 30+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well-being is prioritized. **Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

  

The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover.
* Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments.
* Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes.
* Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream.
* Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps
* Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment.
* Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities.
* Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance.
* Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery.
* Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover.
* Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints.
* Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem.
* Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities.
* Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early.
* Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills.
* Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF
* AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance.
* Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria.
* AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness.
* Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early.
* Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements.
* Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover.

**Services at AVEVA**

Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

**India Benefits include:**

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

**Hybrid working**

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**Hiring process**

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

**About AVEVA**

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

c65663f5.description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.

* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).

* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.

fc337e96.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (E3)
fc337e96.description:
**About Caylent**
Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production.
  
  
Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first.
  
  
We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien!
  
  
**********About the Role**********
We are seeking a
**Senior Cloud Engineer (E3)**
to join our growing
**Managed Service Provider (MSP)**
team. This role is ideal for a hands-on technical leader who can design, build, and operate complex cloud solutions while mentoring engineers and partnering closely with CloudOps, DevOps, security teams, and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and implementation of advanced cloud-native solutions for client workloads
* Evaluate and select tools, libraries, and AWS services aligned to scalability, security, and cost efficiency
* Apply structured frameworks to assess problems, risks, and architectural trade-offs
* Build and enhance cloud-native architectures including serverless, IoT backends, and highly automated delivery pipelines
* Enforce engineering standards, SDLC best practices, and architectural consistency
* Move fluidly between high-level architectural thinking and hands-on implementation
* Partner with CloudOps to design support models, response procedures, and operational handoffs
* Participate in cross-functional delivery teams to ensure successful client outcomes
* Mentor engineers, define stories and task-level work, and provide technical guidance
* Design and implement highly reliable, secure, and cost-optimized AWS architectures
* Build and maintain observability platforms using AWS-native tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Config) and partner solutions (Datadog, Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry)
* Collaborate with 24x7 operations teams to define actionable metrics, logs, and alerts Establish runbooks and automation aligned to monitoring thresholds and incident response
* Drive root cause analysis, noise reduction, and long-term reliability improvements
* Partner with DevOps and security teams to embed resilience, security, and cost optimization into all solutions
* Coach, mentor, and share knowledge with engineers across experience levels
* Perform code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and pair program when needed
* Contribute to internal IP, tooling, and open-source initiatives
* Participate in Agile delivery models and execution planning
* Engage with clients through presentations, architectural discussions, and technical decision-making
* Build relationships with vendors and AWS partners
* Stay current with AWS best practices and emerging cloud technologies

**Requirements**
**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field with strong 4+ years of IT experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
* 2+ years of programming experience in Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Java, or C#
* 2+ years of strong experience in Kubernetes or Continuous Integration and Deliver (CI/CD) experience.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices
* Experience working within Agile or similar delivery methodologies
* Willingness to work in graveyard shift.
* AWS Associate or Professional certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, SysOps, Developer)
* Experience designing scalable, automated cloud infrastructure
* Strong experience with AWS Lambda and serverless architectures
* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise or MSP environments
* Experience in client-facing or consulting roles
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to varied audiences
* Effective time and self-management with the ability to prioritize, adapt, and meet deadlines
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to analyze issues and deliver practical solutions
* Collaborative team player who builds productive relationships with clients and stakeholders

Signs you may be a great fit
  
  

* Impact: Play a pivotal role in shaping a rapidly growing venture studio.
* Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment that values creativity and ownership.
* Growth: Access professional development opportunities and mentorship.
* Benefits: Competitive salary, health/wellness packages, and flexible work options.

As a Sr. Partner Solutions Architect, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to partners and their customers, helping them solve complex business challenges by designing scalable, secure, and resilient solutions on AWS. You will combine deep technical expertise with strong relationship-building skills to influence architectural decisions, shape partners' technical strategies, and drive broad adoption of AWS services. You will bring visible and measurable impact to partner growth ambitions, helping them dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.

* Collaborate cross-functionally with Account SAs, Sales, TAMs, BD, and service teams to accelerate customer adoption of partner solutions.

* Grow the SA organization by hiring, coaching, and mentoring talent, raising the bar across the team.

As a Strategic Member Of The AWS India Partner Solutions Architects Team, You Will Act As a Trusted Advisor To Our Managed Systems Integrators. This Includes
  
  

* Provide the architectural guidance and recommendations necessary to promote successful partner engagements in India.

* Capture and share best-practice knowledge with our broader Solution Architecture community
* Share customer feedback to internal product management and engineering teams to help drive the future of AWS

* 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
