40bacc24.title: Devops Architect
40bacc24.description:
**Job Summary**  

**Location:** Bangalore, KA, IN

**Company:** Alstom

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your DevOps and CI/CD expertise in a new cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative and innovative teammates.

Youll play a key role in designing and optimizing scalable DevOps architectures and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring seamless integration and delivery of software applications. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (development, QA, operations), evaluate and recommend tools and technologies, and lead the implementation of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, and much more.

Youll specifically take care of fostering a culture of collaboration and efficiency across teams, but also ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based infrastructures.

Well look to you for:

* Contribute to the elaboration of product/system specification architecture, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
* Define the software requirements specifications
  + Define the functional requirements, operational requirements, interfaces requirements and the requirements linked to performance, safety, cybersecurity, RAM constraints
  + Ensure that all the requirements can be verified (testability, )
  + Ensure the traceability of the software requirements through the development cycle
* Define the software architecture
  + Elaborate the functional and structural breakdown into software components
  + Allocate the requirements to the software components
  + Define the interfaces between the software components
  + Define the dynamical behavior of the software
  + Validate the feasibility of the solution: model simulation, mock-up
* Take main technical choices for software development
  + Select development tools, methodology (ex: UML, ), programming languages, coding strategy and coding rules, strictly following internal process/methods tools recommendations
  + Contribute to the selection of the execution environment (processor, operating system, middleware, basic software), together with the product architect, system engineering manager and hardware architect
* Designing and implementing DevOps strategies: This includes creating scalable frameworks (GitLab CI/CD components), integrating tools (compilation, SCA, SATS, etc) and processes, and aligning DevOps practices with business objectives.

* Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines: Automating the build with powershell, python; automatic deployment processes to enable rapid and reliable software releases.   
     
  Managing cloud-based infrastructure: Overseeing the deployment and management of cloud infrastructure using tools like Terraform and Kubernetes.

* Collaborating with other teams: Working with development, operations, and security teams to ensure smooth and secure software delivery.   
     
  Monitoring and optimizing system performance: Ensuring the system is running efficiently, is scalable, and is secure.

* Guiding and mentoring junior engineers: Helping to foster a culture of continuous improvement.   
  Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Defining and managing infrastructure using code to bring agility and consistency.

* Ensuring security: Implementing security measures, identity management, and compliance controls.

* Arbitrate and validate major software design choices
* Mentor developers and provide technical leadership within the team
* Perform software/software integration, together with the software designers
* Perform hardware/software integration, together with the hardware architect
* Specify, design, prepare and perform tests and verifications of his/her deliverables
* Sustain the software
* Keep informed of the evolution of technologies through techno watch
* Contribute to standardization by reusing existing solutions or by defining reusable solutions, including COTS\*
* Apply and ensure application of processes and standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement (RoE: Return of Experience, process)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement **CI/CD pipelines** using **GitLab** for automated build, test, and deployment.
* Architect and manage **containerized environments** using **Docker** and **Kubernetes**.
* Implement **GitOps workflows** using **ArgoCD** for continuous delivery.
* Develop and maintain **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** using **Terraform** and **Ansible**.
* Set up **monitoring and observability** solutions using **Prometheus** and **Grafana**.
* Ensure high availability, scalability, and security of cloud-native applications.
* Collaborate with development, QA, and operations teams to streamline delivery processes.
* Drive best practices for DevOps, automation, and cloud infrastructure.

  
  
**All about you**  

We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, weve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor's or Masters degree in Engineering or computer Science, Software Engineering, ( Engineering Dgree)
* 10+ years of experience in software development and architecture, with a strong focus on DevOps and CI/CD practices

5b2acb4f.title: Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor
5b2acb4f.description:
**Req ID:**
392818
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Client Architect Systems Integration Sr. Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Client Architect – Managed Services**
Senior client-facing architecture role | Global managed services environment
  
  
Role type: Full-time | Client engagement: Multi-year managed services | Reporting: Client CTO / account technology leadership
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
NTT DATA is a global technology services organisation delivering complex managed services for major enterprises. We are strengthening the architecture capability supporting a multi-hundred-million-euro global managed services agreement, with the role connected into our wider global architecture, engineering, operations and technology communities.
  
  
You will act as a senior technical advisor and Technical Design Authority for an assigned area, translating business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving initiatives into practical technology solutions. The role combines technology roadmap ownership, architecture governance, design assurance and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on solutions that work sustainably in steady-state ("Day 2") operations.
  
  
This is a technical leadership role within a long-term client partnership. You will lead through influence, shape decisions in joint architecture forums and bring together the right specialists across the organisation. Business as Usual (BAU) support, implementation and project management remain with the appropriate delivery teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Act as the ongoing Technical Design Authority for your assigned area, maintaining architectural integrity as the managed environment evolves.
* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business stakeholders, understanding business requirements, commercial objectives and cost-saving priorities and translating them into viable technology solutions.
* Maintain current-state and target-state architecture, technology roadmaps, lifecycle plans and visibility of technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence risk.
* Review and assure High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and material changes for security, resilience, scalability, performance, operability, lifecycle and alignment with agreed standards.
* Drive simplification and standardisation through reusable patterns, reference architectures, approved technology choices and the reduction of variants and exceptions that increase support complexity and managed service cost.
* Use service data, monitoring, capacity, performance and incident trends to identify architecture-led improvements that increase resilience, improve service quality and reduce recurring operational workload.
* Set an ambitious automation agenda with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), engineering and operations teams, using Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations (AIOps) and advanced automation to dramatically reduce manual effort and remove avoidable manual triage, troubleshooting, event correlation and repeatable incident resolution.
* Shape new projects, demands and transformation initiatives with the client through architecture forums, ensuring dependencies, ownership, architectural decisions, supportability and the transition into Day 2 operations are designed from the outset.
* Consider the long-term economics of architecture decisions, including infrastructure rightsizing, licence utilisation, platform rationalisation, support complexity, automation potential and cost-to-serve.
* Represent your area in architecture and governance forums, document significant decisions and ensure cross-domain risks and dependencies are surfaced early and resolved through the appropriate technical leadership.
* Coach and guide technical teams while remaining distinct from routine third- and fourth-line operational support and hands-on implementation.

**What We're Looking For**

* Significant experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure, cloud, network, platform or application operations within complex managed services, outsourcing or large enterprise environments.
* Proven experience as a Client Architect, Technical Design Authority, Enterprise Architect, Solution Architect or equivalent senior technical authority for a substantial service estate.
* Deep expertise in at least one relevant technology or service area, combined with sufficient breadth to understand dependencies across infrastructure, networks, security, applications, platforms and operations.
* Strong experience creating and assuring architecture documentation, roadmaps, HLDs, LLDs, standards, reference patterns and technical decision records.
* Strong understanding of Day 2 service concerns including monitoring and observability, capacity, availability, performance, resilience, disaster recovery, patching and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrable experience using automation, observability and AIOps to improve operational outcomes, reduce manual intervention and improve the speed and quality of detection, diagnosis and resolution.
* Strong commercial awareness and an understanding of how architecture decisions influence operational effort, licensing, technical debt, transformation priorities and long-term service cost.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to connect business objectives and commercial priorities with technical choices and explain trade-offs clearly to senior client leaders and technical teams.
* Relevant professional-level architecture and technology certifications aligned to your area of expertise are expected, but practical experience, sound judgement and the ability to build trust are more important than certification alone.

**Where you could fit**
We are recruiting several senior Client Architects across major technology domains, including infrastructure and cloud platforms, networks and connectivity, data platforms and middleware, enterprise applications and application platforms, SAP, resilience and data protection, and observability, automation and AIOps. Each role combines deep expertise in a primary domain with enough breadth to understand dependencies across the end-to-end managed service and collaborate effectively with specialists in other towers.
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Build trusted relationships with client technology and business leaders, understand their business requirements, commercial goals and cost-saving priorities, and translate them into credible technology solutions and roadmaps.
* Drive technology refresh and transformation by maintaining clear roadmaps, identifying lifecycle risks and technical debt early, and proposing practical plans to address them.
* Lead simplification and standardisation across the technology estate, reducing unnecessary variants, exceptions, support complexity and the operational cost of the managed service.
* Improve service stability and operational performance through architecture-led change, with measurable reductions in recurring incidents and tickets, less manual intervention and faster diagnosis and resolution.
* Shape new projects and demands jointly with the client through architecture forums, ensuring architectural decisions, dependencies, ownership, supportability and transition into Business as Usual (BAU) service are designed in from the outset.

**Why this role**
You will combine the depth of a major client environment with the reach of a large global technology organisation. The role gives you space to build trusted relationships over time, shape significant technology decisions and connect across NTT DATA architecture, engineering, operations and partner communities. You will help make large managed services agreements work globally while building a network and experience that extends well beyond a single account.
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
***NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.***
***This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you'd like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here. For Pay Transparency information, please click here.***

* Works closely with software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to define requirements and deliver robust solutions.
* Designs and Implement LLM-driven agent services for design, code generation, documentation, test creation and observability on AWS
* Develops orchestration and communication layers between agents using frameworks like A2A SDK, LangGraph, or Auto Gen
* Integrates AI agents with toolchains such as Jira, Bitbucket, Github, Terraform and monitoring platforms
* Collaborates on system design, SDK development and data pipelines supporting agent intelligence
* Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and team members.
* Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.
* Drives decisions that influence the product design, application functionality, and technical operations and processes

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
* Experience in Software engineering using AI Technologies
* Strong hands-on skills in Python, Pydantic, FastAPI, LangGraph, and Vector Databases for building RAG based AI agent solutions integrating with multi-agent orchestration frameworks and deploying end-to-end pipelines on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, Terraform)
* Experience with LLMs integration, prompt/context engineering, AI Agent frameworks like Langchain/LangGraph, Autogen, MCPs, A2A.
* Solid understanding of CI/CD, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and APIs
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.
* Ability to tackle design and functionality problems independently with little to no oversight

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience with Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, automated deployment, and ML pipelines.

1cb84409.title: Program Manager
1cb84409.description:
WHO WE ARE

We are an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization focused on helping clients

move from fragmented processes and systems to integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven

operations.

Our approach to ERP implementation rests on two key tracks:

1. Industry Best Practices & ERP Transformation

We evaluate a client's existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and

enable these through leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not

simply to implement software, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models

that reflect proven industry practice.

2. Sustained Organizational Change

ERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management.

We work with clients to embed new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day habits of

their workforce - ensuring the solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only a

technology deployment.

OUR CLIENT SEGMENT

The role will support clients across three broad segments:

▪ Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.

▪ Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.

Page 2 of 2

▪ Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the

₹200–800 crore range.

OUR FOCUS AREAS

We maintain a strong focus on Compliance and Corporate Governance, supported by a Centre of

Excellence comprising experienced functional and domain professionals.

Our clients typically come from non-ERP or fragmented-system environments, where business

processes are managed through standalone applications or disconnected modular systems across

departments. This calls for an articulate leader who can effectively drive high-level conversations across

diverse steering committees and technical groups — managing governance, schedule and scope with an

80% onsite/onshore presence.

ROLE, SCOPE & RESPONSIBILITIES

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead large-scale

enterprise transformation programs. The ideal candidate will bring a stable career history (a maximum

of 1–2 employers) and a proven track record of driving complex software, ERP and CRM

implementations.

As our projects and client relationships typically span 10–15 years, the most important hiring mandate is

stability: candidates should have at least 8–10 years of single, continuous tenure with a Top Tier

company.

▪ Drive Executive Conversations: Lead, influence and drive strategic conversations with C-suite

executives, business heads and partners to secure buy-in and align expectations.

▪ Lead Enterprise Transformations: Direct complex implementations across Software/ERP platforms

(Microsoft, SAP), including surround technologies and other custom solutions.

▪ Facilitate Governance & Alignment: Own the project schedule, scope and governance framework —

chairing steering committee meetings and cross-functional workshops.

▪ Manage RAID & Risks: Proactively identify, articulate and mitigate program risks, assumptions,

issues and dependencies (RAID) during stakeholder reviews.

▪ Onshore Leadership: Operate effectively in an onsite/onshore model (80% presence), driving daily

face-to-face collaboration with client teams.

IDEAL CANDIDATE

▪ Experience: 10+ years of core project and program management experience.

▪ Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills, with the ability to drive complex

conversations between business users and technical teams.

▪ Professional Stability: A stable, progressive career track record — preferably 1–3 organisations, with

at least 80% of total tenure spent at a single organisation.

▪ Target Background: Proven delivery experience within tier-1 tech integrators and consulting firms,

such as IBM, Wipro, TCS, CTS, Infosys, HCL, Capgemini, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, etc.

Page 3 of 2

▪ Methodologies: Expert knowledge of program governance, budgeting and structured deployment

frameworks.

OUT OF SCOPE — WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

Candidates whose primary experience lies in the following areas will not be considered:

▪ Service delivery management or support-operations projects.

▪ Ticket management, SLA tracking, or ITSM frameworks.

▪ Pure resourcing / team management.

▪ Core infrastructure, networking, or technical migration projects (DWH / Cloud / Infra).

▪ Candidates not comfortable with the travel required for client engagements.

Pay: ₹2,500,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

c001c8f4.title: Senior Technical Account Manager
c001c8f4.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and technical advisor. You will understand customer business requirements, translate them into integrated technology and process solutions, and guide customers through cloud adoption and transformation.

You will provide leadership across the solution lifecycle, coordinate cross-functional teams, and help customers deploy and optimize Oracle Cloud workloads. This role combines technical depth, customer relationship management, and program delivery expertise to drive successful customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to understand business goals, technical requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, then translate them into practical solution designs.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments and develop roadmaps for transitioning, implementing, and optimizing customer solutions.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead end-to-end delivery across requirements intake, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to Oracle Cloud, support cloud-adoption models, and recommend actions to overcome delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third-party partners.
* Communicate technical concepts, solution options, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Support strategic planning, program direction, customer satisfaction, and successful delivery of IT solutions within agreed timelines and budgets.

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Mandatory**

* 8 years of experience in a customer-facing, consultative, or technology-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
  + Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 4 years of relevant experience.
  + Master’s degree in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field plus 2 years of relevant experience.
  + Doctorate in Business, Computer Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 3 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Strong understanding of Oracle products, including Fusion applications, OCI, and on-premises offerings.
* Ability to translate business requirements into system, application, process, and solution designs.
* Experience leading business analysis, business-process design, and software development lifecycle activities.
* Demonstrated ability to assess technology assumptions, identify systems, subsystems, and interfaces, and evaluate solution alternatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to consider broader cross-module impacts.
* Proven customer service and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across business and IT teams in a collaborative, remote environment.
* Ability to travel to customer locations and internal sessions up to 25%.

**Good-to-Have**

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Relevant cloud certifications.
* One full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience with IT service management.
* Experience with account management.
* Experience working with operating budgets or project financials.
* Familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on-premises services.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have experience working directly with customers to understand their business needs and translate them into technology solutions?
* Have I supported or led cloud adoption, implementation, or migration activities involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I guide stakeholders through requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, and go-live activities?
* Am I comfortable collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to resolve blockers and keep a program on track?
* Can I clearly explain technical options, risks, and recommendations to customer stakeholders at different levels?

Sam’s Club eCommerce is a team of engineers passionate about taking care of our members and associates. You will build Discovery and Execution plans that include coordination of numerous cross-functional teams
  
  
You will lead multiple teams of engineers to deliver cross-functional initiatives

You will communicate to team members, peers and leadership in a way that supports effective program execution

Belonging

74344879.title: Sr Tech Infra Program Manager, DCPD
74344879.description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
  
  
Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ? Have you managed complex infrastructure projects ?
  
  
If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Hyderabad, Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on-time and at-cost.
  
  
You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering managing a team with strong urge to learn will be essential.
  
  
Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Senior Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in Hyderabad, Telangana India. The Sr TIPM manages delivery of ~5 projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity. The Sr TIPM is able to guide and develop partner teams to accomplish the regions goal.
  
  
The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region-wide knowledge and monitoring of in-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
  
  
A successful TPM Manager must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. ****deep AI understanding, system-level thinking, and executive communication skills****

3778f9e1.title: Solution Engineer - GCC (FSI)
3778f9e1.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?

27958ddb.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
27958ddb.description:
**Principal Solution Engineer (Presales)**

Sales and Revenue, Solutions Engineering | Gurgaon (Onsite) | US business hours (Eastern/Central overlap) | Periodic US travel

**About Spyne**

Spyne is building the AI operating system for automotive retail. We started with visual merchandising, expanded into conversational AI, and are now putting AI agents across the dealership so dealers move inventory faster, respond to buyers instantly and run more of their operation with AI. Founded by operators from Amazon, Cox and OYO, Spyne has grown 30x in under 3 years and powers 1,500+ dealerships across the US. We’re backed by Accel, Vertex Ventures and Storm Ventures.

What we’re building:

* **Studio AI (Visual Agents):**
  turns a smartphone capture into a complete, publish-ready listing, so cars reach the website faster.
* **Vini AI (Conversational Agents):**
  answers every call, chat and text across sales and service, and writes outcomes back into the dealer’s DMS and CRM. We’re building a family of agents for recall, receptionist, reputation, acquisition, sales and service, built for dealers to try and turn on themselves.
* **AI Contact Service:**
  Vini at the core with a human BDC team around it, delivering the outcomes dealers expect from an in-house BDC.
* **DealerOS:**
  the layer that brings it all together. It sits above the dealer’s existing software (DMS, CRM, inventory, website, service) and runs agents across the vehicle journey, from sourcing to sale to service.

See DealerOS in action: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gjehUZhJi3k

**Role Overview**

The Principal Solution Engineer owns the technical win on Spyne’s largest US dealer-group and enterprise opportunities, from initial discovery through to a structured handover into Onboarding. The role reports to the Head of Sales and partners closely with Account Executives, Product, Engineering and Customer Success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Discovery:**
  Lead structured discovery with dealer principals, GMs, BDC and internet managers, and dealer-group IT. Map the vehicle lifecycle from acquisition to service, and quantify pain in dealer terms such as time-to-line, lead response time, missed after-hours leads and aged inventory.
* **Demonstration:**
  Deliver tailored demos using the prospect’s own VINs and lead scenarios. Present Studio AI and Vini AI as a single inventory-to-sale solution for executive, operator and IT audiences.
* **Scoping:**
  Define rooftops, modules, integrations and volumes. Design pilots with written success criteria, owners and fixed end dates. Validate any non-standard request with Product and Engineering before it is committed.
* **Solution Documentation:**
  Author the solution design for each enterprise deal and own the technical sections of RFPs and security questionnaires. Secure customer sign-off before contract.
* **Handover:**
  Run a formal internal handover to Onboarding, join customer kickoff, and remain the point of contact for technical escalations through go-live.
* **Team Enablement:**
  Coach AEs and junior SEs, maintain demo environments, discovery frameworks and the pilot playbook, and support the growth of the SE function.

**Measures of Success**

Performance is assessed on technical win rate, pilot-to-paid conversion, enterprise sales cycle length and handover quality. Targets are agreed with the CRO within the first 30 days, and the role is expected to run the full deal cycle independently by day 90.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-10+ years in B2B SaaS, including 6+ years in presales or solution engineering on enterprise, multi-stakeholder deals
* Track record as technical lead on six-figure ARR deals with US customers
* Strong understanding of integrations, including APIs, webhooks, data feeds and SSO
* Executive presence and excellent written English
* Ability to work US hours and travel to the US

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience selling AI products, startup experience, familiarity with TCPA, CAN-SPAM and SOC 2, or a background in automotive retail.

**What We Offer**

* A principal-level role shaping how Spyne sells to the largest US dealer groups and OEMs
* Direct access to the Head of Sales
* The opportunity to build and lead the Solutions Engineering function as it scales
* Competitive fixed pay plus a variable component tied to technical-win and ARR targets

c98b9c41.title: Solutions Specialist, MCU
c98b9c41.description:
**About Us**
Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.
  
  
Our software and development tools help build products for cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries worldwide. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.
  
  
Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.
  
  
We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Qt for MCUs is on a mission to bring Qt’s industry-leading UI framework to the most resource-constrained microcontrollers on the market — enabling rich, responsive user experiences on devices where every byte of Flash and every millisecond of CPU time matters. Our team works directly with the world’s leading silicon vendors and embedded product companies to make that vision a reality.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer — MCU, you are the technical heart of our customer engagements. You will port Qt for MCUs to new silicon platforms, design display adaptation layers, solve complex hardware-software integration challenges, and serve as the go-to subject matter expert for MCU-related opportunities across sales, pre-sales, and product engineering.
  
  
This role is located in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Port Qt for MCUs to new microcontroller platforms — from BSP bring-up and HAL integration through to display adaptation, framebuffer management, and validated performance on target hardware
* Design and optimise display and graphics pipelines for memory-constrained MCUs, including DMA-driven transfers, partial rendering, and asset optimisation using the Qt for MCUs toolchain
* Act as the primary technical SME for customer engagements, proof-of-concept projects, and evaluations — delivering workshops, demos, and training to engineering teams worldwide
* Debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, BSP, and UI stack layers using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes; provide root-cause analysis and drive resolution with product engineering
* Author application notes, porting guides, and best-practice documentation; support the sales team with technical proposals and RFP responses for Qt for MCUs solutions
* Collaborate closely with silicon vendors (Infineon, Renesas, NXP, STMicroelectronics) and internal engineering teams to bridge cutting-edge Qt technology with real-world MCU constraints

**What You Bring To The Table**

* 5–8 years of hands-on embedded software engineering experience with a strong focus on microcontroller-based products and ARM Cortex-M class devices (STM32, NXP i.MX RT, Renesas RA/RH)
* Proven experience porting or adapting embedded software stacks in bare-metal and RTOS environments (FreeRTOS and/or Zephyr), with a solid grasp of MCU memory architecture
* Hands-on experience with TFT/LCD display integration: framebuffer management, pixel format handling, display controller configuration, and serial protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, DMA)
* Experience with at least one embedded GUI framework — Qt for MCUs, LVGL, Embedded Wizard, or STemWin — and proficiency in C and C++ with CMake-based build systems
* Strong communication skills in English; ability to translate deep technical knowledge into clear guidance for both engineering and commercial audiences

**Bonus Points For…**

* Experience with additional MCU families (ESP32/Espressif, PIC/Microchip) or silicon vendor BSP ecosystems such as STM32CubeIDE, MCUXpresso, e2studio, or ModusToolbox
* Prior Solutions Engineering, Field Application Engineering, or other customer-facing technical role experience
* Familiarity with Qt Widgets or Qt Quick/QML on higher-powered targets, and/or contributions to open-source embedded or GUI projects

**Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.**
We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.
  
  

* Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
* Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
* Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
* Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
* Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

**Bring Your Whole Self**
The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.
  
  
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.
  
  
**We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.**

**About Business Line/Function**
Within the CIB ITO Industrial Transformation division, our mission is to build the industrial-grade foundation that will make this vision a reality. We are not just building tools; we are building autonomous intelligence that will define the future of Corporate & Institutional Banking.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
As the financial landscape undergoes a paradigm shift, BNP Paribas is positioning itself at the forefront of the next technological revolution. We are embarking on a massive strategic journey to accelerate the deployment of AI Agents across our global operations, with a clear and ambitious vision: to integrate advanced agentic workflows into the core of our business by 2030.
  
  
Within the CIB ITO Industrial Transformation division, our mission is to build the industrial-grade foundation that will make this vision a reality. We are not just building tools; we are building autonomous intelligence that will define the future of Corporate & Institutional Banking.
  
  
As an Agentic Solutions Engineer within the AI Platform team, your mission is to act as a bridge between cutting-edge AI capabilities and business implementation. You will lead the "Agentic Bootstrap" initiative, designed to empower project teams (including Flagship projects) to structure their requirements, define technical solutions, and successfully adopt our agentic frameworks.
  
  
Your goal is to accelerate the transition from conceptual AI ideas to robust, scalable, and production-ready agentic workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Framework Evangelism: Communicate the capabilities, best practices, and roadmap of the Agentic Framework to diverse stakeholders across the CIB.
* Solution Guidance: Provide hands-on technical guidance and support to project teams during the implementation phase, ensuring alignment with AI Platform standards.
* Continuous Evolution: Actively contribute to the evolution of the internal framework by gathering feedback from the field and implementing new features or optimizations.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Fact MCP, STT
* Arize, Dynatrace

* Adaptability: Willingness to explore uncharted territories and solve unprecedented problems.

We are looking for a unique profile that refuses to choose between "hard" and "soft" skills. To succeed in this role, you must possess a rare equilibrium: the technical depth required to architect the future of AI, combined with the interpersonal agility to navigate a complex, rapidly transforming environment.
  
  
If you are a tech enthusiast who thrives on communication, possesses the empathy to guide others through change, and has the vision to build the foundations of 2030, we want to meet you.

**Skills Referential**

BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. **Level**
: Lead Business Transformation Architect
  
  
As a Lead Business Transformation Architect/ Specialist Master at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels.

We are looking for a seasoned Five9 CCaaS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-grade cloud contact center solutions built on the Five9 Intelligent CX Platform. This is a senior technical role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, AI-driven automation, and client advisory — equal parts strategist and builder.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on Five9 expertise, a strong grasp of modern CCaaS architecture patterns, and the communication fluency to translate complex technical decisions into clear business value for clients and stakeholders.
  
  

* Solution Design & Architecture: Lead end-to-end CCaaS solution design — from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and rollout. Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and high-performing Five9 architectures that align with client goals and industry best practices.

Implement identity and authentication frameworks including SSO, SAML, and OAuth.
* AI & Automation Strategy: Drive the adoption of Five9's Genius AI capabilities — including Intelligent Voice Assistants, AI-powered Agent Assist, the AI Summary Node, Knowledge Node (RAG-based), and the AI Trust & Governance framework. Provide architectural guidance on deploying responsible, hallucination-aware AI within the contact center environment. 9 10 Stay ahead of Five9's evolving Agentic CX roadmap and help clients position for next-generation capabilities.
* Performance Optimization & Reporting: Configure dashboards, real-time reporting, and supervisor tools to monitor and continuously optimize contact center operations. Guide clients on best practices for scalability, performance, reliability, and security.

* Collaboration, Scoping & Delivery: Partner with project managers for accurate effort estimation, scoping, risk management, and on-time delivery. Lead and mentor engineers, consultants, and junior delivery team members to elevate technical capability and solution quality across the team.
* Client Engagement & Presentations: Deliver compelling client-facing presentations, solution demonstrations, and value propositions. Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.

Our Sales & Service team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients’ brand values for measurable business growth. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients’ marketing and engagement operations into modern, data-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i.e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis.

* Advanced understanding of CCaaS architecture patterns, enterprise scalability design, and cloud contact center infrastructure
* Solid understanding of core contact center operations: ACD, IVR, CTI, and CRM integration workflows

* Familiarity with AI/ML applications in CX — chatbots, virtual agents, predictive analytics, agent assist, and GenAI-driven capabilities
* Awareness of compliance and security frameworks relevant to CCaaS: PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR
* Bonus: Server-side development experience in Node.js, Java, PHP, or .NET
* Excellent communication and documentation skills with the ability to present confidently to executive and technical audiences

* Proven experience designing enterprise-grade M365 solutions

* Excellent architectural thinking beyond platform-specific constraints
* Experience designing integrated solutions across multiple systems
* Strong understanding of cloud-native and modern application architectures

**Core Skills:**

* Dataverse: Data modeling, APIs, security, and integration with Power Platform and custom apps
* Integration Architecture: REST & SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, secure enterprise integrations

**Desirable Skills:**

* Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
* AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
* Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
* Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
* PCF Controls: Custom PowerApps Component Framework development using React and TypeScript

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* Strong experience across Microsoft SharePoint (on‑premises and online), with the ability to modernize and extend solutions beyond platform constraints
* Proven hands-on expertise with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps, and Power Automate for building modern, extensible business solutions
* Strong front-end development skills using TypeScript, React, Angular, and Fluent UI, with an emphasis on scalable and reusable components
* Solid experience with PowerShell and PnP for automation, provisioning, and enterprise governance
* Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills, with the ability to operate as a solution architect and trusted advisor

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**About EY**
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we’ll make our ambition to be the best employer by 2020 a reality.
  
  
**If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.**
**Join us in building a better working world.**
**Apply now**
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

46541c1a.title: Consultant, FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization
46541c1a.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The GTDA FinOps Strategy, Governance & Value Realization team sits at the intersection of technology, business, and finance. The team partners across Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, Finance, and business leadership to improve cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization accountability, and investment value realization. Its mission is to build trusted reporting, governance standards, and decision-ready insights that help TransUnion manage cloud and infrastructure spend more effectively while enabling sustainable technology growth

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

We are looking for a data-driven, analytically minded Consultant to join TransUnion’s Enterprise Cloud Economics / FinOps team. This role sits at the **intersection of technology, business, and finance** , helping TransUnion improve how it understands, governs, and optimizes cloud, AI, and infrastructure spend.

In this role, you will transform raw cost, usage, and capacity data into transparent dashboards, actionable insights, and measurable business value. You will partner closely with Technology Strategy & Governance, Cloud Engineering, Finance, Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, and business stakeholders to support FinOps governance, cost transparency, capacity planning, optimization tracking, and executive reporting.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role for someone who enjoys connecting technical data with financial discipline and business decision-making in a large-scale enterprise technology environment.

* Build and maintain cloud, AI, and infrastructure cost dashboards for leadership, engineering, finance, and business stakeholders.
* Analyze cloud spend, infrastructure usage, capacity trends, cost variances, and optimization opportunities.
* Translate technical cost and capacity data into business and financial insights that support executive decision-making.
* Produce monthly reporting inputs, executive scorecards, and governance materials for cloud and AI economics.
* Develop capacity utilization reporting across cloud compute, storage, database, network, server, VMware, middleware, and related infrastructure domains.
* Consolidate demand signals from engineering and business teams into a forward-looking view of capacity requirements.
* Support performance and capacity analysis by working with application and platform owners on right-sizing, configuration, query/index optimization, and infrastructure improvement opportunities.
* Track cloud commitments, reservations, savings plans, committed-use discounts, GPU utilization, and other capacity or consumption-based economics.
* Manage the optimization pipeline from opportunity intake through prioritization, implementation, and Finance-validated value realization.
* Identify spend accountability gaps and help route ownership to the appropriate engineering, product, platform, or business teams.
* Support the FinOps governance calendar, ensuring operational changes align with finance close, forecasting, budgeting, and planning cycles.
* Partner cross-functionally across technology, business, and finance teams to improve cost transparency, accountability, and measurable outcomes.

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Experience in cloud financial management, capacity planning, IT finance, infrastructure reporting, or a related analytical field.
* Working understanding of enterprise infrastructure including server, storage, network, virtualization (VMware), database, middleware, and common operating systems.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure and business capacity planning, with demonstrated reporting and performance analysis skills.
* Working knowledge of public cloud platforms — GCP and/or AWS — including cloud cost fundamentals such as committed-use discounts, savings plans, tagging, and resource lifecycle.
* Proficiency in Google BigQuery for querying and analyzing cloud cost and usage datasets.
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in reporting and analysis tools including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with cloud cost tooling such as Harness CCM is a plus.
* Experience building capacity utilization reports across storage, server, VMware, database, and network infrastructure domains.
* Ability to manage current usage statistics and develop projected growth estimates from business demand signals.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills — able to translate complex infrastructure and cost data into actionable insights for audiences at all levels.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Self-starter who works well independently and collaborates effectively within a cross-functional team.
* The ability to socialize ideas, make recommendations, and gather team consensus to move initiatives forward.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Familiarity with FinOps principles and frameworks — FinOps Foundation certification (FOCP or equivalent) is a plus.
* Scripting or automation skills such as VBA, PowerShell, or SQL to improve reporting efficiency.
* Experience with Splunk or similar observability/analytics platforms for infrastructure performance analysis.
* Experience integrating cloud economics data into financial planning workflows such as forecasting, budgeting, or chargeback/showback.
* Background supporting a federated or matrixed technology organization.
* Familiarity with workflow and ticketing systems such as JIRA or ServiceNow/Remedy.
* Experience with AI/ML or GPU infrastructure cost reporting and governance.
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

Consultant, Strategic Planning

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
  
  
We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:
  
  

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
  
  
**Job Description**
Version 1 seeks an Oracle Cloud Functional consultant.
  
  
The successful candidate will join our Bangalore based Oracle Cloud Functional Support team, forming part of Version 1’s ERP Practice. Candidate should be customer focused and process driven with great documentation skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide day to day application support for a variety of clients.
* Requirements gathering and documentation for business changes.
* Work with technical consultants to deliver client requirements.
* Liaise directly with clients to ensure all requests for change are properly designed, assessed, prioritized, and managed through to completion.
* Assist with transitioning clients into support post Cloud implementation projects and from competitors.
* Identifying persistent problems and work with key stakeholders to address the root causes.
* Providing end user application and functionality training.
* Support all aspects of Cloud Quarterly Releases from Impact Assessment through testing and defect support
* Creating test plans and coordinating testing with the different stakeholders.
* Help ensure that MS ERP initiatives follow the proper planning, scheduling and management processes.
* Assist with risk management and change management on projects.

**Qualifications**
**Essential Qualifications:**

* A minimum of 1-2 years’ experience as an application support analyst or similar role.
* Experience in Oracle implementations and/or upgrades
* Experience of any or all: General Ledger, Subledger Accounting, Payables, Payments, Receivables, Revenue Management, Advanced Collections, Bill Management, Budgetary Control, Cash Management, Tax, Expenses, Fixed Assets, Projects, HCM, Payroll, Absence, Time & Labour, Talent Management, Compensation and Recruiting
* Must have good experience translating business requirements and design into functional solutions
* ITIL process Knowledge
* Experienced user of defect tracking systems, including the extraction of key data for weekly reporting and KPI tracking.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience in configuring and supporting Smart View reports
* Functional and Technical problem investigation skills.
* Oracle Cloud Financials, Procurement or HCM Certification

**Additional Information**
Why Version 1?
  
  
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
* Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
* Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
* Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
* Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
* Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.
  
  
Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.
  
  
We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.;

;We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you ll find:;

* ;  **A culture that backs you**  ; We re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.;;

* ;  **Work that matters**  ; Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.;

* ;  **Room to grow**  ; Whether youre starting your career or bringing years of experience, we re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who ve been excelling here for 10+ years.;
