**Position: Project Manager - Language PMU**

**About:**

  
  

Aligned with NEP 2020, the Language Division PMU supports impact assessment and strategic directions for language institutions. The project maps the national language ecosystem, reviews institutional mandates and governance, strengthens outreach and digital visibility, and develops a performance-linked funding framework. The Project Manager will hold direct ownership of the Ministry and institutional relationship, lead a multidisciplinary team, and be accountable for institutional review and overall PMU delivery, bringing experience of managing central Ministry of Education engagements on the transformation of national institutions, higher education policy and financing, and technical education and skilling systems.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

1. Lead PMU planning, team coordination and timely delivery across concurrent workstreams, holding overall management responsibility at every level of the engagement; set quality standards and review mechanisms; track milestones, risks and dependencies, and conduct weekly progress reviews.

2. Lead institutional diagnosis and mandate assessment across language institutions, reviewing functions, governance structures, overlaps, performance and NEP 2020 alignment, and recommend structural changes to improve institutional functioning and ranking.

3. Coordinate merger, integration, specialization and role-rationalization analysis with the restructuring specialist; develop future institutional roles and implementation roadmaps, and support institutions from diagnosis through execution.

4. Oversee institution and scheme data collection, field visits, validation and analysis of courses, enrolment, faculty capacity and emerging demand to build the national language landscape, including which courses to add or retire, examination and quality gaps, and linkage of language programmes with job-market demand.

5. Guide the funding specialist in reviewing grants and expenditure, assessing alternate financing mechanisms at student, institutional and systemic levels, defining outcome KPIs and benchmarks, and developing institutional scorecards and a performance-linked funding framework.

6. Coordinate flagship initiative mapping, success stories, communications, digital visibility and outreach planning; lead the digital transformation workstream, including the introduction of AI and language technologies, and oversee minister-facing and administrative dashboard requirements.

7. Manage Ministry, State and institutional consultations with Secretaries, Joint Secretaries, Vice Chancellors, faculty, students and state education departments; synthesize specialist inputs into assessment reports, policy reports, concept notes, strategy documents, presentations and implementation plans.

8. Identify integration of language institutions with national missions, skilling priorities and other Ministries' initiatives, and author strategy documents on integration opportunities under the guidance of senior Ministry officials.

9. Support capacity building of institutional leadership and faculty, including training-needs analysis, professional development plans and pedagogy training, to embed recommended reforms.

**Qualifications**

**Skills Required**

* **Required: Postgraduate degree (MBA or equivalent) in Management, Public Policy, Education or a related field.**

* **Preferred: Ph.D. in Management or a relevant discipline; project management certification (e.g., Google Project Management Specialization, PMP or PRINCE2); certification in AI ethics or responsible AI.**

* **Required: Project and stakeholder management, team leadership, research and data interpretation, policy writing, communications, presentations and MS Office Suite.**

* **Preferred: Institutional diagnostics and restructuring, higher education financing, multi-stakeholder consultation facilitation, quality assurance, and AI and digital transformation in education.**

**Experience:**

1. Minimum 10 years of professional experience, including at least 7 years in management consulting, higher or technical education advisory, institutional transformation or public sector programme management with central and state governments.

2. Experience as Project Manager or Lead on central Ministry of Education or higher education engagements involving transformation of national institutions, institutional restructuring for ranking and functioning, multi-state higher education financing studies, or integration of skilling with higher education.

3. Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across concurrent engagements and managing senior government and university stakeholders (Secretaries, Joint Secretaries, Vice Chancellors), including multi-state consultations with 200+ stakeholders.

4. Experience with World Bank or ADB-funded education and skilling programmes, course rationalization and quality reform in technical education, and authoring strategy documents on AI in higher education and integration with national missions.

e43bb598.title: Project Manager — Cloud, Data & Business Applications
e43bb598.description:
**Practice**
Delivery Management, Avanade India
  
  
**Location**
Bengaluru / Delhi NCR, India (Hybrid, with client travel)
  
  
**Experience**
12–15 years in IT, with proven delivery ownership of projects in one or more of cloud migration and application modernisation, data transformation, or CRM/ERP transformation — running teams of eight to ten people, with hands-on delivery experience on Microsoft technologies
  
  
**Role Summary**
Avanade India is looking for a Project Manager to take end-to-end delivery ownership of client projects across cloud modernisation, data and business applications. This is a delivery leadership role for someone who has carried the plan, the budget, the team and the client relationship on real projects — not only reported on them.
  
  
You will run projects with teams distributed across different locations, own scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk, and be the client’s day-to-day point of accountability. We are not looking for experience in every domain: depth in one or two — cloud migration, application modernisation, data transformation, or a CRM or ERP programme — matters more than shallow coverage of all four. Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies is expected, as most of our work sits on the Microsoft stack.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of client projects — initiation, planning, execution, go-live and closure — against agreed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Build and maintain the project plan: work breakdown, estimates, dependencies, critical path, milestones and release schedule.
* Lead a delivery team of consisting of architects, developers, testers and analysts, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Own the commercials of the project — budget, forecast, effort tracking, resource utilization, revenue recognition and margin — and flag variance early.
* Run governance: steering committees, weekly status, RAID logs, dashboards and reporting to client and internal stakeholders.
* Manage scope and change control — impact assessment, change requests, re-baselining and the commercial conversation that goes with them.
* Identify, track and mitigate risks and issues, and escalate with a recommendation rather than only a problem.
* Act as the client’s day-to-day delivery contact, building trust with business and IT stakeholders and managing expectations through the difficult parts of a project.
* Run delivery in the method the engagement needs — agile, waterfall or hybrid — including sprint ceremonies, backlog management and release planning.
* Coordinate the delivery lifecycle across teams: requirements, design, build, testing (SIT/UAT), data migration, cutover, hypercare and transition to support.
* Manage resourcing and onboarding, workload allocation and knowledge continuity across the team.
* Hold quality and compliance — delivery standards, documentation, security and client policy requirements — and prepare for internal and client audits.
* Manage third parties, client teams and Microsoft or partner resources where they form part of the delivery.
* Support presales and account growth — estimation, delivery approach, plans for proposals, and identifying extension opportunities on live projects.
* Coach team members and junior project managers, and contribute delivery templates and lessons learned to the practice.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12–15 years of overall IT experience, with at least 5–6 years managing project delivery end to end.
* Proven delivery of projects in one or more of: cloud migration, application modernization, data platform or data transformation, and CRM or ERP transformation.
* Experience delivering on Microsoft technologies — Azure, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Fabric or the wider stack.
* Demonstrated experience running teams of upto 15-20 resources, including distributed onshore and offshore members.
* Strong command of project management disciplines: estimation, planning, scheduling, budgeting, RAID management, change control and reporting.
* Hands-on with project management and delivery tooling — Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, Planner, Excel-based tracking and reporting dashboards.
* Experience running both agile and waterfall delivery, and knowing which one a given engagement actually needs.
* Commercial awareness — managing budget, effort, utilization and margin, and handling scope and change commercially.

**Business Unit**

BXTI – Finance & Operations Technology

**Business Description**

Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone’s businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial – our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team has the opportunity to make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who can take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring and developing excellence. We collaborate to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

**Job Title**

Senior Vice President – Program Manager

**Job Description**

Blackstone is seeking a best-in-class Senior Vice President, Program Manager to shape and lead technology-enabled initiatives across its Finance and Operations Technology portfolio. Based in Bangalore, this leader will define the long-term direction and own the delivery of complex, multi-year programs spanning corporate finance, procurement, treasury, and fund accounting platforms, partnering closely with Finance, Treasury, Fund Operations, and Technology leadership across global offices.

The ideal candidate pairs deep corporate finance technology expertise (for example Oracle, Coupa, treasury management, and fund calculation platforms) with strategic foresight, exceptional problem-solving skills, strong program leadership, and a hands-on technical mindset. This person will anticipate future business and technology needs, use AI and data thoughtfully to improve decisions and delivery, and set the standard for program leadership in Bangalore. The role requires equal comfort shaping a compelling long-term vision, presenting recommendations to executive steering committees, and driving disciplined sprint-level execution in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Lead end-to-end delivery of a portfolio of finance and operations technology programs, including general ledger, financial close, procure-to-pay, treasury and cash management, and fund calculation and allocation platforms.
* Own program strategy, target-state roadmaps, and multi-year delivery plans, anticipating future business capabilities and technology needs while translating objectives from the CFO organization, Controllers, Treasury, Tax, Procurement, and Fund Operations into clear priorities, requirements, and execution milestones.
* Drive large-scale implementations, upgrades, and integrations of enterprise platforms such as Oracle (Fusion/EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems (e.g. Kyriba, FIS Quantum, or ION), and fund accounting and waterfall engines.
* Establish and run program governance, including steering committees, executive status reporting, RAID management, budget and resource tracking, and benefits realization.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, data, architecture, information security, finance operations, and third-party vendors and system integrators, across Bangalore, New York, and other global locations, leveraging tools such as JIRA, Sigma, and Excel for planning, tracking, and analysis.
* Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior finance and technology leaders, structuring ambiguous problems, identifying root causes, developing practical options, and prioritizing investments based on long-term value, risk, scalability, and business impact.
* Manage vendor and system integrator relationships, including statements of work, delivery oversight, commercial tracking, and escalation.
* Define and track program success metrics (for example close-cycle time, straight-through processing rates, reconciliation breaks, and user adoption), using data and AI-enabled analysis where appropriate to surface insights, improve forecasting, strengthen decisions, and drive continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.

  

* 15+ years of experience in financial services technology, with at least 8 years leading large, complex programs as a program manager, delivery lead, or senior technical project manager.
* Deep, hands-on experience delivering corporate finance technology, such as Oracle ERP (Fusion or EBS), Coupa, treasury management systems, and fund accounting, fund calculation, or waterfall and allocation platforms.
* Strong understanding of corporate finance and fund operations concepts, including general ledger, consolidation, financial close, accounts payable, cash management, fees, carried interest, capital calls and distributions, and investor allocations, and how they translate into data, systems, and processes.
* Proven track record delivering multi-workstream, cross-regional programs in a high-expectation environment, ideally at a top-tier asset manager, private equity firm, investment bank, or leading technology or consulting organization.
* Experience leading distributed teams and working across time zones, including partnering with US- and Europe-based stakeholders from an India delivery center.

* Demonstrated critical thinking beyond immediate delivery, define a credible long-term vision and roadmap, and connect near-term priorities to broader business, operating model, data, and technology outcomes while remaining close to execution.
* Exceptional problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex and incomplete information, challenges assumptions constructively, and drives decisions and outcomes without heavy supervision.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, to build clear, visually compelling executive materials; synthesize complex information into a concise narrative; facilitate decision-oriented discussions; and tailor messages for technical, business, and senior leadership audiences.

* High level of critical and systems thinking, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and professionalism, to evaluate second-order impacts and make balanced recommendations aligned with Blackstone’s culture of and performance.
* Proficiency with JIRA (or similar tools) for backlog management, sprint planning, portfolio and program tracking, and status reporting.
* Solid understanding of finance system integration patterns, including ERP interfaces, bank connectivity (SWIFT, host-to-host, payment file formats), subledger and journal feeds, and master data management.
* Strong understanding of modern system architectures, including cloud-native and SaaS platforms, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, event-driven integrations, and enterprise application ecosystems.
* Experience partnering with technology teams on data model reviews, technical requirements, solution architecture, and end-to-end delivery across upstream and downstream platforms.
* Command of both Agile and waterfall delivery, including SDLC governance, DevOps concepts, release planning, testing coordination, environment management, and production implementation readiness.
* Hands-on, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership over delivering outcomes rather than just managing processes.
* Forward-looking, curious, analytical, and intellectually rigorous, to connect market, business, data, and technology trends to a practical long-term strategy.
* Confident and credible with senior leaders, to present a clear point of view, communicate complex trade-offs simply, influence decisions, and navigate competing priorities with maturity and discretion.
* A leader who builds trust across geographies and develops talent within the Bangalore team.
* Strong alignment with Blackstone’s values, including ethical judgment teamwork, innovation, and long-term partnership with colleagues and investors.

0ed2b00a.description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about building innovative technology solutions that drive Prime membership growth and deliver personalized experiences? Join our IES Prime team where you'll lead complex technical programs across multiple stakeholders to create differentiated customer journeys throughout the Prime lifecycle. In this role, you'll leverage your deep technical expertise in large-scale distributed systems to drive strategic initiatives that connect various Amazon systems, enhancing the end-to-end Prime experience for customers in Emerging Markets.
  
  
Working at the intersection of customer experience and technical implementation, you'll tackle challenges across distributed systems, customer-facing applications, high-throughput production environments, and the application of ML/AI to enhance the Prime membership journey. This unique position offers exceptional visibility across Amazon's ecosystem while contributing to Prime's north star vision of becoming Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and validate complex program requirements across multiple stakeholder teams, solving ambiguous problems and proactively identifying risks related to Prime lifecycle experiences
* Partner with engineering teams to create high-level technical designs and architectural for implementing solutions that integrate with various Amazon systems, ensuring scalability and performance for high-volume customer experiences
* Drive end-to-end program management for technical initiatives that enhance Prime membership growth, benefit engagement
* Lead technical discussions with cross-functional teams to align business needs with technical constraints, making smart trade-offs between short and long-term requirements
* Streamline processes and implement operational excellence procedures to improve concurrent project delivery while monitoring metrics and program health

A day in the life
  
  
As an example - Your day begins with leading a cross-team planning session to align stakeholders on integration challenges for an upcoming Prime benefit enhancement. You'll brainstorm solutions for scaling a personalized post-signup journey, then unblock your team by facilitating a design review with partner engineering teams. Afterward, you'll contribute to the team's architectural evolution during a technical review session, analyze program metrics, and prepare updates for leadership on the progress of your initiatives that improve Prime's value-for-money promise in price-sensitive markets.
  
  
**About The Team**
Prime's north star vision is to be Earth's most engaging, satisfying, and loved membership program, delivering profitable growth by improving the Amazon experience. Our tech team drives Prime business growth in Emerging Markets through innovative technology solutions. The IES Prime team drives the growth of Prime membership by delivering personalized, contextual, and value-led experiences across the member lifecycle. Our mandate spans creating differentiated post-sign-up journeys, deepening benefit engagement, communicating value realized through personalized experiences, and enabling seamless renewals that reinforce Prime's value-for-money promise—a core differentiator in price-sensitive markets.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

a543aea5.title: Sr Technical Program Manager
a543aea5.description:
**Life at Plume**
At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life’s moments better. Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.
  
  
We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.
  
  
With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day.
  
  
**This is a work-from-office / In-Office role based in our Hyderabad, India location.**
**Job Summary**
Seeking an experienced, energetic and collaborative Engineering Program Manager to define and drive product success for our cloud based service platform.
  
  
They will be able to lead multiple simultaneous projects or programs that are complex and are able to develop recovery strategies for those that stray from their plan while being part of the collaborative, and fun loving team at a rapidly growing organization.
  
  
Plume develops and deploys cloud based control planes with scale to manage 10’s of millions of customer homes through some of the world’s largest ISPs. Plume cloud applications include WiFi network management and optimization, device access control, network provisioning and end customer user interaction through mobile apps. Our focus is on the home market and we support B2B and B2C product offerings.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build and maintain the project plan including scope, schedule and risk management
* Drive execution and demonstrate end to end ownership of complex, technical programs to successful completion
* Drive deep collaboration across a network of critical dependencies
* Identify and resolve conflicts, inter-dependencies and program issues quickly and efficiently
* Lead cross functional project meetings and milestone reviews
* Deliver executive communication and drive the decision-making process
* Manage stakeholder and team communications and updates
* Develop roadmaps and development milestones for projects based on input from Product teams
* Monitor progress to plan and design a recovery strategy if project deviates from baseline plan

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) or relevant industry-standard experience, with 10+ years of experience.
* Experience working in rapidly growing organizations
* Must have strong technical background and Hands on experience in software development. Strong preference for candidate transitioned from lead development into Program Management
* Lead end-to-end program execution for initiatives such as feature development, interoperability, performance optimization, certification. working closely with firmware, driver, hardware, QA, and product teams to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
* Must have prior experience working in the Wi-Fi domain and be able to understand and engage in technical discussions related to Wi-Fi protocols, features, performance issues, and firmware architecture. Ability to work closely with firmware teams on architecture, release planning, dependency management, defect triage, and risk mitigation is essential.
* Able to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to make programs successful
* Demonstrable ability to think outside the box to resolve technical issues and resource conflicts
* Thorough knowledge of software engineering principles and agile methodologies
* 5+ years’ experience managing fast-paced agile software projects with aggressive schedules
* Ability to quickly pick up new technologies and industry trends
* Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills and passion to solve hard problems
* Excellent leadership and communication skills

**About Plume**
As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world’s largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.
  
  
Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume’s software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.
  
  
Plume is an equal opportunity workplace that maintains a continuing policy of nondiscrimination in all employment practices and decisions, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy, childbirth or related individual conditions, medical conditions (as defined by state law), military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

88ba79a2.title: Technical Program Manager
88ba79a2.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**About The Role**
At PayPal, real-time decisioning powers customer protection and global commerce. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of risk strategies and the next-generation Risk Decisioning Platform. From roadmap to production, you’ll be accountable for the integrated plan, the cross-team execution, and the measurable results. You’ll partner with the Product Manager, risk strategy leaders, data science, modeling, and engineering to turn the roadmap into outcomes: loss reduction, approval rates, and customer experience.
  
  
Near term, you’ll lead the program to move strategies off legacy systems and ramp them to full production. Beyond that, you’ll orchestrate the launch of new strategies and build the delivery mechanisms, including experimentation and automation, that keep them improving.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Scope: The project & program responsibilities are focused on internal information system-specific project tasks or non-technical project completion using an internal customer perspective, both typically from initiation through delivery.
* Organize daily activities based on organizational goals.
* Develop and implement new programs that support objectives.
* Monitor projects and oversee project managers.
* Evaluate program strengths and weaknesses.
* Develop program budgets and plans.
* Meet with stakeholders to discuss program status and goals.
* Improve strategies with the marketing team.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own end-to-end program delivery. Turn the product roadmap into an integrated, multi-quarter plan spanning rules, models, data pipelines, platform capabilities, and customer treatments, with clear milestones, owners, and dependencies. Lead independently.
* Lead the legacy migration. Own the strategy, sequencing, and execution of moving risk strategies to the Risk Decisioning Platform, including parity validation, shadow and champion/challenger testing, cutover, and ramp to full production.
* Drive new strategy launches. Establish repeatable launch processes, from design through readiness reviews, rollout gating, monitoring, and rollback, that other teams adopt as the standard.
* Align teams and leaders. Partner across data science, modeling, engineering, platform, risk operations, and strategy teams on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs. Resolve cross-org blockers early and influence without direct authority.
* Manage dependencies and risk. Make critical paths and dependency maps visible, and anticipate risks to data, models, platform capacity, and infrastructure before they hit the schedule.
* Enable experimentation and automation. Work with engineering and data science to make testing, deployment, and strategy optimization faster and safer, focusing on the highest-leverage automation.
* Track, report, and govern. Define program metrics and dashboards covering delivery health, strategy performance, and captured savings. Present in program, product, and steering committee reviews, shaping the narrative and trade-off recommendations for senior leadership.
* Raise the bar. Introduce scalable program practices and post-launch retrospectives, and mentor other program managers.

What you bring
  
  

* 5+ years of program or technical program management experience delivering complex, cross-functional technical programs, including programs spanning multiple teams or organizations
* Strong technical fluency in data pipelines, model deployment, APIs, and distributed systems, enough to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists and challenge technical trade-offs
* Proven experience leading large-scale migrations or platform transitions, including cutover and ramp planning, with ownership of strategy as well as delivery
* Excellent planning, prioritization, and risk management skills, with a record of delivering on time in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across competing priorities without direct authority
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief executives and steering committees
* Comfort working with data: you define metrics, read dashboards, and use them to steer the program
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Hands-on background in engineering, data science, or risk analytics
* Experience with real-time decisioning or rules-engine platforms
* Experience mentoring or leading other program managers

**Subsidiary:**
PayPal
  
  
**Travel Percent:**
0
  
  
PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.
  
  
For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.
  
  
**Who We Are:**
Click Here to learn more about our culture and community.
  
  
**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.
  
  
**Belonging at PayPal:**
Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.
  
  
Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.
  
  
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
The mission of the Engineering Program Management Office (PMO) is to implement program and project management methodologies that enable Fivetran to deliver complex products and initiatives on time and within expectations. In addition, the Engineering PMO serves as the subject-matter expert body on project and program management standards, directing a department-wide approach to program delivery and communication. You will help plan, track, and execute the company's most critical and cross-cutting Product and Engineering objectives. You will be responsible for leading cross-functional teams, managing complex programs and projects, and ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions that meet our customers' needs. You will communicate and work in close collaboration with partners across the engineering team and other business partners to achieve this vision.
  
  
This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore Office, India.
  
  
**Technologies you will use:**

* Surface feedback and enhancement to project/program management processes.
* Align stakeholders and team members towards project/program management best practices.

**Skills We’re Looking For:**

* 4+ years of experience in technical project/program management.
* Agile and waterfall project/program management experience.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Jira.
* Can lead large and complex initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Can introduce structure and order in volatile conditions.

You’ll be our product expert in front of customers. You’ll know our platforms inside out, from every module and workflow to every setting, and use that knowledge to show facility owners, clinic heads and operations managers exactly how our software fits the way they work. ce4e07d2.title: Solutions Consultant 2
ce4e07d2.description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. As a Solutions Consultant for IT/ITeS, you will be part of the core technical team, architecting solutions for large IT/ITeS customers in the region. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  
  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

**The Role**
AspenTech is an AI-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market-leading company with double-digit growth and a blue-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.
  
  
As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.
  
  
In this customer-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

What You'll Need
  
  

* 14 + years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21), and Advanced Process Control (APC) & Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice-to-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals & Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food & Beverage, Pulp & Paper, Power Generation, and Water & Wastewater.

* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning & Scheduling - Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.

Regional travel up to 35%.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 7+ years in software development, AI/ML engineering, or technical consulting. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency using TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms, (Nice to have: Go).
* Applied AI Knowledge: Large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, and modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* System Integration: Comfortable integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and event/data pipelines.
* Data-Driven Mindset: Use A/B testing, telemetry, and metrics to guide decisions and drive improvements.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
* Customer Empathy: A bias for action and a relentless focus on solving problems for customers.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1756005

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title: Senior Manager – Solution Architecture**

**Summary:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager – Solution Architecture to lead the design and governance of end-to-end enterprise solutions supporting data products and corporate finance transformation.

This role combines solution strategy, architecture leadership, and people management, translating complex business requirements into secure, scalable, and cost-effective solutions. The ideal candidate will connect business processes, applications, data, integration, and cloud technologies to enable transformation across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.

You will own solution architecture quality across engagements, lead a team of architects, and partner with enterprise architecture, product, engineering, security, and business leaders to guide solutions from discovery through implementation and business value realization.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Solution Strategy & Architecture Leadership**

* Own end-to-end solution architecture across complex transformation initiatives, aligning business capabilities, functional requirements, and technology choices with enterprise strategy.
* Lead discovery and architecture workshops to define solution scope, assess current-state landscapes, and develop target-state designs and phased transition roadmaps.
* Define architecture across application, data, integration, infrastructure, and security domains, with clear component responsibilities, interfaces, deployment models, and dependencies.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy options, cloud services, enterprise products, and emerging technologies through structured trade-off analysis and targeted proofs of concept.
* Establish reference architectures, design patterns, architecture decision records, and review standards; ensure alignment with enterprise principles and govern justified exceptions.
* Lead architecture reviews and resolve cross-domain design challenges, balancing business fit, scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and total cost of ownership.

  

**Architecture Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Provide architecture oversight across concurrent engagements, maintaining traceability from requirements to design decisions, implementation, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to translate designs into actionable work, validate feasibility, and manage technical dependencies, design changes, and architecture risks.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, recovery, and supportability; guide validation through testing and operational readiness reviews.
* Develop migration and modernization approaches, including data migration, coexistence, cutover, and rollback; align sequencing, estimates, and cost assumptions with delivery teams.
* Embed security, privacy, data governance, and applicable compliance requirements in solution designs, working with control owners to assess risks and close design gaps.

  

**Team Leadership & Talent Management**

* Lead and scale a solution architecture team, coordinating application, data, integration, cloud, and security specialists across engagements.
* Build an inclusive, high-performance architecture practice focused on sound judgment, collaboration, reusable knowledge, and measurable business outcomes.
* Own hiring, resource allocation, performance management, succession planning, and capability development aligned with business demand and technology priorities.
* Mentor architects and technical leads on design quality, business understanding, stakeholder influence, and career growth; strengthen communities of practice and peer reviews.

  

**Business & Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with business leaders, finance transformation stakeholders, product owners, and clients to clarify needs and translate them into feasible solution options.
* Present solution alternatives, investment needs, trade-offs, and risks to decision-makers; secure alignment on scope, target architecture, and expected business outcomes.
* Lead architecture inputs for proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations, including solution narratives, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Communicate architecture decisions, delivery implications, technical risks, and business value clearly to executive and technical audiences.

**Reusable Solutions & Innovation**

* Develop reusable solution blueprints, accelerators, and integration patterns that improve consistency, reduce delivery effort, and support repeatable client outcomes.
* Assess opportunities to simplify application portfolios and modernize legacy solutions, balancing reuse and standardization with business-specific requirements.
* Evaluate analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions through business cases and proofs of value, addressing data readiness, security, responsible use, and operational feasibility.

  

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of experience across solution architecture, software engineering, enterprise integration, or data platforms, including ownership of complex enterprise solution designs.
* 5+ years of architecture or engineering people-management experience, with a proven track record of leading architects or technical leads across multiple programs or engagements.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep experience designing solutions on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including hybrid integration, deployment models, resilience, and cost considerations.
* Strong expertise in application architecture, APIs, microservices, event-driven systems, enterprise integration patterns, and the trade-offs between distributed and simpler architectures.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, including transactional systems, data warehouses or lakehouses, data pipelines, master data, and analytics integration.
* Experience producing architecture models, interface specifications, decision records, and non-functional requirements; familiarity with frameworks or methods such as TOGAF, C4, or ArchiMate.
* Expertise in secure solution design, identity and access management, data protection, and enterprise governance, with working knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational support.

**Architecture & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to guide enterprise solutions from discovery and option assessment through design governance, implementation oversight, and transition to operations.
* Experience leading architecture reviews, proofs of concept, vendor evaluations, and risk assessments while managing cross-team dependencies and stakeholder expectations.
* Strong skills in technical estimation, total cost of ownership analysis, modernization planning, and evaluating performance, resilience, and scalability trade-offs.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Understanding of enterprise business processes and data models; exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A) is preferred.
* Experience in finance transformation, ERP integration, analytics platforms, or data-led enterprise transformation is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong people leadership, practice development, and coaching skills, with the ability to lead architects and influence multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, including executive-level engagement and client-facing solution presentations.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture with pragmatic delivery, challenge assumptions constructively, and make clear decisions under ambiguity.
* High ownership mindset focused on solution quality, implementation feasibility, sustainable technology choices, and measurable business outcomes.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Service line - Position Title: TechOps\_CloudOps\_Azure\_DevOps\_Senior**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**About Global Delivery Services**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

  

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a skilled Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in the Azure cloud platform and experience applying AI to CloudOps. This role is responsible for end-to-end infrastructure and deployment automation, CI/CD engineering, reliability, and incident resolution, while using generative AI and AIOps capabilities to improve observability, triage, root cause analysis, runbook automation, and operational efficiency. The role will lead escalations, design secure and governed AI-enabled operations solutions, and collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, security, data, and AI teams to deliver highly available services.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* **Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)**
* + Design, deploy, and manage scalable AKS clusters for mission‑critical workloads.
  + Implement secure cluster networking, workload identities, and governance policies.
  + Optimize AKS performance, reliability, and cost as part of the platform architecture.
  + Integrate AKS with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and monitoring solutions.
* **ARM Templates & Bicep**
* + Develop reusable ARM/Bicep infrastructure‑as‑code templates for automated deployments.
  + Standardize resource deployments through parameterized and modular Bicep templates.
  + Migrate legacy ARM templates to Bicep for improved maintainability.
  + Ensure consistency, compliance, and repeatability across environments using IaC best practices.
* **Azure DevOps**
* + Architect and implement end‑to‑end CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure.
  + Lead DevOps automation initiatives across build, release, testing, and deployment workflows.
  + Implement secure DevOps practices, including secrets management and pipeline governance.
  + Manage Azure Repos, Boards, Pipelines, Artifacts, and environment configurations.
* **Landing Zone Architecture**
* + Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
  + Define foundational architecture for identity, networking, governance, policies, and management groups.
  + Build scalable enterprise-ready landing zones for multi‑subscription and multi‑environment setups.
  + Implement guardrails such as Azure Policies, RBAC structures, and blueprint‑style templates.
* **Terraform & Terraform Cloud**
* + Develop and manage Terraform modules for consistent provisioning across environments.
  + Implement Terraform Cloud/Enterprise for remote state management and secure pipelines.
  + Automate Azure infrastructure deployments using version-controlled IaC.
  + Enforce policies, workspaces, and governance using Terraform Cloud capabilities.
* **AI-enabled CloudOps & Agentic Automation**
* + Design and implement AI-assisted operational workflows for alert enrichment, incident triage, event correlation, root cause analysis, knowledge retrieval, and runbook execution.
  + Build and operate secure cloud operations agents using Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI Search, and orchestration frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel.
  + Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions grounded in approved runbooks, knowledge articles, telemetry, and configuration data; apply vector, hybrid, and semantic search patterns.
  + Integrate agents securely with operational tools and APIs using function calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP), with approval gates for production actions.
  + Engineer production controls for identity, private networking, secrets, prompt-injection defence, data protection, content safety, auditability, evaluation, and responsible AI.
  + Monitor AI services and agents for availability, latency, quality, token usage, model drift, cost, and operational risk using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, and enterprise observability platforms.
* **Documentation & Best Practices**
* + Create detailed architectural documents, design specs, deployment guides, and runbooks.
  + Maintain IaC repositories with clear documentation, versioning, and conventions.
  + Conduct knowledge transfer sessions, workshops, and technical enablement for teams.
  + Provide guidance on DevOps, cloud governance, scalability, cost optimization, and security best practices.

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines,
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform; good understanding of ARM Templates/ Biceps.
* Familiarity with scripting languages such as Bash and Python.
* Deep understanding of Azure services(VMs, Blob Storage, AKS, AAD).
* Container orchestration and management using Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker.
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible.
* Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, IAM policies, and compliance standards.
* Experience with ITSM tools like ServiceNow for incident and change management.
* Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, vector search, RAG, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and MCP in an enterprise operations context.
* Hands-on Python experience for API integration, telemetry processing, automation, evaluation, and AI-enabled operational tooling.
* Ability to design human-in-the-loop automation with least-privilege access, measurable quality thresholds, rollback controls, audit trails, and safe failure handling for production environments.
* Strong documentation and communication skills.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5 - 8 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure operations, and automation.
* Hands-on expertise in Building and deploying Azure cloud environments for high availability systems.
* Proficiency in Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD tooling, and automation scripting.
* Demonstrated experience delivering at least one AI-enabled CloudOps, DevOps, SRE, observability, service-management, or knowledge-assistant use case from design through production support.
* Experience in a 24x7 rotational support model.
* Relevant certifications in Azure (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert).

  

**Technologies and Tools**

**Must have**

* Cloud Platforms: Azure
* CI/CD & Deployment: Azure DevOps Pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Containerization: Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Helm
* Logging & Monitoring: Azure Monitor
* Configuration & Automation: Ansible, Bash
* AI-enabled CloudOps: Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Foundry Agent Service, Azure AI Search, vector databases, RAG, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and responsible AI controls
* Programming & Integration: Python, REST APIs, JSON, SDK-based integrations, managed identities, and secure secrets handling
* AI Observability & AIOps: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, OpenTelemetry, anomaly detection, event correlation, and AI-assisted incident response
* Incident & ITSM: ServiceNow or equivalent
* Certification: Azure relevant certifications

  

**Good to have**

* Cloud Infrastructure: CloudFormation, ARM Templates
* CI/CD & Deployment: GitHub Actions,
* Security: IAM Policies, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Security Hub
* Networking: VPC, Subnets, Load Balancers, Security Groups (AWS/Azure)
* Scripting: Python/Bash
* Observability: OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk
* Agent Frameworks & Standards: Microsoft Agent Framework or Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP), multi-agent orchestration, and agent evaluation
* AI Operations Ecosystem: GitHub Copilot, ServiceNow AI capabilities, Datadog AI features, Splunk AI capabilities, or equivalent enterprise AIOps tooling
* Compliance: Azure Security Center, Azure CAF

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

**Our Commitment:** As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**Professional Development:** From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

**People and Culture:** In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

**Benefits:** Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

**How to Apply:** If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

We are looking for a skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with expertise in AWS cloud operations, observability, incident management, and automation. The role is responsible for building and maintaining monitoring and alerting solutions, leading production incident triage and root cause analysis, and improving service reliability across AWS and heterogeneous technology platforms. The engineer will leverage AI/ML and AIOps capabilities to predict and prevent incidents, accelerate diagnostics, automate operational processes, and reduce response times while collaborating with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to deliver highly available services.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

  

**Alerting, monitoring and Triage**

* Build and maintain comprehensive monitoring and alerting to proactively identify performance degradation and application disruptions
* Perform end to end triage and in depth troubleshooting of production incidents by analysing logs, telemetry signals, and related diagnostic data to quickly identify root causes and restore service
* Implement ML models that analyse telemetry, logs and metrics to predict and prevent incidents before they impact users.
* Implement best in class detection mechanisms to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and accelerate incident response
* Develop systems that learn from historical incidents, continuously improving diagnostic accuracy and accelerate incident response time
* Build innovative, scalable alerting solutions across a heterogeneous technology landscape, including AWS, Unix, and Mainframe platforms.
* Develop and maintain synthetic monitoring to simulate real user interactions and ensure early detection of failures.
* Perform daily health checks, triage and troubleshoot alerts, and resolve issues to minimize downtime and user impact.
* Conduct trend analysis, identify recurring patterns, and partner with application teams to enhance system reliability and availability

  

**Incident Management**

* Participate in standard incident management processes, leveraging incident playbooks, diagnostic tools, and technical expertise to quickly identify impact and restore service
* Proactively trigger incident management when early signals indicate potential disruption
* Review and act on maintenance notifications, service advisories, and platform updates to mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain a centralized incident response playbook, ensuring steps, processes, and escalation paths are clearly documented.
* Document incidents, recovery steps, and learnings, and communicate them to relevant stakeholders to drive continuous improvement

  

**Problem Management:**

* Collaborate closely with application (App) development teams to identify, diagnose, and resolve operational problems impacting the platform or applications.
* Act as a bridge between platform operations and development teams to ensure timely root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.

  

**Collaboration and Continuous Improvement**

* Work collaboratively with developers, DevOps engineers, and IT stakeholders to improve performance, reliability, and operational maturity.
* Continuously refine alerting to reduce false positives and false negatives.
* Stay current with emerging observability tools, monitoring strategies, and SRE practices.
* Promote and support adoption of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles across teams.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned
* Willingness to work in a 24×7 support model, as needed

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification (mandatory); AWS Solutions Architect certification preferred.
* Minimum of 3 years of hands on experience as an operations engineer, full stack developer, or automation engineer.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability collaborating with application teams, ability to handle escalations and troubleshoot complex application issues.
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting logs to generate operational intelligence and accelerate incident resolution.
* Experience with observability, SRE principles, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve system reliability.
* Sound knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and IAM.
* Experience with REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems
* Strong tooling and automation skills using Python, Java, Selenium etc.
* Prior experience in incident management and stakeholder communication.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively across teams

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Familiarity with Agile development practices and methodologies.
* Experience with Application Performance Monitoring (APM) tools such as Honeycomb, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or other similar tools
* Background in supporting Java-based applications on AWS, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, and deployment support.
* Experience with additional monitoring and visualization tools such as Splunk, Grafana, and ThousandEyes.
* Exposure to Unix and Mainframe environments.
* Experience in networking and troubleshooting connectivity issues
* Experience building AI/LLM-powered applications (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) is nice to have

  

**Education:**

**Degree:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  

**What we offer you**

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

**How to Apply:** If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
