ec436352.title: Tech Principal, AI Solutions
ec436352.description:
**Tech Principal, AI Solutions**

  

Location: Hybrid | Type: Full-time

  

**About Newpage Solutions**

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data- driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview.

We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in peoples lives.

  

**Your Mission**

We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping: when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement,

a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence: you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data

engineering. Third, delivery governance: you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably. You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built: not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge

of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

  

**What Youll Do**

**Shape Solutions in Discovery**

* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the clients problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end: target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually: layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership: team shape, phasing,milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.

**Set the Engineering Standards**

* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build: reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.

**Govern and Steer Delivery**

* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects: regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.

You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. 35a51e28.title: Senior Program Manager, Seller Fees Science & Tech
35a51e28.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.
  
  
Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management  
  
Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.  
  
GTM Execution & Content Management  
  
Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.  
  
Process Development & Operational Excellence  
  
Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.  
  
Program Leadership  
  
Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.  
  
A day in the life  
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience with go-to-market planning, launch execution, or operational readiness programs

Due to criticality of the ShipTech systems, world-wide (WW) Amazon business organizations work with ShipTech every year to deliver their programs for network expansion, operational efficiency improvement, new feature delivery to enhance customer/operator experience, compliance asks, etc. WW requestors submit intakes to deliver: (1) on-boarding new shippers, carriers, and services to the shipping network, (2) facilitating package movement and tracking in Amazon and third-party (3P) network, (3) changes in carrier artifacts like a label and manifest, (4) carrier configurations like routing codes, account ids, and (5) custom tech-builds for meeting business specific asks delivered by ShipTech every year.
  
  
We are looking for a Program Manager to be a part of our multi-year effort to execute the vision and support the operational execution for the Global Program team. Our mission is to be a partner and enabler to Amazon Customer Fulfillment, Transportation & Logistics, and Operational Finance, within WW Operations. This role gives an opportunity to work closely with Business, Operations, Tech, and Senior Leaders to manage and deliver for Amazon businesses.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have successfully led programs in the operations excellence or supply chain analytics space. They have strong analytical skills and expertise in excel. They will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Program Manager you will be responsible for driving cross-functional product design platform capabilities alignment among stakeholders. You will work closely with Product Management and Technology teams as well as various Business Operations and Carrier launch teams to intake new use cases by collecting requirements, scoping, prioritizing and than working with development teams to implement and deploy tech changes . Your role is critical in executing our program and project initiatives, while providing great internal customer support and driving consistency, help us continue to support our initiatives, and identify process improvement opportunities.
  
  
Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. This candidate must have crisp communication skills, and have experience communicating project status and updates across a global audience. We are looking for someone who is detail-driven, and has excellent problem solving and communication abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs and a high bias for action are important for this role.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The successful candidate will have very strong analytical skills and expertise in excel. She/he will be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. She/he will be experienced at working with large data sets and managing multiple competing priorities. She/he will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, and be a passionate advocate of the team and processes to stakeholders. She/he will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a team of program managers who work across 20+ platform tech teams. Our stakeholders are transportation teams across regions. We contribute to several large-scale high-visibility programs each year such as network expansion projects like market place launches and carrier launches, and new feature build outs to provide enhanced customer experience or better operational efficiencies. We also support several compliance programs across our worldwide stakeholders. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to work with with global business customers and our engineering teams to support intake requests related to new carrier on-boarding and ship method integrations.

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience

* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

This candidate must have crisp communication skills, and have experience communicating project status and updates across a global audience. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs, influence without authority, and a high bias for action are critical for success in this role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering large end to end programs. You will have the opportunity to engage with experienced cross-disciplinary teams to conceive of and design innovative customer facing initiatives. You thrive through creating a vision, building consensus and driving teams towards results. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, significantly complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, and then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. This role will require the candidate be self-sufficient to analyze large amounts of data. So, working knowledge of SQL is critical for success. You will not be required to build data infrastructure but you will need to be comfortable querying (good foundational knowledge), be nifty with excel (power pivot), and use data to drive / influence discussions. Many a times you will have to leverage existing data generated by other BIEs to drive your programs. Other times, the exact data may not be available and you will need to be self-sufficient to not be blocked by this.

You will engage with stakeholders ad partners to track progress on goals, as well as identify opportunities to further enhance customer experience. You will crisply communicate to senior leadership on status, progress, concerns and help required to unblock key opportunities. The bottom line is to drive improvements which requires strong communication, a flair for identifying data patterns, comfort with analyzing large varied datasets, and a knack of influencing diverse set of stakeholders.

We are building products that help customers to easily identify offers which are closest to them. True to Amazon’s tenets, customer and seller obsession are always at the forefront of our decisions. We innovate and design our services and tools with a focus on customer experience, followed by our focus on technology and worldwide scaling. You will work on the customer’s search experience, build new widgets that drive better discovery of products, improve personalization for the entire customer’s journey, improve our perception of speed, and scale all these products globally.

* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

b79d1364.description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Serves as the connective tissue for our most strategic product launches. In this newly created role, you will be the central orchestrator responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of bringing new Gracenote products and features to market.
  
  
You will not just manage a schedule; you will bridge the gap between technical execution and commercial readiness in partnership with Product, Engineering, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the comprehensive New Product Introduction (NPI) / Go-To-Market (GTM) process from ideation and development through to launch and post-launch evaluation.
* Serve as the primary liaison connecting diverse teams. Ensure alignment across:

+ Product & Design: Tracking feature readiness, user experience milestones, and beta testing.
+ Engineering: Monitoring development sprints, QA, and technical deployment schedules.
+ Legal & Privacy: Ensuring new products meet all regulatory compliance, data privacy standards, and that necessary vendor/client contracts are updated.
+ Marketing: Aligning product delivery with messaging, positioning, and promotional launch campaigns.
+ Sales & Enablement: Ensuring sales teams are trained, equipped with collateral, and ready to monetize the product on day one.
+ Customer Support/Operations: Ensuring support teams have the documentation and tools needed to assist clients post-launch.

* Build and scale a standardized NPI playbook for Gracenote, defining clear phases, gates, deliverables, and ownership for all future launches.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, dependencies, and risks across all workstreams. Develop mitigation plans and escalate critical issues to executive stakeholders with proposed solutions.
* Host regular cross-functional syncs. Provide clear, concise executive reporting on program health, launch readiness, and post-launch metrics.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program management, product operations, or GTM management experience, preferably within the B2B tech, SaaS, or data/entertainment industries.
* Proven ability to "speak the language" of diverse departments—from deeply technical engineering constraints to complex legal compliance and nuanced marketing strategies.
* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to drive alignment, accountability, and momentum among stakeholders who do not report to you.
* Deep understanding of software development lifecycles (Agile/Scrum) and traditional project management frameworks. PMP, PgMP, or Agile certifications are a plus.
* Hyper-organized with a keen eye for detail. Capable of managing multiple, complex product launches simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, capable of distilling complex program statuses into clear executive summaries.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

**About Beroe And MAX**
Beroe is a procurement intelligence company. Global enterprises rely on our market, supplier and category insight to make better sourcing decisions.
  
  
MAX is Beroe’s AI-powered decision engine for procurement, built in partnership with Kearney. It turns market signals, supplier risk and spend data into recommendations that CPOs and category leaders can act on.
  
  
**Role purpose**
You’ll be the hands-on demo specialist for MAX in APAC and Europe. You will deliver sharp, client-specific demonstrations to senior procurement and supply chain leaders, and you’ll build the collateral that makes those demos land.
  
  
You’ll work under the direction of the Presales & Solutions lead. Your job is to make every client conversation look polished, relevant and credible.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Demonstrations**

* Deliver MAX demos to CPOs, CFOs, heads of category and supply chain leaders at enterprise accounts across APAC and Europe
* Tailor each demo to the client’s categories, spend profile, regional context and business priorities, using discovery notes from the account team
* Tie each demo to a clear value story (savings, risk reduction, speed to decision) and agree a concrete next step with the account executive
* Handle client questions on product, data and integration with confidence. Build a working understanding of AI and security topics (e.g., how MAX models work, data handling, access controls) so you can respond credibly, and escalate deeper technical questions to Product or the Director

**Collateral and demo assets**

* Build and maintain client-facing materials: tailored demo decks, one-pagers, use-case stories, ROI and business-case templates, and leave-behinds
* Create demo scripts and storylines by industry (e.g., pharma, chemicals, food & beverage, CPG), following the narrative standards set by the Director
* Work with Product to keep demo environments, sample data and sandboxes current and realistic
* Keep a clean, versioned library of assets that account teams can reuse

**Deal and event support**

* Support account executives with pre-demo preparation and follow-up materials
* Contribute to RFP and RFI responses on MAX (a regular part of the role, though not its core focus)
* Contribute to pilot design and success criteria, and help prepare pilot results readouts
* Represent MAX at industry events, client workshops and joint sessions with Kearney
* Capture client reactions and objections after each demo and share them with the Director, Product and Marketing

**Qualifications**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years in B2B software, consulting or procurement/supply chain, including 3+ years in presales, solution consulting, product specialist or demo roles
* Proven ability to deliver polished, client-specific demos to senior business audiences
* Working knowledge of procurement, sourcing or supply chain, from practice, consulting or selling into those functions
* Strong storytelling and visual communication skills, with a track record of building high-quality decks and collateral
* Comfort explaining AI and analytics platforms in plain business terms, or the curiosity and ability to build that quickly
* Excellent written and spoken English, and experience working with clients across multiple cultures and regions

**Nice-to-have**

* Background in procurement tech (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer) or procurement intelligence
* Consulting experience in operations or procurement
* Industry exposure to pharma/life sciences/chemicals or CPG

fbff2f1d.title: Senior Technical Architect
fbff2f1d.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
We are a virtual-first company, and your primary work experience will be virtual / working from your home, when not traveling to customer or prospect facilities in this specific role. Occasional travel to a physical office may be required to enhance working relationships, collaboration, design, strategy, and alignment.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced and seasoned technology professional to join us as a Senior Technical Solution Architect within our Presales / Sales Engineering organization. In this highly customer-facing role, you will lead and sustain advanced technical exchanges with key prospects and global enterprise customers, translating complex requirements into robust, secure, and scalable integration solutions. You will specialize in Application-to-Application (A2A), Business-to-Business (B2B) or EDI, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integrations, driving technical win strategies and bridging enterprise platforms with next-generation cognitive systems.
  
  
If you are a deep integration expert skilled in customer engagement, modern enterprise middleware, API strategies, and AI Agent integration layers, this is the perfect opportunity to drive significant impact across our presales engagements and global enterprise sales cycle.
  
  
In addition, you will serve as the technical authority during presales discoveries, architectural workshops, and solution demonstrations, partnering closely with sales leadership and business consultants. You will be providing customer-driven feedback to Product R&D as well.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Technical Discovery & Customer Exchanges: Conduct deep-dive technical discovery sessions, lead advanced architectural exchanges with prospective clients, and articulate complex enterprise integration strategies to key business and technical stakeholders.
* Integrate via Enterprise Tools: Architect enterprise-grade integrations, based on our QAD Integration Platform and through middleware, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), and ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) platforms.
* Master Protocols & API Layers: Design robust integration via API and protocol layers utilizing REST APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and other modern communication frameworks.
* Demonstrate Integration Platform and AI Solutions: Present and demonstrate advanced integration capabilities with 3rd party applications and AI Agents, cognitive workflows to client executives and technical panels.
* Presales Partnership: Partner directly with Account Executives and Business Consultants to respond to complex RFPs/RFIs, address technical objections, validate solution feasibility, and ensure seamless handoffs to Implementation Services.
* Create Architectural Blueprints: Develop, maintain, and own high-quality technical diagrams, data-flow schemas, and system topology designs for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployments.
* Engage C-Level Stakeholders: Direct and lead deep technical discovery and architectural discussions with top-tier prospects, customers, and key enterprise executives.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Experience**

* Advanced Integration Skills: 10+ years of professional experience in technical solutions architecture, system integration, or software engineering.
* Cloud & SaaS Expertise: Proven experience managing and architecting within Cloud and SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of security protocols, data privacy, and compliance.
* A2A, B2B & B2G Expertise: Deep, hands-on knowledge of Application-to-Application (A2A) flows, Business-to-Business (B2B) standards, and Business-to-Government (B2G) integration frameworks
* AI Integration Layer Mastery: Strong capability and current technical knowledge of AI Agent integration layers, large language model (LLM) orchestration pipelines, and cognitive agent frameworks.
* API & Protocols: Full command of RESTful APIs, SOAP, web services, microservices design patterns, and routing topologies.
* Enterprise Tooling: Mastery of middleware platforms (e.g., Boomi, MuleSoft, or equivalent), ETL, and ESB systems.
* ERP Landscapes: Strong familiarity with manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial enterprise software landscapes is highly desirable.
* Exceptional Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical jargon into business value for C-level executives.
* Customer Engagement & Presales Track Record: Proven experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles, delivering compelling technical demonstrations, and leading architectural workshops for customer stakeholders.
* Language Proficiency: Excellent English (verbal and written)

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent professional qualifications.
* Relevant industry certifications (PMP, Boomi/MuleSoft Architect, AI/LLM Engineering, or AWS/Azure Solution Architect) are highly valued.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well-being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.

**Compensation Package**

* Compensation will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
* Local country-based benefits package.

**About QAD**
**Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set.**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager (Sr TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data / Analytics, Application-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers, working alongside the broader dedicated account team. If you wish to be at the forefront of customer strategies and innovation, come join us!

A day in the life
  
  
A TAM's daily activities involve managing complex technical and critical service events while serving as the principal technical advisor for enterprise customers. They spend their time partnering with customers to optimize AWS usage, tracking operational issues, managing feature requests and launches, while also working directly with internal AWS teams to exceed customer expectations.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, they provide strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, while keeping their customers' AWS environments operationally healthy.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

1c68a753.title: Architect
1c68a753.description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

Platform Architect, Developer Productivity

**The role**
------------

You will set the multi-year architecture for Myntra’s developer platform: the CI/CD, environments, tooling, and AI-assisted engineering workflows that every engineering team builds on. You will be the final authority on trade-offs between developer experience, reliability, security, and cost. The goal is to make shipping fast, safe, and cheap for engineers across Myntra, and to measure it by outcomes rather than activity. You will own the platform blueprint across multiple product areas, not just one, and will weigh emerging technology trends against long-term business goals.

  
  

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Define the architecture and roadmap for a unified internal developer platform, with paved paths for build, test, deploy, observe, and operate. The platform should support 10x scale.
* Own the architecture blueprint across product areas. Unify duplicated patterns, tooling, and service hops into shared platforms, and remove silos between teams.
* Turn vague developer pain points, such as slow pipelines, environment sprawl, and on-call toil, into clear problems and technical directions, and drive them to shipped systems.
* Decide which problems matter at division scale and which to ignore, and drive major technology decisions to closure across product areas.
* Set the standard for AI-assisted engineering across the division: agent workflows, secure prompting, AI code review and verification, and token/compute governance.
* Define AI-native engineering paradigms for the division, including how autonomous agents are used, supervised, and kept within safe boundaries.
* Make build vs. buy vs. offload calls on tooling (including AI tools) using cost data. Replace expensive vendor tools with leaner internal or open-source ones where the numbers support it.
* Establish observability, SLO, and chaos-engineering standards that reduce org-wide MTTR. Design for graceful degradation and BCP.
* Design platforms that are self-healing and debuggable by design, remove single points of failure, and isolate heavy AI/compute workloads from core traffic.
* Own FinOps and security guardrails for platform services, including zero-trust, data privacy, and responsible-AI boundaries.
* Set division-wide compliance, security, and cost-governance standards, and balance large multi-cloud infrastructure investments against their return.
* Measure developer productivity with SPACE and DORA, not PR or line counts. Cover satisfaction, flow, and cognitive load as well as delivery speed.
* Act as the DRI across teams. Resolve cross-functional impasses by speaking both technical and business language, and advise VPs and managers.
* Represent the platform in executive and external technical forums.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.
* Mentor and sponsor other architects, and build mentorship frameworks that scale beyond your direct network.
* Mentor senior engineers and sponsor named people into larger roles.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* Deep experience architecting large-scale platforms, such as cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and internal developer platforms.
* Strong grounding in distributed systems design, SRE practice (SLIs/SLOs, incident response, RCA discipline), and Kubernetes, IaC, and multi-region/hybrid-cloud resilience.
* Hands-on fluency with AI IDEs and agents, plus judgment on verifying AI output, building evals, and modelling inference cost.
* Track record of adoption: platforms and standards that teams outside your own use, not slide-deck architecture.
* Cost and risk judgment, including cloud/GPU capacity planning and data-privacy compliance.
* Excellent communication, with the ability to make the final call when a group is stuck and keep trust.
* Experience owning architecture across multiple product areas or a whole division, including multi-million-dollar infrastructure decisions.
* A record of developing other architects and tech leads.

c37452b9.title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
c37452b9.description:
### **When you join Verizon**

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**

* **Type of Work:** Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* **Expected Volumes:** Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* **Risk & Criticality:** Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

### **What we’re looking for...**

* **Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership:** Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* **Automation Scoping & Strategy:** Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* **Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding:** Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* **Solution Architecture & Validation:** Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* **Mentorship:** Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* **4 to 6 years** of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* **Advanced Networking Knowledge:** Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* **Automation Acumen:** Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* **Cloud Integration:** Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* **Presentation Skills:** Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

### **Where you’ll be working**

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

### **Equal Employment Opportunity**

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital health technologies are transforming healthcare by enabling innovative solutions that enhance health system efficiency, service delivery, and patient outcomes, contributing to the achievement of Universal Health Coverage (UHC) and the health-related Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

The Government of Chhattisgarh has formally requested WHO-SEARO's technical support to develop and implement a roadmap for UHC and health-related SDGs in the state. This collaboration was advanced through the Joint Consultative Meeting for the Development and Implementation of UHC and Health SDG Roadmaps in Chhattisgarh and Madhya Pradesh (Bhopal, April 2026) and the Swasth Chhattisgarh Consultation (Raipur, June 2026). Digital health and AI constitute a cross-cutting enabler of the state's UHC acceleration agenda, with implementation to be intensified in designated beacon districts alongside statewide efforts.

As part of this agenda, WHO-SEARO is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh on the state's digital health action plan, the evaluation of AI tools in health — including SAKSHAMA and other AI applications proposed to be taken forward for evaluation in the state — and the scale-up of digital health innovations. Intelehealth is supporting the Government of Chhattisgarh and WHO-SEARO in operationalising telemedicine, digital health, and AI interventions in the state, including under an Agreement for Performance of Work (APW) with WHO.

The Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will be Intelehealth's dedicated in-state resource, based in Raipur, to coordinate digital health and AI interventions across Chhattisgarh — including AI evaluations and digital health innovations — working in close collaboration with WHO-SEARO's Digital Health team and the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh.

Under the supervision of the designated lead at Intelehealth and in close collaboration with WHO-SEARO's Digital Health team , the Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will undertake the following responsibilities:

* Serve as the state-level project coordinator for digital health and AI interventions supported by WHO-SEARO and Intelehealth in Chhattisgarh, at the state level and in the designated beacon districts, under the state's UHC and health-SDG acceleration agenda.
* Support the Government of Chhattisgarh in the development, refinement, and implementation of the state's Digital Health and AI roadmap/action plan, ensuring alignment with the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), national digital health standards (including HL7 FHIR), and WHO guidance.
* Coordinate the design, protocol development, ethics and regulatory processes, field operations, and reporting of AI evaluations in the state — including the evaluation of SAKSHAMA and other AI tools taken forward for evaluation in Chhattisgarh — in collaboration with government counterparts, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders.
* Coordinate the implementation and scale-up of digital health innovations in the state, including telemedicine (hub-and-spoke models and eSanjeevani last-mile strengthening), AI-enabled screening and decision-support tools, and digital platforms for maternal and child health, communicable diseases, and NCDs.
* Support the operationalisation of digital health and AI activities under the WHO–Intelehealth workplans, including readiness assessments, capacity building of frontline health workers and medical officers, and support to the NHM Programme Management Unit.
* Provide expert technical advice to the Department of Health and Family Welfare, NHM, and State Health Systems Resource Centre on program objectives, execution options, and implementation plans for digital health and AI.
* Support the framing and application of context-appropriate frameworks by which AI models are evaluated for accuracy, safety, usability, equity, and cost-effectiveness, and the pathways by which promising AI applications transition from proofs-of-concept to scaled, sustainable deployments in the state.
* Establish and maintain monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and progress reports to track digital health and AI implementation in the state and beacon districts, and its contribution to health outcomes and equity.
* Facilitate coordination across stakeholders — state government, technology partners, evaluation partners, academic institutions, and funders — including organising review meetings, workshops, and field visits.
* Develop and deliver training programs, workshops, and capacity-building initiatives to enhance digital health and AI literacy among state and district health officials and frontline workers.
* Conduct research and analysis on emerging digital health and AI trends, opportunities, and challenges relevant to Chhattisgarh to inform state policy and programming.
* Contribute to knowledge-sharing and documentation of best practices through reports, publications, presentations, and digital platforms.
* rovide technical assistance on digital health and AI-related projects as required by Intelehealth and WHO-SEARO.

**Over a 12-month period, the Senior Digital Health & AI Project Coordinator will:**

* Coordinate and support the completion of the SAKSHAMA evaluation in Chhattisgarh, including finalised evaluation protocol, ethics/regulatory clearances, field data collection, and evaluation report.
* Coordinate and support additional AI evaluations taken forward in the state, with agreed protocols, implementation plans, and progress reports for each.
* Support finalisation and phased implementation of the Chhattisgarh Digital Health and AI roadmap/action plan, with a costed workplan for the state and beacon districts.
* Deliver quarterly progress reports and dashboards on digital health and AI implementation in the state and beacon districts, shared with the Government of Chhattisgarh, WHO-SEARO, and Intelehealth.
* Support the operationalisation of telemedicine and digital health interventions, including readiness assessments, training completion reports, and documentation of hub-and-spoke operationalisation.
* Develop capacity-building materials and facilitate training sessions on digital health and AI applications for state and district health officials and frontline workers.
* Document and disseminate best practices and lessons learned from digital health and AI implementation in Chhattisgarh, including at least two knowledge products (case studies, policy briefs, or presentations).
* Facilitate and assist in organising state-level review meetings and at least one state workshop on digital health and AI.

### **Requirements**

**Education Qualification :**

* **Essential:** Master's degree in data science, public health, computer science, engineering, mathematics, law, or a related field with 5+ years of combined education and experience in health and technology development/application
* **Desirable:** Additional degree or specialized training in artificial intelligence, data science, or health informatics.

**Prior Experience:**

**Essential:**

* Excellent executive presence and upward communication skills with senior officials like IAS in the Government Systems.
* Liasoning with the senior IAS officials in the Government systems, senior executives in the
* At least 4 years of experience working on digital and AI projects or delivering data science applications in health services.
* Experience in developing conceptual frameworks, policy proposals, or strategic plans for digital and AI and data science.
* Direct experience in advising on the technical implementation of digital, AI and data science in health systems.
* Experience in having supported the development, testing, launch, or actual scale-up of any AI-based technology. Experience in technology assessment and product development is an advantage.
* Collaborative track record of partnering with governments, Ministries of Health, NGOs, academic institutions, and global funders, particularly in the Global South, including playing a technical advisory role.
* Demonstrated program or project management expertise: from work plan concept development through implementation, with strong organizational and prioritization skills.
* Attention to detail, including the ability to scrutinize budgets against work plans and deliverables.

**Desirable:**

* Experience of working with state governments in India, particularly with the National Health Mission and state health departments
* Working knowledge of Hindi and familiarity with the Chhattisgarh health system context

**Skills:**

* Proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) at an advanced level.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing digital & AI initiatives in health.
* Strong knowledge of digital & AI applications for public health innovation and health system strengthening.

**Ideal Persona:**

7c5e57a8.title: Senior Program Manager, Seller Fees Science & Tech
7c5e57a8.description:
**Description**
The Fee Strategy Operations team is seeking an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Program Manager to drive cross-functional go-to-market (GTM) execution for fee and incentive launches across Amazon's worldwide marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution—partnering with Fee Strategy, Product, Operations, Legal, Seller Communications, and regional stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of fee/incentive changes to Sellers globally. This role provides the unique opportunity of managing billion dollar incentive programs across stores and drive seller success.
  
  
Our environment is fast-paced and demands a self-starter who is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable navigating ambiguity across multiple teams, partners, and levels of management. You will own end-to-end program delivery, understand business problems at a strategic level, and have the ability to prevent or mitigate the consequences of poor business decisions. As the program owner, you will look at the bigger business picture, drive outcomes by understanding relevant business requirements, and deliver results with minimal oversight.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Partner with worldwide cross-functional teams to align GTM strategy, timelines, and deliverables for fee and incentive launches and changes. Collaborate closely with Fee Strategy Product Managers to understand GTM requirements, translate them into actionable work-backwards plans, and drive execution of GTM activities across all fee/incentive types. Act as the primary liaison between Fee Strategy and WW partner teams—Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Science, Seller Communications, Reporting, and Operations—to track, report, and monitor launch readiness, central content readiness, country teams' readiness, announcement plans, and cross-team alignment. Develop working-backwards plans and establish mechanisms to track, monitor, and report on GTM execution and launch readiness.
  
  
GTM Execution & Content Management
  
  
Identify and deliver updates to Seller-facing communications (SeCe), partnering with Country Fees POCs and partner teams to prepare and align on internal content and readiness for launches and changes. Manage end-to-end delivery of content updates for BRDs, TRDs, ARDs, Help Pages, Paragon SOPs, and country/partner teams' internal readiness for all fee/incentive types, following the GTM Launch Playbook. Maintain a centralized repository of Seller-facing content resources and internal launch documentation, managing ongoing content updates throughout the year while ensuring accuracy and version control.
  
  
Process Development & Operational Excellence
  
  
Build and implement program mechanisms to drive GTM execution, collect Seller Voice of Seller (VOS) feedback, define program performance metrics, synthesize insights, and share actionable summaries with product teams. Perform fee/incentive change validation activities, report observations and discrepancies to Product and Tech teams, and drive resolution to closure.
  
  
Program Leadership
  
  
Execute high-priority, cross-functional, high-impact projects self-sufficiently with minimal oversight. Solve complex, ambiguous problems independently by applying sound judgment, data-driven analysis, and structured thinking. Identify process gaps and proactively propose scalable solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational risk. Analyze the overall program performance and drive program roadmap with product.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Program Manager in Fee Strategy Operations, you operate at the intersection of strategy and execution. Your day involves leading cross-functional syncs with Fee Strategy PMs, Country Fees POCs, GPO, Legal, Seller Communications, and Operations to align on launch readiness, resolve blockers, and confirm content and announcement timelines across regions. You manage hands-on deliverables—reviewing and updating Help Pages and Paragon SOPs in the centralized content repository, tracking program documentation completion and updates, performing fee change validations against Seller-facing surfaces, and escalating discrepancies to Tech/Product teams for resolution. Equally, you invest time in building scalable mechanisms—developing work-backwards plans for newly approved fee/incentive changes, synthesizing Seller VOS feedback into actionable insights for product teams, and refining the GTM playbook based on lessons learned from prior cycles. You independently manage ambiguity across 6+ partner teams spanning multiple geographies, drive cross-functional alignment without authority, and deliver results with minimal oversight—balancing strategic coordination with operational rigor every single day. You monitor the performance of the program, identify gaps, and work with country team to improve key conversion and selection metric.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 4+ years of developing program strategies and plans, diving execution, and influencing senior stakeholders experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
* Experience managing competing priorities across a wide range of stakeholders
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Experience with go-to-market planning, launch execution, or operational readiness programs

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

As a
**Senior Program Manager**
for the Productivity Engineering team at

Your primary focus will be leading end-to-end program lifecycles, managing cross-functional delivery, and optimizing performance across the entire enterprise portfolio.

In this role, you will actively lead cross-functional program management initiatives, define core project requirements, and drive complex strategic programs to timely completion. You will align key program metrics with leadership objectives, oversee portfolio health, and support secondary operational areas such as productivity tooling and SaaS license oversight where needed.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

c9c4786a.title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
c9c4786a.description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.

524e62e9.title: Senior Demo Platform Architect
524e62e9.description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Demo Platform Architect – Contact Center and Customer Experience**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Demo Platform Engineer with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX suites, preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS. This role will own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of shared demo environments and reusable customer service use cases. The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise, strong operational ownership, and independent decision-making to ensure demo environments remain reliable, current, scalable, and ready to support both internal teams and occasional customer-facing engagements.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Own and Optimize Demo Environments – Maintain reliable, scalable, secure, and high-quality shared demo environments leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk.
* Develop New Demo Use Cases – Design and build compelling, reusable demonstrations that showcase contact center, customer experience, AI, automation, analytics, and integration capabilities.
* Support Custom Demo Requests – Partner with presales specialists and architects to develop opportunity-specific configurations, integrations, workflows, and demonstrations.
* Maintain Product and Release Readiness – Track Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and related technology releases and incorporate relevant capabilities into the demo portfolio.
* Drive Automation and Standardization – Develop reusable components, templates, deployment processes, and automation to improve the speed and consistency of demo delivery.
* Ensure Security, Governance, and Best Practices – Maintain appropriate access controls, data standards, platform governance, cost management, and technical quality across demo environments.
* Support Customer-Facing Activities – Occasionally participate in customer demonstrations, proof of concepts (PoCs), technical discussions, and presentations for prospects and clients.
* Develop Technical Documentation and Demo Collateral – Create technical guides, setup instructions, troubleshooting documentation, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, and internal enablement materials.
* Engage with Vendors and Partners – Work closely with AWS, Zendesk, and other partners to remain aligned with product capabilities, best practices, and technology advancements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Demo Platform Ownership: Define and execute the technical vision for shared demo environments, proactively identifying improvements, resolving issues, and ensuring environments remain available and ready for use.
* Demo Design and Development: Build compelling end-to-end contact center demonstrations leveraging Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS services to showcase customer experience, agent productivity, AI, automation, and operational performance.
* Integration Management: Design and maintain integrations between Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS, and other enterprise systems to support realistic workflows, consistent data, and reusable demo scenarios.
* Custom Demo Support: Work with presales specialists and architects to understand opportunity requirements and deliver tailored demonstrations while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets for the wider team.
* Technical Oversight: Establish and maintain high standards for demo architecture, configuration, testing, security, documentation, reliability, and overall presentation quality.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage with internal teams, business leaders, product specialists, engineering teams, customers, and external partners to gather requirements, propose solutions, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver effective demonstrations.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Stay ahead of product releases, industry trends, and emerging technologies in contact center platforms, AI, and automation, applying them to continuously improve the demo portfolio.
* Independent Execution: Establish priorities, manage multiple concurrent requests, make informed decisions, and deliver outcomes without requiring detailed day-to-day direction.
* Governance: Establish and enforce governance frameworks for security, access control, data management, cost optimization, platform reliability, and lifecycle management of demo environments.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or Business Administration - or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum of 8–10 years in solution engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, software development, or a related technical field, with at least 5 years of experience in contact center technologies, including Amazon Connect and CRM/CX technologies, preferably Zendesk.
* Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in designing, implementing, and supporting scalable solutions using a CRM/CX platform, Amazon Connect, AWS Lambda, Amazon AI Agents (Bedrock), Amazon Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and other AWS services. We will rank you higher if you have experience or exposure to Python and/or NodeJS.
* Demo Development: Demonstrated experience creating technical demonstrations, reusable use cases, prototypes, proof of concepts, or reference implementations that translate technical capabilities into compelling business scenarios.
* Platform Management: Experience maintaining shared technical environments, managing releases and configuration changes, troubleshooting complex issues, and proactively improving platform availability and reliability.
* Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to operate with ownership, take initiative, work independently, influence cross-functional teams, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced and globally distributed environment.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions, collaborate across time zones, and articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of investigating root causes, making sound decisions with incomplete information, and developing scalable solutions to complex challenges.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent credentials in contact center platforms.
* Industry Knowledge: Experience designing and demonstrating omnichannel contact center solutions, including voice, chat, messaging, AI-driven automation, agent assistance, Workforce Engagement Management, including workforce and quality management, and contact center reporting and analytics tools.
* Customer Engagement: Experience delivering technical demonstrations, supporting customer discussions, and responding to detailed technical questions during customer or prospect engagements.
* Agile Methodologies: Experience working within Agile and DevOps frameworks, including source control, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and repeatable deployment practices.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.

Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.

  + Staffing estimates
  + Cost models
  + Performance targets
  + Service level commitments

* Define governance, reporting, and continuous improvement frameworks.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale RFP responses and competitive pursuits.
* Strong understanding of F&A process areas and operating models.
* Experience building staffing, productivity, and financial models using benchmark data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

ABB Installation Products Division (formerly Thomas&Betts), helps manage the connection, protection and distribution of electrical power from source to socket. **The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both**

  

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

  

**What the week contains**

  

Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.

  

**The uncomfortable part**

  

Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

  

**Looking for**

  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering or a customer-facing technical role
* Enough hands-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience

  

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

  

*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer-facing engineering roles here.*
