ae3a2be4.title: Lead Specialist, Solution Architect
ae3a2be4.description:
Lead Specialist, Solution Architect - OnVUE

  
  

About OnVUE

  
  

OnVUE is Pearson’s online proctored test delivery platform, supporting the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of assessments for Pearson’s certification and professional testing business. The platform enables candidates to test remotely while maintaining exam integrity through identity verification, monitoring, secure delivery workflows, and operational controls. The OnVUE environment includes modern and legacy systems, with ongoing focus on platform modernization, service resilience, API-first integration, cloud-native delivery, candidate and proctor experience, and improved developer and operational practices.

  
  

Role summary

  
  

As a Lead Specialist, Solution Architect, you are a recognized subject-matter expert who provides technical leadership for sophisticated, high-impact solution work. You independently translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into secure, scalable, viable, and maintainable architectural models and guide solution delivery from inception through implementation.

  
  

You maintain technical consistency within the assigned scope, balance advanced solution design with hands-on support for complex delivery challenges, and resolve day-to-day integration and build issues. You influence through depth of knowledge, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to steer architecture discussions toward practical outcomes. You mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers, establish trusted technical patterns within your domain, ensure conformance to established frameworks, and escalate decisions that materially exceed the assigned scope to senior experts.

  
  

Key responsibilities

  
  

Solution architecture and technical leadership

  

  
* Translate business needs, stakeholder constraints, and technical requirements into robust architectural models and fit-for-purpose solution designs.
  
  
* Own solution architecture from discovery and design through implementation and production adoption.
  
  
* Provide technical leadership for high-impact projects, major features, product changes, services, domains, or business capabilities.
  
  
* Maintain technical consistency within the assigned product, service, project, domain, or broader solution footprint.
  
  
* Evaluate and communicate tradeoffs involving scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, integration, delivery risk, operational needs, and business value.
  

  

Implementation and delivery guidance

  

  
* Guide engineering and delivery teams through implementation while preserving architectural intent.
  
  
* Resolve complex architectural, integration, and build issues within the assigned scope.
  
  
* Consult on technical feasibility for major features, updates, integrations, and solution approaches.
  
  
* Identify high-stakes architectural risks early and coordinate practical mitigation.
  
  
* Adapt architecture to changing requirements without sacrificing solution stability, security, or long-term maintainability.
  

  

Standards, influence, and capability building

  

  
* Establish trusted and repeatable technical patterns within the assigned domain while ensuring conformance with established architecture frameworks, standards, and guidelines.
  
  
* Participate in architecture forums and guide discussions toward sound, practical outcomes.
  
  
* Mentor engineers, junior architects, and peers in solution design, technical practices, and architectural decision-making.
  
  
* Communicate design options, recommendations, constraints, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
* Escalate decisions outside the assigned scope or requiring senior technical or enterprise direction.
  

  

Required education and experience

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
* Progressive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a related technical discipline.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience designing sophisticated solutions and guiding delivery from inception through implementation.
  
  
* Experience translating business needs and technical constraints into secure, scalable, maintainable architecture.
  
  
* Experience influencing architecture and delivery outcomes without formal authority.
  

  

Desired knowledge, skills, and abilities

  

  
* Strong solution architecture, system design, integration, and technical problem-solving skills.
  
  
* Ability to evaluate solution options and explain tradeoffs across business value, delivery feasibility, risk, and long-term technology health.
  
  
* Working knowledge of Java-based enterprise application stacks, cloud-native design, APIs, microservices, event-driven integration, containers, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, security, data consistency, and operational readiness.
  
  
* Practical familiarity with service decomposition, API gateway patterns, versioned API contracts, distributed tracing, messaging, data-driven backend systems, and headless or decoupled front-end and back-end architecture patterns.
  
  
* Strong documentation, facilitation, communication, and influencing skills.
  
  
* Ability to mentor others and introduce trusted, repeatable technical approaches.
  

  

Success measures

  

  
* Architecture artifacts are clear, fit for purpose, timely, and enable secure, scalable, stable implementation.
  
  
* Solution designs are adopted successfully, integrate effectively, and remain durable in production.
  
  
* Design choices minimize avoidable rework, support business continuity, and reduce preventable technical risk.
  
  
* Technical blockers and high-stakes architectural risks are identified and resolved or escalated in time to protect delivery.
  
  
* Documentation and quality standards are met with limited revision cycles.
  
  
* Repeatable technical approaches, mentorship, and knowledge transfer improve team effectiveness.
  
  
* Stakeholders trust the role to explain design options, constraints, and tradeoffs and to guide solution delivery.

**Role & responsibilities**

Seeking an experienced **IBM MQ Engineer / Architect** with strong containerization and Kubernetes knowledge to lead the migration of IBM MQ workloads from Amazon EC2 to Amazon EKS. The role will own assessment, target-state design, migration planning, build, testing, cutover, and post-migration stabilization for a secure, highly available, and observable IBM MQ platform running on Kubernetes.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

* Assess the current IBM MQ estate running on EC2, including queue managers, channels, clustering, HA/DR setup, storage, security, monitoring, and dependencies.
* Define the target architecture for IBM MQ on EKS, including container strategy, namespace design, networking, persistent storage, secrets handling, and high availability.
* Design and implement IBM MQ containerization patterns using Docker/OCI images and Kubernetes-native deployment approaches.
* Build and manage deployment automation for IBM MQ on EKS using Helm, Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code where applicable.
* Plan and execute migration from EC2 to EKS with minimal disruption, including environment setup, data persistence strategy, queue manager migration, rollback planning, and cutover support.
* Configure persistent volumes, storage classes, backup, restore, and disaster recovery for stateful IBM MQ workloads on Kubernetes.
* Implement security controls including TLS, certificate management, IAM integration, secrets management, encryption, and platform hardening.
* Partner with application, middleware, infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to validate connectivity, performance, and production readiness.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability for IBM MQ on EKS using enterprise tooling.
* Tune performance, capacity, and resilience characteristics for containerized MQ workloads.
* Produce architecture documents, runbooks, SOPs, migration plans, and operational handover materials.
* Support hypercare and post-production stabilization after migration.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of hands-on experience with IBM MQ administration and engineering.
* Strong experience with IBM MQ queue managers, channels, listeners, clustering, client connectivity, SSL/TLS, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience containerizing middleware platforms, ideally IBM MQ.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, including pods, StatefulSets, services, ingress/network policies, volumes, config maps, secrets, and RBAC.
* Experience migrating stateful enterprise workloads from virtual machines or EC2 to Kubernetes.
* Strong understanding of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, EKS, VPC, IAM, EBS/EFS, load balancing, Route 53, CloudWatch, and security controls.
* Experience with CI/CD and automation tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Terraform, Ansible, or similar.
* Knowledge of Linux administration, shell scripting, and container runtime concepts.
* Experience with monitoring and logging platforms such as Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, Dynatrace, or AppDynamics.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across middleware, OS, networking, storage, and cloud layers.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with IBM MQ Operator or similar Kubernetes-native operational models.
* Prior experience designing HA/DR for IBM MQ on Kubernetes.
* Experience with service mesh, certificate automation, and secrets platforms such as HashiCorp Vault.
* Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns involving IBM MQ, APIs, microservices, and event-driven systems.
* Exposure to regulated environments with strong audit, security, and resiliency requirements.
* Experience with OpenShift is a plus.

30025624.title: Privileged Access & Identity Security Architect - Entra ID
30025624.description:
**Role summary**

  

You will own how identity and privileged access are designed and governed across a hybrid Microsoft estate. As part of a zero-trust program, and building on lessons from recent identity incidents, you will define a tightened privileged access model in Entra ID and on-prem AD, set the policies and standards, and hold teams to them through reviews and governance. You are the policy owner and design authority; platform teams implement and operate under your direction.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

  

**Privileged access architecture**

  

* Design and own the privileged access model based on Microsoft's Enterprise Access Model (control, management and user/workload planes), covering Entra ID and on-prem AD.
* Define standards for Privileged Identity Management (PIM): just-in-time, time-bound elevation, approval workflows, justification, MFA on activation, and PIM for Groups.
* Minimize standing privilege: remove permanent Global Administrator and other high-impact role assignments, apply least-privilege and custom roles, and use administrative units and restricted management where suitable.
* Define emergency access (break-glass) accounts, privileged access workstation requirements and secure admin pathways.

  

**Identity controls and zero trust**

* Design the Conditional Access framework: baseline policies, admin-specific policies, device compliance, location and risk conditions, authentication strengths and session controls.
* Drive phishing-resistant authentication (FIDO2 keys, passkeys, Windows Hello for Business, certificate-based authentication) for all privileged users.
* Use Entra ID Protection user and sign-in risk signals, and define responses to risky identities.
* Govern hybrid identity: Entra Connect / Cloud Sync security, AD tiering, Tier 0 protection and hardening against common AD attacks.

  

**Non-human and workload identities**

* Set policy for service principals, managed identities, app registrations and enterprise apps: ownership, credential hygiene, secret and certificate rotation, and workload identity federation in place of secrets.
* Control application consent and high-privilege API permissions (for example, Microsoft Graph) to block consent phishing and over-privileged apps.
* Govern on-prem service accounts and group Managed Service Accounts.

  

**Identity governance and review policies**

* Design and run access reviews for privileged roles, groups, guest users and applications, with clear reviewers, cadence and auto-remediation.
* Define joiner-mover-leaver controls with Entra ID Governance (entitlement management, access packages, lifecycle workflows).
* Maintain identity security policies, standards and exceptions; align with ISO 27001, DPDP Act and healthcare/GxP audit requirements.
* Report identity risk and control health: standing privilege counts, PIM adoption, phishing-resistant MFA coverage, review completion and stale accounts.

  

**Incident support**

* Act as identity expert in incidents involving compromised accounts, token theft, privilege escalation or malicious consent, and lead the identity root cause and control fixes.

  

**Must-have skills**

* 10+ years in IAM/identity security, with deep Entra ID and Active Directory security expertise.
* Proven design and rollout of PIM, Conditional Access and access reviews at enterprise scale.
* Strong understanding of identity attacks (AiTM phishing, token replay, consent phishing, Kerberos attacks, DCSync) and the controls that stop them.
* Hybrid identity architecture: Entra Connect / Cloud Sync, AD tiering and Tier 0 protection.
* Experience writing identity policies and standards and winning adoption from IT and business teams.
* Strong documentation and stakeholder communication.

  

**Good to have**

* Entra ID Governance (entitlement management, lifecycle workflows) and Entra ID Protection in production.
* Identity threat detection tooling (for example, CrowdStrike Falcon Identity Protection or Microsoft Defender for Identity).
* Automation with Microsoft Graph and PowerShell for identity reporting.
* Experience in regulated industries, ideally healthcare or pharma.
* Certifications: SC-300, SC-100, AZ-500, CISSP, or equivalent.
* Looking for Immediate Joiners

  

**What success looks like in 12 months**

* No permanent Global Administrators outside break-glass accounts; all privileged roles eligible through PIM.
* 100% of privileged users on phishing-resistant authentication.
* Quarterly access reviews running for all privileged roles, with completion tracked.
* Workload identities inventoried, owned, and moved off long-lived secrets where possible.

Next

6497fd70.title: Enterprise Architect
6497fd70.description:
Position Summary
  
  
As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  
  
In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
  
  
You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
  
  
As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
  
  

* Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
* Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
* Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
* Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
  
  

* Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
* Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
* See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
* Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.

Lead Enterprise Architecture Build
  
  

* Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
* Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
* Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
* Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
* Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.

Drive Alignment and Transformation
  
  

* Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
* Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
* Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
* Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.

Influence and Encourage
  
  

* Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
* Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
* Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
* Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.

Contribute to Adobe's Growth
  
  

* Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
* Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
* Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
* Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
* Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
* Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
* Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
* Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills, with the ability to influence decision-making across organizations.
* Experience collaborating with software engineers, data architects, application developers, data scientists, and business leaders to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead through influence and drive alignment across diverse teams and functions.
* Willingness to travel up to 50%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Adobe Experience Cloud and Adobe Experience Platform tools.
* Experience working with digital marketing, customer experience, customer data, or personalization platforms.
* Knowledge of customer journey orchestration, decisioning, and real-time activation strategies.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.

At Adobe, you'll do meaningful work alongside outstanding individuals who are passionate about innovation, creativity, and customer success. We are dedicated to helping our employees grow, thrive, and make an impact through continuous feedback, learning opportunities, and career development.
  
  
If you're ready to build the future of digital experiences and assist organizations in transforming through data, AI, and cloud technologies, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**About Adobe**
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  
Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**Let’s Adobe together**
At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  
Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
  
  
Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
  
  
**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.
  
  
At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience.

As part of a high-impact team within our Commercial Strategy group, you will lead client engagements spanning real-time monitoring, deep-dive analyses, and executive-level workshops that shape critical decisions across drug development and commercialization.
  
  
With strong mentorship, visible leadership opportunities, and a collaborative, expert-driven culture, Trinity CI offers a unique platform to accelerate your career while making a meaningful impact on therapies that improve patients’ lives.
  
  
**Do You Have Experience In And a Passion For**

* Supporting clients who deliver life-changing and life-saving therapies?
* Delivering high-quality, impactful client work?
* Leading and managing strategic projects?

If so, Trinity could be the right place to grow your career and influence decisions that truly matter.

People Management

Business Development

Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree preferred.

ef8a5594.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
ef8a5594.description:
**Description**
Ready to do something big?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.
  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.
  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
  
  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s
  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
  
  
https://vimeo.com/80948105
  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
  
  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

3498c594.title: Program Manager
3498c594.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
3498c594.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
Systems is a global team that designs, builds, and manages the firm’s technical infrastructure, including desktops, software applications, communications platforms, conferencing tools, network connections, and internal platforms that power developer productivity and user efficiency. We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Program Manager to join the Systems PMO team in our Hyderabad office. In this role, you will drive large-scale, cross-functional programs across the Systems portfolio, with a focus on teams such as Information Security and Database Engineering. You will own the programs end to end, from shaping roadmaps and priorities through execution, rollout, adoption, and reporting. You will partner with engineering leads to engage with technology teams globally and facilitate alignment on priorities, dependencies, and risks.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
The ideal candidate will demonstrate robust communication and stakeholder management skills, sound technical judgment grounded in hands-on experience with infrastructure, security, or data systems, and the strategic thinking and program mindset needed to keep complex programs moving in a dynamic environment. You will partner with engineering leads across Systems teams, and with engineering leads and program/product managers in adjacent teams, to shape, maintain, and communicate coherent roadmaps, translating technical priorities and business needs into well-sequenced program plans while aligning on shared priorities and negotiating dependencies and sequencing. You will own large-scale programs, and their cross-functional projects end to end, from scoping and milestone definition through execution tracking, rollout, and closure, driving decisions, resolving blockers, and managing change requests on long-horizon initiatives. You will manage risks early through early-warning indicators, reach explicit mitigate-or-accept decisions with engineering leads, and escalate with a recommended course of action. You will also own program communications and user engagement, including gathering requirements and feedback, running pilots and early-adopter groups, and preparing audience-tailored documentation, and maintaining governance by keeping program plans, decision records, test plans, and acceptance criteria current and compliant with the firm's security and organizational standards. Finally, you will define success metrics and leading and lagging indicators, build dashboards that give engineering teams and senior leadership a clear view of progress, risks, and outcomes, create reusable playbooks, templates, and reporting for other program managers, and identify ways to reduce operational overhead through automation, self-service, and generative AI.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold–
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline. An MBA or an equivalent postgraduate qualification in management or a technology discipline
* 5–8 years of total experience, with at least 3 years in a technical program, project, or product management role, including hands-on experience using program and project tracking tools
* Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver large-scale, cross-functional technical programs in a globally distributed environment, across varied technical domains
* Contextual knowledge of enterprise IT infrastructure environments such as identity, security, database, and reporting platforms, with the technical fluency to engage credibly with engineering teams, ask the right questions, and make informed trade-offs
* A data analytics background with proficiency in business intelligence tools, and the ability to define how success is measured (metrics, baselines, targets) and to interrogate the underlying data to produce a clear narrative of what the numbers mean and what should happen next
* Robust analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities, with sound judgment under ambiguity and comfort with shifting priorities
* Strategic thinking and a program mindset: the ability to connect individual projects to a broader roadmap, prioritize the most critical problems first, and keep execution aligned to longer-term goals
* Robust stakeholder management: mapping stakeholders, managing expectations, and influencing outcomes across teams without direct reporting lines
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce crisp, executive-ready updates and to translate fluently in both directions between technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience working in a regulated or security-sensitive environment such as financial services
* Prior hands-on experience as a Systems, Security, or Database engineer, with a subsequent transition into a program or product management role
* Working knowledge of information security domains such as software security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, endpoint and network security, observability, security compliance, governance frameworks, and audit workflows
* Working knowledge of database and data platform concepts, including relational and NoSQL technologies, business intelligence platforms such as Power BI, high availability and disaster recovery, upgrades and migrations, and capacity and performance management
* Experience in a technology operations environment, with the ability to use operational data to identify gaps, scope projects, and build dashboards for leadership visibility
* PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or equivalent project management certification. Security management certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM) are a plus

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMOct26

* Develop and manage end-to-end project plans and ensure on-time delivery
* Partner closely with engineering and product leads to evolve Ethos' product strategy and development
* Provide hands-on program management during analysis, design, development, testing, implementation, and post implementation phases
* Drive internal process improvements within the team
* Provide day-to-day coordination for projects and tasks
* Perform the duties of a Scrum Master using agile methodologies and scrum practices
* Assist teams with having a detailed understanding of agile and scrum framework
* Participate and facilitate roadmapping, sprint planning sessions, retrospectives, demos, and scrum of scrums
* Help teams understand and balance dependencies between performance, efficiency, and product functionality
* Map dependencies and relationships between projects and teams, coordinating efforts across organizations and verticals
* Communicate status and big picture to the stakeholders and leadership
* Work independently with minimal supervision

**Qualifications And Skills**

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.

74eed501.title: Presales Consultant
74eed501.description:
**Presales Consultant – AI SaaS (Svaarico & Upranke)**

digiPanda Consulting , Experience: 2–3 years

**About us**

digiPanda is a 40+ member digital agency serving 200+ clients, and we're building our own AI products:

**• Svaarico**
– an AI voice agent platform that handles inbound and outbound calls for businesses

**• Upranke**
– tracks how brands appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity), also called GEO/AEO

**The role**

You'll own the demo stage of our sales cycle. Sales brings the lead; you understand the client's business, run a demo built around their problem, handle the hard questions, and move the deal to a trial or close.

**What you'll do**

• Run discovery calls to understand each prospect's business, current process and pain points

• Deliver tailored live demos of Svaarico and Upranke over video calls and in person

• Build custom demo setups before each call: a sample voice agent for the prospect's use case, or an Upranke visibility report on their brand

• Handle technical and commercial objections with confidence

• Prepare solution notes and proposal inputs with the sales team

• Run trials and proofs of concept, and make sure they convert

• Pass client feedback and feature requests to the product team

• Own the demo playbook: scripts, FAQs, objection handling, demo accounts

• Track demos, trials and conversion rates in the CRM

**Must-have**

• 2–3 years in SaaS presales, solutions consulting, product demos or technical sales

• A track record of demos that converted. Be ready to share numbers

• Genuine interest in AI. You already use AI tools daily and keep up with what's new

• Strong spoken English and Hindi; you can present to founders and business owners

• Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business terms

• Fast learner on new products and dashboards

**Good to have**

• Experience selling AI, telephony/calling, CRM, marketing or SEO tools

• Understanding of SEO and digital marketing, or of call-center and telephony workflows

• Exposure to selling to Indian SMBs as well as mid-market clients

• Something you've built yourself with AI tools, such as an automation or a side project

**What you get**

• Work directly with the founder on AI-native products

• Deep hands-on experience in voice AI and GEO, two of the fastest-growing spaces

• Fixed salary plus incentives on conversions

• A growth path to Presales Lead or Product roles as the team scales

**How to apply**

* Send your CV along with a 2–3 minute video demoing any SaaS or AI tool you've sold or used, the way you would pitch it to a client.

9c4d910c.description:
**Meet the Team**

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of Cisco and Splunk technology, partners, and customers—creating scalable solutions, enabling partner-led growth, and building trusted technical relationships that drive business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Global Partner Solution Engineer, you will be a strategic technical advisor to partners, customers, and internal sales teams. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help GSIs create new solutions and services, accelerate opportunities, expand within existing accounts, and differentiate Cisco and Splunk from the competition.
  
  

* Develop multi-year strategic plans with GSIs, integrating Cisco and Splunk technologies into differentiated solutions and service offerings.
* Lead technical engagements including executive discussions, customer workshops, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, and solution design activities.
* Build and mature partner technical practices and Centers of Excellence (CoEs), including enablement, certification, and activation of partner resources.
* Drive partner-led demand generation by identifying new opportunities, developing solution frameworks, and enabling cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive displacement strategies.
* Collaborate with account teams, Business Entities, product teams, and extended sales organizations to influence deal strategy, provide competitive intelligence, and translate customer and partner needs into technical requirements.
* Create scalable technical assets, demos, webinars, and other enablement content that help partners develop and deliver new solutions.
* Lead virtual technical teams through complex sales cycles, mobilizing the right resources to progress and close strategic opportunities.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer and partner stakeholders, shaping technology strategies and demonstrating the business value of Cisco and Splunk solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical sales, solutions engineering, consulting, partner engineering, or related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience designing and presenting technical solutions to customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience working across complex technology environments and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to travel up to 40%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cloud, ITOps/Observability, Security, Big Data, Edge, IoT, IIoT, or closely related domains.
* Hands-on expertise in two or more technologies including Splunk SIEM/SOAR/Platform, Cisco XDR, Talos, ThousandEyes, Meraki, Splunk Observability Cloud, AppDynamics, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Native Technologies, or Microservices Architectures.

* Proven experience delivering technical workshops, webinars, demonstrations, or presentations at external industry events.
* Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and executive stakeholders across partner and customer organizations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

d09e1185.title: Mainframe Infrastructure Integration Architect
d09e1185.description:
Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Integration Architect

**Location:** Bangalore  
**Experience:** 15+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe Infrastructure Integration Architect to lead infrastructure integration and readiness for an ACF2 to RACF migration.

The role involves ensuring seamless integration with z/OS infrastructure, Sysplex, JES2, USS, networking, storage, GDPS, HSM, automation, and operational systems. The candidate will be responsible for infrastructure readiness, system configuration impacts, IPL and fallback dependencies, disaster recovery (DR) validation, and cross-functional issue resolution while ensuring system stability, resilience, and audit readiness.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead infrastructure readiness for RACF activation and security conversion across production, disaster recovery (DR), and test environments.
* Validate z/OS parmlib/proclib, IPL processes, RACF class activation, SMF settings, system exits, started task definitions, and security-sensitive configurations.
* Manage integration impacts across JES2, USS, TCP/IP, AT-TLS, certificates, keyrings, z/OSMF, automation, scheduler interfaces, and system command authority.
* Assess storage, HSM, catalogues, GDPS, backup/restore, tape, and DR procedure impacts under the target RACF security model.
* Coordinate infrastructure service IDs, started task IDs, batch IDs, operations IDs, automation IDs, and emergency support IDs with the RACF group model.
* Define pre-IPL, post-IPL, fallback, DR, and infrastructure validation procedures for mock and production cutovers.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure authorisation failures using console logs, RACF messages, SMF, JES logs, TCP/IP logs, USS logs, IPCS, and subsystem traces.
* Review infrastructure runbooks, implementation plans, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), recovery procedures, and technical documentation.
* Ensure infrastructure monitoring, alerting, operational procedures, and escalation paths are updated for RACF-controlled operations.
* Provide infrastructure risk assessments and readiness inputs for migration go/no-go decisions.

Required Technical Skills

**1. Mainframe & z/OS Infrastructure**

* Strong knowledge of IBM z/OS, parmlib, proclib, IPL, SMF, system exits, JES2, WLM, and RMF.
* Hands-on experience with Sysplex and mainframe infrastructure architecture.

**2. Mainframe Security Integration**

* Experience with RACF security profiles and resource classes, including STARTED, SURROGAT, OPERCMDS, FACILITY, UNIXPRIV, and DIGTCERT.
* Knowledge of dataset security, certificates, and keyrings.
* Understanding of ACF2/RACF coexistence and security migration.

**3. USS & Network Infrastructure**

* Knowledge of USS, OMVS, BPX resources, TCP/IP, AT-TLS, FTP/SFTP, SSH, and keyrings.

**4. Storage & Disaster Recovery**

* Experience with SMS, HSM, catalogues, GDPS, backup/restore, tape management, and dataset profiles.
* Strong understanding of disaster recovery planning and validation.

**5. Automation & Operations**

* Experience with NetView, System Automation, scheduler interfaces, and operational procedures.

**6. Governance & Change Management**

* Experience in change control, infrastructure readiness reviews, implementation planning, fallback procedures, DR validation, and audit evidence management.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with z/OSMF, zSecure, System Automation, and GDPS tooling.
* Knowledge of Ansible for Z and Git-based configuration management.
* Exposure to AI-assisted mainframe operations.
* IBM certifications in z/OS, Parallel Sysplex, RACF, GDPS, or storage technologies.

Experience & Qualifications

* 15+ years of experience in IBM Z infrastructure, z/OS systems programming, or mainframe infrastructure architecture.
* Strong experience with z/OS, Sysplex, JES2, USS, TCP/IP, storage, automation, and disaster recovery.
* Proven experience supporting mainframe security subsystem changes, RACF implementation, ACF2/RACF coexistence, or large-scale infrastructure migration and cutover programmes.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

9bd66d54.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect – Revenue Recognition (Oracle Fusion))
9bd66d54.description:
**Job Description Summary**
This role is part of the IT Finance Systems team and provides senior solution leadership for Revenue Recognition as GE HealthCare migrates from Oracle E-Business Suite R12 to Oracle Fusion Cloud. We are looking for a revenue accounting practitioner who has delivered multiple ERP implementations across industries and can bring leading practices that go beyond any single platform. The role shapes global solution decisions and guides controlled, scalable revenue recognition capabilities across revenue management, accounting, integrations, and reporting.
  
  
**Job Description**
**In this role, you will**

* Act as the design authority for revenue recognition: define target-state business processes and the solution architecture across contract and performance obligation management, revenue accounting, adjustments, reconciliation, close, and reporting.
* Advise Finance, Controllership, Commercial, Tax, and business leaders on leading practices in revenue accounting, drawing on experience from other industries and challenging current ways of working where a process should change rather than be configured around.
* Lead revenue recognition design for contract and transaction scenarios, including performance obligations, allocation, satisfaction events, contract modifications, variable consideration, billing-versus-revenue differences, and period-end accounting, in line with approved accounting policies under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.
* Define and govern the use and integration of Revenue Management, Subledger Accounting, General Ledger, and upstream order, billing, and commercial systems that feed revenue contracts, evaluating options and documenting trade-offs, controls, and accounting impact.
* Provide hands-on application leadership for configuration, setup validation, and prototyping, and assess downstream business, accounting, control, security, reporting, and integration impacts.
* Lead workshops, fit-gap analysis, solution confirmation, and design reviews, and manage decisions, risks, and dependencies.
* Oversee and produce high-quality functional specifications, process flows, user stories, accounting examples, mappings, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria for RICE components; guide technical teams on source-to-target mappings, event and accounting logic, interface controls, error handling, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define test strategy and lead CRP, SIT, UAT, regression, conversion, cutover, and validation of revenue contracts, revenue schedules, accounting entries, balances, and reports.
* Lead R12-to-Fusion migration and reconciliation of revenue contract, performance obligation, deferred or unearned revenue, and related accounting data.

704e0320.title: Cloud Solution Architecture - M365, Copilot
704e0320.description:
**Overview**

Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.
  
  
The Global Customer Success (GCS) organization is leading the effort to create the desired customer experience through support offer creation, driving digital transformation across our tools, and delivering operational excellence across CE&S.
  
  
As a Cloud Solution Architect aligned to Factory delivery, you will enable customers to achieve their outcomes based on their investments in Microsoft technology. Leveraging your Microsoft Copilot Studio technical subject matter expertise, you will lead technical conversations with customers and Microsoft colleagues, driving value to their organization. This is a hands-on role that includes accelerating customer adoption by building Agentic AI solutions and identifying resolutions to unblock customer success projects for the AI Factory. You will also drive product influence with Engineering through technical feedback via the[MR1.1][PR1.2][PR1.3] factory. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your technical and program management skills, and deepen your cloud expertise.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
CSAs are senior individual contributors who operate globally and engage directly with customers. It is a hands-on technical role spanning across design, build, and production with a focus on issue resolution to remove customer production blockers. Candidates are expected to comfortably switch from a whiteboard to the keyboard. This is a truly exciting role that will feature unique and challenging technical problems to solve and to help our customers succeed.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer-Centric Approach:
  
  

* Play a pivotal role in the AI Cloud Accelerate Factory, providing technical enablement, operational support, and strategic engagement across customer projects. This role is designed to ensure successful delivery of AI solutions built on Copilot Studio, troubleshoot complex issues, and support innovation through pilot evaluations and advanced use case development. Understand customers' overall data estate, business priorities, and IT success measures. Innovate with Agent solutions that drive business value.
* Facilitate scalable delivery through strong technical program management utilizing a factory model/approach, driving program awareness and demand across the regional operating units. Attend in-flight project status meetings to monitor progress and identify support needs. Engage directly with complex or non-standard customer use cases beyond existing accelerators. Participate in intake reviews for milestone sizing, objection handling, and technical scoping.
* Ensure Solution Excellence: Deliver solutions with high performance, security, scalability, maintainability, repeatability, reusability, and reliability upon deployment. Gather insights from customers and partners and maintain a high CSAT.

**Business Impact**

* Usage (Cloud & Support) Growth: Develop opportunities to drive Customer Success business results by working with business and technical decision makers to ensure they understand Microsoft 365, Copilot and Copilot Studio value proposition and get value from their investment in Microsoft technology.
* Resolution of Customer Blockers: Identify resolutions to issues blocking go-live of customer success projects by leveraging deep knowledge of Microsoft 365 services & technical subject matter expertise. Lead technical conversations with customers to drive value from their Microsoft 365 investments and implement AI Agents. Deliver all work according to Factory best practices & policies and using repeatable IP.
* Architect Copilot Studio Agent Solutions: Apply technical knowledge to design solutions aligned with business and IT needs. Create Innovate with Agent roadmaps, lead POCs and MVPs, and ensure long-term technical viability.

**Technical Leadership**

* Advocate for Customers: Share insights and best practices, collaborate with the Factory team to address key blockers, and influence improvements, roadmap and feature prioritization.
* Resolve technical blockers: Debug technical issues and provide fixes for engagements encountering blockers.
* Learn It All: Demonstrate Self Learner mindset through continuous alignment of individual skilling to team/area demands and Customer Success goals.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated on market trends, collaborate with the technical community, and educate customers about the Copilot Studio capabilities and platform.
* Accelerate Customer Outcomes: Through engaging with field teams, share expertise, drive factory nomination pipeline, and promote Factory to accelerate customer success, as well as collate feedback upon execution to drive improvement and leverage field teams inputs.

**Business Process Analysis**

* Depict customer business processes and prepare for the analysis and improvement of business process performance.
* Articulate, demo, and present complex customer concepts to varying audiences, such as BDMs (Business Decision Makers) & ITDMs (Information Technology Decision Makers).
* Experienced in delivery management, opportunity qualification, stakeholder communication, and partner engagement, including opportunity and pipeline mgmt.
* Experience in ensuring customers realize value by consuming technology.
* Collaboration & field Engagement: Experienced in collaborating in virtual teams to develop and drive M365 Copilot usage opportunities through influence. Identify and document best practices and customer references/ Winwires.

**Qualifications**
Required/Minimum Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 8+ years’ experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, Microsoft Azure business Solutions, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or Business Applications consulting OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Breadth of technical experience and knowledge in foundational security, foundational AI, architecture design, with depth / Subject Matter Expertise in one or more of the following:
  
  

* Deep Domain Expertise in M365 Areas: Deep domain expertise in one or more of the M365 specific areas, such as Microsoft IQ understanding, Connectors, MCP Servers and Copilot Studio OR hands-on experience working with the respective products at the expert level.
* Low Code development experience - Power Platform experience is needed. Copilot 365 and Teams background is useful for the role
* 8+ years experience working in a customer-facing role and on technical M365/Power Platform/Copilot Studio projects.
* Architecting Enterprise-Grade Solutions: Deep knowledge of solution architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of Cloud/collaboration environments.
* Certification in one or more of the following technologies preferred: M365 fundamentals, M365 Copilot fundamentals, Microsoft Power Platform/Copilot Studio platforms, Microsoft Azure fundamentals, Cloud Security, AI Business Professional and AI Transformation Leader, AI Fundamentals.
* Fluency in SaaS solutions; particularly all Microsoft 365 offerings.
* Domain experience Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure solutions, and understanding of how Microsoft Security, compliance, and identity solutions that can span across these solution areas to provide a holistic and end-to-end solution.
* Competitive Landscape knowledge of cloud and AI platforms. Understanding of M365 partner ecosystems and creation of Agents to solve customer needs.
* Breadth of technical experience and knowledge, with depth / SME in two or more of the following M365 solutions.
* M365 Copilot
* Power Platform/Copilot Studio
* Azure Foundry
* IDM, Information Protection & Compliance.
* Governance & Risk Management
* Agentic Workflows: Familiarity with Agent Framework, MCP, Langchain, or other agentic frameworks.
* Generative AI and Responsible AI: Foundational knowledge of current and emerging AI technology, including Generative AI technology applications and use cases (including, but not limited to, Large Language Models) and Foundational models toolsets.
* Understanding of Responsible AI practice including ethical considerations, bias mitigation, and fairness.
* Competitive Landscape: Understanding the competitive landscape is valuable; candidates should be aware of key AI platforms beyond Azure, such as AWS and GCP.
* Collaboration and Communication: Acknowledged for driving decisions collaboratively, resolving conflicts and ensuring follow through with exceptional verbal and written communication skills.  Presentation skills with a high degree of comfort with both large and small audiences.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

fd4e31b1.title: Data Architect(Immediate Joiner_Remote)
fd4e31b1.description:
**Job Description: Data Architect**

  

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a **Data Architect** who can provide strong technical leadership across data engineering, architecture, and cloud solutions. The role requires a hands-on architect who can **make sound technical decisions, work closely with the customer and engineering teams, resolve technical roadblocks, and drive scalable data solutions from design through implementation**.The ideal candidate should be versatile across modern data and AWS technologies, with strong experience in **Python, Apache Spark, SQL, AWS, dbt, and Snowflake**, along with a good understanding of event-driven architectures, CDC, data integration, and cloud-native services.**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and drive **data architecture and technical decisions** across data engineering initiatives.
* Work closely with **customer architects, engineering leaders, product teams, and developers** to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable solutions.
* Define **data architecture, integration patterns, data models, pipelines, processing frameworks, and technology standards**.
* Provide technical direction to data engineering teams and **unblock complex implementation challenges**.

* Define and implement cloud-native data solutions leveraging relevant **AWS services**.

* Collaborate with DevOps, application, security, and platform teams to ensure **end-to-end solution alignment**.
* Support technical estimation, roadmap planning, PoCs, and architecture decisions for new initiatives.
* Stay hands-on enough to **prototype solutions, troubleshoot issues, and validate architectural decisions** when required.
* Mentor engineers and help build stronger technical capabilities within the team.

  

**Required Technical SkillsCore Data Engineering**

* Strong hands-on experience with **Python, Apache Spark, and SQL**
* Strong understanding of **data modeling, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, and data integration**
* Experience with **dbt** and modern data transformation practices
* Strong experience with **Snowflake**, including data modeling, performance optimization, and scalable data processing

  

**AWS / Cloud**

* Strong AWS experience with the ability to design cloud-native data solutions
* Good working knowledge of services such as:
* S3
* Lambda
* Glue
* EventBridge
* SNS / SQS
* Step Functions
* IAM
* CloudWatch
* Understanding of cloud security, networking, scalability, reliability, and cost considerations

  

**Data Architecture**

* Experience designing **modern data platforms and data architectures**
* Strong understanding of **CDC (Change Data Capture)** and incremental data processing
* Experience with batch and event-driven architectures
* Understanding of APIs, file-based integrations, messaging, and streaming patterns
* Strong understanding of data quality, governance, lineage, and observability

  

**Customer & Leadership Skills**

* Strong ability to **communicate architecture and technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders**
* Comfortable working directly with customers and challenging assumptions when required
* Ability to evaluate multiple technical options and clearly articulate **trade-offs and recommendations**
* Strong problem-solving skills with a bias toward **unblocking teams and moving delivery forward**
* Ability to operate across architecture, engineering, cloud, data, and application teams
* Comfortable working in an environment where requirements and technical challenges evolve rapidly
* Strong ownership and accountability for technical outcomes

  

**Experience**

* **10+ years** of experience in data engineering / data architecture / cloud data platforms
* Strong hands-on experience with **Python, Spark, SQL, AWS, dbt, and Snowflake**
* Proven experience working as a **Data Architect / Lead Data Engineer / Data Engineering Architect**
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers and distributed engineering teams
* Experience making architecture decisions and leading technical delivery across complex data initiatives

  

**What Success Looks Like**

* Engineering teams have clear **technical direction and architecture guidance**
* Technical blockers are identified and resolved quickly
* Customer and engineering teams are aligned on **architecture, technology choices, and implementation approach**
* Data solutions are scalable, secure, performant, and maintainable
* Architecture decisions translate effectively into **working production solutions**
* The team becomes increasingly self-sufficient through strong technical guidance and mentoring

bbd1d159.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Cloud Data Architect - Databricks - Executive Director
bbd1d159.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Name-GDS Consulting Cloud Data Architect – Databricks**

The Cloud Data Architect will lead the strategic migration and transformation of enterprise data platforms from legacy systems to modern cloud-native architectures using Databricks. This role is pivotal in enabling scalable, secure, and high-performance data analytics environments for EY clients across sectors.
  
  
The architect will be responsible for designing future-state reference architectures, guiding implementation teams, and ensuring alignment with EY’s data modernization strategy. The role demands deep technical expertise, hands-on leadership, and the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology domains.
  
  
The leader will be responsible for accelerating the following:
  
  
Strategic Leadership
  
  

* Drive the strategic vision for cloud data modernization, leveraging Databricks capabilities within EY
* Lead cross-functional teams across geographies to deliver scalable data solutions that support enterprise transformation.
* Influence client C-suite stakeholders by articulating the business value of cloud-native data architectures. Market Intelligence and Go-To-Market (GTM)
* Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies in cloud data platforms to inform solution strategy.
* Collaborate with EY GTM teams to develop differentiated offerings around Databricks.
* Contribute to EY’s market positioning by aligning architecture capabilities with client demand and sector-specific needs.

Sales and Business Development
  
  

* Support pre-sales activities including client workshops, RFP responses, and solution demos.
* Partner with account teams to identify opportunities for cloud data transformation and drive pipeline growth.
* Translate client requirements into scalable architecture proposals that align with EY’s delivery capabilities.

Thought Leadership
  
  

* Represent EY in industry forums, webinars, and conferences focused on cloud data and analytics.
* Author whitepapers, blogs, and internal knowledge assets on Databricks best practices.
* Mentor junior architects and contribute to EY’s internal capability development programs.

Partnership and Ecosystem Development
  
  

* Build and nurture strategic alliances with Databricks and Azure to codevelop joint solutions.
* Engage with technology partners to stay abreast of product roadmaps and integration capabilities.
* Leverage EY’s ecosystem to deliver end-to-end solutions that span data, AI, cloud, and security.

* Lead and architect the migration of data analytics environments from legacy systems to Databricks with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Define high-level migration roadmaps and future-state reference architectures on Azure cloud.
* Design and implement end-to-end data analytics solutions leveraging Databricks utilities and big data modeling techniques using Python.
* Setup, configure, and deploy Databricks solutions across multidepartment environments.
* Guide teams in implementing best practices for data transformation, aggregation, and workload management.
* Address technical inquiries related to customization, integration, and enterprise architecture.
* Enable business stakeholders to make data-driven decisions through accurate analysis, reporting, and presentation of key findings.

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**

* Make strategic decisions on cloud architecture design, resource allocation, and technology investments.
* Evaluate performance metrics and ROI of Databricks implementations.
* Conduct impact analysis of proposed solutions on client operations, including cost-benefit, scalability, and integration feasibility.
* Prioritize solution components based on business value and technical feasibility.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 15-20 years of experience in data architecture, solution design, and implementation.
* At least two end-to-end implementations of Databricks and cloud data platforms.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale data migration projects and managing cross-functional teams.
* Experience in client-facing roles with a track record of delivering high-impact solutions.

* Experience in handling complex deployments and multi-tower configurations.

The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers
